examples.en: There are two areas that are particularly intended for children.
examples.zh: 有两个区域是专门为儿童设计的。

examples.en: I know a lot of people study economics too.
examples.zh: 我知道很多人也在学经济学。

examples.en: There used to be a lot of factories in this area until the 1960s.
examples.zh: 直到20世纪60年代，这一带曾有很多工厂。

examples.en: Please speak to your supervisor if this is going to be a problem.
examples.zh: 如果这会造成问题，请与你的主管谈谈。

examples.en: We invoice you afterwards, so you don't pay for children who can't come because of sickness, for example.
examples.zh: 我们事后会开具账单，所以比如孩子因生病无法到场，你无需为此付费。

examples.en: The baths were luxurious, and bathing became very popular.
examples.zh: 浴场十分奢华，沐浴因此变得非常流行。

examples.en: The winding spiral of the labyrinth has been used for centuries as a metaphor for life's journey.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，迷宫蜿蜒的螺旋一直被用来比喻人生的旅程。

examples.en: I'm sure you'll have some ideas about what I can do.
examples.zh: 我相信你对我能做什么已经有一些想法了。

examples.en: I think having nutritional food labeling has been a good idea, don't you?
examples.zh: 我觉得食品营养标签是个好主意,你说呢?

examples.en: The viewer sees not an actor working at his craft, but another human being struggling with life.
examples.zh: 观众看到的不是一个在施展演技的演员，而是另一个在人生中挣扎的普通人。

examples.en: There are two things you need to know about large furniture.
examples.zh: 关于大件家具，有两点你需要知道。

examples.en: I expect you've done some research to find out if anyone else is selling a similar product.
examples.zh: 我想你已经做过一些调研，看看是否有别人在卖类似的产品。

examples.en: We have studied only 5 percent of the species we know.
examples.zh: 我们迄今只研究了已知物种的5%。

examples.en: The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks.
examples.zh: 托儿费用包含餐食和点心。

examples.en: I just think it's sad when children don't read books.
examples.zh: 孩子们不读书，我只觉得很可悲。

examples.en: The important thing is that you don't have to study and work.
examples.zh: 重要的是你不必同时兼顾学习和工作。

examples.en: Let me know if you need any more information.
examples.zh: 如果还需要更多信息，请告诉我。

examples.en: A lot of students go on to take a master's degree.
examples.zh: 很多学生会继续攻读硕士学位。

examples.en: Newspapers and broadcasters are there to provide what the public wants.
examples.zh: 报纸和广播机构的作用是提供公众想要的内容。

examples.en: We're thinking of offering tours in other languages in future.
examples.zh: 我们正考虑将来提供其他语言的导览服务。

examples.en: I've learnt such a lot about what sustainability actually means.
examples.zh: 我对"可持续性"的真正含义学到了很多。

examples.en: By 1907, the heart of today's Underground system was in place.
examples.zh: 到1907年，今天地铁系统的核心部分已经建成。

examples.en: For a start, play can even cost animals their lives.
examples.zh: 首先，玩耍甚至可能让动物丧命。

examples.en: Counter-intuitively, hunger is prevalent among many smallholder farmers in the developing world.
examples.zh: 与直觉相反，饥饿在发展中国家的许多小农户中十分普遍。

examples.en: The rise has been even steeper since the early 1980s.
examples.zh: 自20世纪80年代初以来，涨幅更加陡峭。

examples.en: By 1878, the number of teams in the football league increased again.
examples.zh: 到1878年，足球联赛的球队数量再次增加。

examples.en: I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is.
examples.zh: 我想我学到了很多，明白了剪辑有多重要。

examples.en: Planks used to build the outer hull were initially sewn together.
examples.zh: 用来建造外层船体的木板最初是缝合在一起的。

examples.en: I just ask for a handful and you fry it in butter.
examples.zh: 我只要一小把，你用黄油煎一下就行。

examples.en: Fractals are common throughout nature, for example in the shapes of mountain peaks or the branches of trees.
examples.zh: 分形在自然界中很常见，例如山峰的形状或树木的枝杈。

examples.en: At times, he seemed to abandon the human figure altogether.
examples.zh: 有时，他似乎完全抛弃了人物形象。

examples.en: The adaptive significance of photoperiodism in plants is also clear.
examples.zh: 植物光周期现象的适应意义同样很明显。

examples.en: I was always worried that my poor handwriting affected my exam results.
examples.zh: 我一直担心自己字迹差会影响考试成绩。

examples.en: The problems that look or sound most dramatic may not be the best places to start.
examples.zh: 看起来或听起来最严重的问题，未必是最适合着手解决的。

examples.en: The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country.
examples.zh: 这里的学校很好，医院也是全国最好的之一。

examples.en: The main reason for this is the power plants used to produce electricity.
examples.zh: 主要原因是用来发电的发电厂。

examples.en: We have eight levels for children from three years upwards.
examples.zh: 我们为三岁以上的孩子设有八个级别。

examples.en: You'll see a smaller track leading off to the right.
examples.zh: 你会看到右边有一条分出去的小路。

examples.en: I was thinking we should start our presentation with an example from our own experience.
examples.zh: 我在想，我们的演讲应该从自己的亲身经历中举个例子开始。

examples.en: The basic process was quite straightforward - breaking the stale bread down to a paste then reforming it.
examples.zh: 基本流程相当简单：把变硬的面包捣成糊状，再重新塑形。

examples.en: The building at the port fell into disrepair, and the place became almost forgotten.
examples.zh: 港口的那座建筑年久失修，那个地方几乎被人遗忘。

examples.en: I thought we could look at seed germination - how a seed begins to grow.
examples.zh: 我想我们可以看看种子萌发，也就是种子如何开始生长。

examples.en: What you can't do is leave it until a few days before the start of term.
examples.zh: 你不能把它拖到开学前几天才做。

examples.en: If you're thinking about taking up running - I'm here to help.
examples.zh: 如果你想开始跑步，我可以帮你。

examples.en: In talking about leadership, we often mention transformational leaders and transactional leaders.
examples.zh: 谈到领导力，我们常提到变革型领导者和交易型领导者。

examples.en: Local managers seem to queue up to borrow the videos!
examples.zh: 当地的经理们似乎都排着队来借这些录像带！

examples.en: I can help you fill out the application forms if you like.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以帮你填写申请表。

examples.en: First I suggest you avoid taking one writer and going into a great deal of detail.
examples.zh: 首先，我建议你不要只选一位作家并深入细究。

examples.en: I've only just moved to the city so I don't actually know many people yet.
examples.zh: 我刚搬到这座城市，所以还不认识多少人。

examples.en: You wanted to see me about your textile design project.
examples.zh: 你想和我谈谈你的纺织品设计项目。

examples.en: In 1849 he began a three-year apprenticeship to become an accountant.
examples.zh: 1849年，他开始了为期三年的学徒生涯，准备成为一名会计。

examples.en: I'd say loneliness has a lot to do with the way cities are designed.
examples.zh: 我认为孤独感与城市的设计方式有很大关系。

examples.en: I was involved in something similar where I used to live, counting all the species of moths.
examples.zh: 我参与过类似的活动，在我以前住的地方统计各种飞蛾。

examples.en: You know, I hadn't realized that children benefit in so many ways from learning to write.
examples.zh: 你知道吗，我以前没意识到，学写字对孩子有这么多好处。

examples.en: Planning permission has been granted for development of both sites.
examples.zh: 两处场地的开发已获得规划许可。

examples.en: Shopping in the town centre has changed over the years.
examples.zh: 多年来，市中心的购物方式已经发生了变化。

examples.en: We would expect to bring between 30 and 40 children.
examples.zh: 我们预计会带30到40个孩子来。

examples.en: Children's activities are often arranged there, like bread-making and face-painting.
examples.zh: 那里经常安排儿童活动，比如做面包和脸部彩绘。

examples.en: There'll also be a community centre for people of all ages.
examples.zh: 还会有一个面向各年龄段人群的社区中心。

examples.en: We decided we wanted to create something people could eat on the go rather than in a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们想打造一种可以边走边吃、而不必在餐厅里吃的食物。

examples.en: I'm sure I'd be able to help but let me take down a few details.
examples.zh: 我肯定能帮上忙，不过先让我记下一些细节。

senses.zh: 成像清晰点；调焦装置；关注的中心

examples.en: You can focus on one thing at a time.
examples.zh: 你可以一次专注于一件事。

examples.en: I was only expecting to get eight or nine pounds an hour.
examples.zh: 我原本只指望每小时挣八九英镑。

examples.en: By 1995, although at least 12 chicks had been produced on the islands, only three had survived.
examples.zh: 到1995年，尽管岛上至少已孵出12只雏鸟，但只有三只存活。

examples.en: A lot of the other possible experiments need quite a bit longer.
examples.zh: 其他许多可能的实验需要的时间长得多。

examples.en: Some years ago, federal money was granted to build a new road.
examples.zh: 几年前，联邦政府拨款修建了一条新公路。

examples.en: I think it would have taken me ages to prepare examples, showing each of the steps involved in making the bird.
examples.zh: 我觉得要准备示例，展示制作这只鸟的每个步骤，会花上我很长时间。

examples.en: You can, and it's very good, though it's not included in the basic cost.
examples.zh: 可以，而且很不错，不过它不包含在基础费用里。

examples.en: There are also several smaller ones, ponds and a stream that flows through the park.
examples.zh: 还有几个较小的公园、池塘和一条流经公园的小溪。

examples.en: A lot more research will be needed, however, before the causes of the glow-worm's gradual decline are clear.
examples.zh: 不过，在弄清萤火虫数量逐渐减少的原因之前，还需要更多的研究。

examples.en: We try hard to involve members of the public in the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们努力让公众参与到剧院的活动中来。

examples.en: I was told to come here, because I'd like to talk to someone about taking a management course.
examples.zh: 有人让我来这儿，因为我想找人谈谈报读管理课程的事。

examples.en: All our lets start on the first of the month.
examples.zh: 我们所有的租约都从每月一号开始。

examples.en: Occasionally, research can be done even in environments where the researchers can't be present.
examples.zh: 有时，即便在研究人员无法亲临的环境中也能开展研究。

examples.en: If you book a family room, it's about £125 per night.
examples.zh: 如果你预订家庭房，大约每晚125英镑。

examples.en: One way to answer the question is to look at the music and not the neurons.
examples.zh: 回答这个问题的一种方式是研究音乐，而不是神经元。

examples.en: For a fuller picture, researchers need more sunken settlements, but the hard part is finding them.
examples.zh: 要获得更全面的图景，研究人员需要更多沉没的聚落，但难点在于找到它们。

examples.en: If we know what's going to happen next, then we don't get excited.
examples.zh: 如果我们知道接下来会发生什么，就不会感到兴奋。

examples.en: As part of this, the effect of each business on the environment was considered.
examples.zh: 其中一环是考虑每家企业对环境的影响。

examples.en: Episodic memories allow us to mentally travel back in time to an event from the past.
examples.zh: 情景记忆让我们能在脑海中回到过去发生的某个事件。

examples.en: Controlled airspace is divided into several different types, designated by letters of the alphabet.
examples.zh: 受管制空域分为几种不同的类型，以字母代号标示。

examples.en: The latest idea suggests that play has evolved to build big brains.
examples.zh: 最新的观点认为，玩耍的进化是为了发育出更大的大脑。

examples.en: The company will pay for eight hours of your time.
examples.zh: 公司会为你付八小时的工时费。

examples.en: There seem to be two main attitudes toward that question.
examples.zh: 对这个问题似乎有两种主要的态度。

examples.en: I only arrived in the country a month ago.
examples.zh: 我一个月前才来到这个国家。

examples.en: We're going to a number of sites, and we won't always be together.
examples.zh: 我们要去好几个地点，不一定总在一起。

examples.en: I'm interested in all kinds of dancing, so I'm sure I'll enjoy that!
examples.zh: 我对各种舞蹈都感兴趣，所以我肯定会喜欢那个！

examples.en: Second, more food is now produced per head of the world's population than at any time in history.
examples.zh: 其次，现在世界上人均生产的粮食比历史上任何时候都多。

examples.en: At the turn of the key, the boiler lit and reached its operating pressure inside of forty seconds.
examples.zh: 钥匙一转，锅炉点燃，不到四十秒就达到了工作压力。

examples.en: Travel on converted mining trains and journey into the depths of the mountain along seams once worked by hundreds of miners.
examples.zh: 乘坐改装的矿车，沿着数百名矿工曾经开采的矿脉深入山腹。

examples.en: I'm really struggling with my Year 12 science class.
examples.zh: 我教的十二年级科学课真让我头疼。

examples.en: I think ticket offices should be open for longer hours.
examples.zh: 我认为售票处应该延长开放时间。

examples.en: I'm ringing because I need a bit of advice.
examples.zh: 我打电话是想征求一点建议。

examples.en: There are several hypotheses which are not mutually exclusive.
examples.zh: 有几种并不互相排斥的假说。

examples.en: Glass is easy to recycle because it can be reused over and over again without becoming weaker.
examples.zh: 玻璃很容易回收，因为它可以反复使用而不会变脆弱。

examples.en: I've got a copy of a program that's now in a museum.
examples.zh: 我有一份程序的副本，现在已经陈列在博物馆里了。

examples.en: If we are good, it's only because we have managed to control and transcend our innate selfishness and brutality.
examples.zh: 我们之所以表现良好，只是因为我们设法控制并超越了与生俱来的自私和残暴。

examples.en: Most people say it is the intellect which makes a great scientist.
examples.zh: 大多数人说，造就杰出科学家的是智力。

examples.en: Younger school-aged children read stories on smartphones; older kids don't read at all, but hunch over video games.
examples.zh: 年龄较小的学龄儿童在智能手机上读故事；大一点的孩子根本不读书，只会弓着背玩电子游戏。

examples.en: In terms of fundraising to support our activities, we've done very well.
examples.zh: 就筹款支持我们的活动而言，我们做得非常好。

examples.en: The product is the country itself - the people, the places and the experiences.
examples.zh: 产品就是这个国家本身——这里的人、地方和体验。

examples.en: Whitebread's recent research has involved developing a play-based approach to supporting children's writing.
examples.zh: 怀特布雷德最近的研究致力于开发一种以游戏为基础的方法，来支持儿童写作。

examples.en: There are examples of languages that have survived in written form and then been revived by later generations.
examples.zh: 有些语言以书面形式留存下来，后来被后代重新复兴。

examples.en: I have to say though that the whale sighting is only one of the many things offered.
examples.zh: 不过我得说，观鲸只是所提供的众多项目之一。

examples.en: Elm was also the preferred material for shields and early swords.
examples.zh: 榆木也是制作盾牌和早期刀剑的首选材料。

examples.en: The theory is also supported by evidence from a dolphin stranding in 1994.
examples.zh: 1994年海豚搁浅的证据也支持了这一理论。

examples.en: I expected to find it more challenging, but I could follow the story pretty well.
examples.zh: 我原以为会觉得更难，但故事我基本都能跟上。

examples.en: I expect it'll take me a while to find what I need.
examples.zh: 我估计要花一阵子才能找到我需要的东西。

examples.en: The myth of the 'natural' forest has survived, yet there are effectively no remaining 'primary' forests in Europe.
examples.zh: "天然"森林的神话流传至今，但事实上欧洲已没有"原始"森林了。

examples.en: In the past, the case for public transport has been made on the basis of environmental and social justice considerations rather than economics.
examples.zh: 过去，支持发展公共交通的理由是基于环境和社会公正方面的考虑，而非经济因素。

examples.en: The tech industry has been criticized in the past for focusing too much on young consumers, but this is changing.
examples.zh: 科技行业过去曾因过于关注年轻消费者而受到批评，但这种情况正在改变。

examples.en: I read something about milk and butter being transported in refrigerated railroad cars in the USA, right back in the 1840s.
examples.zh: 我读到过，早在19世纪40年代，美国就用冷藏火车车厢运输牛奶和黄油。

examples.en: I think I should probably have ground up the nuts more than I did.
examples.zh: 我想我应该把坚果磨得更碎一些。

examples.en: Premier membership is for individuals only, but you will be sent passes for guests every month.
examples.zh: 高级会员资格仅限个人，但每月会寄给你访客通行证。

examples.en: Parking space is available, with permits costing £60 per term.
examples.zh: 有停车位，许可证每学期60英镑。

examples.en: The aim of this is to help older people keep up with technology.
examples.zh: 这样做的目的是帮助老年人跟上科技的步伐。

examples.en: Films and compact discs cost little to transport, even by aeroplane.
examples.zh: 电影和光盘的运输成本很低，即使空运也是如此。

examples.en: You might find modern novels or 19th century playwrights interesting.
examples.zh: 你可能会觉得现代小说或19世纪的剧作家很有意思。

examples.en: I want to talk about the rationale behind what I decided to do.
examples.zh: 我想谈谈我做出那个决定背后的理由。

examples.en: Madagascar's forests are being converted to agricultural land at a rate of one percent every year.
examples.zh: 马达加斯加的森林正以每年百分之一的速度被改造成农田。

examples.en: Today we're going to look at an important area of science, namely nanotechnology.
examples.zh: 今天我们要看科学的一个重要领域，即纳米技术。

examples.en: I'm delighted you're all interested in joining the scheme.
examples.zh: 我很高兴你们都有兴趣参加这个计划。

examples.en: Shade-tolerant plants have lower photosynthetic rates and hence have lower growth rates than those of shade-intolerant species.
examples.zh: 耐阴植物的光合速率较低，因此生长速度比不耐阴的物种更慢。

examples.en: Single-storey greenhouses have the benefit of natural overhead light: even so, many still need artificial lighting.
examples.zh: 单层温室具有自然顶光的优势，即便如此，许多温室仍需要人工照明。

examples.en: I never really planned to be a lifeboat volunteer when I came to live in Northsea.
examples.zh: 我来到诺斯海居住时，从没真正打算当救生艇志愿者。

examples.en: You are asked to fill in a questionnaire giving details of any health problems.
examples.zh: 你需要填写一份问卷，说明任何健康问题的详情。

examples.en: I'm hoping to do the one in business skills.
examples.zh: 我希望能上商务技能那门课。

senses.zh: 可信的；可望成功的；可能的

examples.en: The knock-on effects are likely to include more warming, cloudier skies, increased precipitation and higher sea levels.
examples.zh: 连锁反应很可能包括气候进一步变暖、天空更多云、降水增加和海平面上升。

examples.en: I'm going to suggest that's an over-simple view.
examples.zh: 我想说，这是一种过于简单化的看法。

examples.en: The College offers a wide range of educational and training programs in business and related areas.
examples.zh: 学院提供商业及相关领域的各类教育和培训课程。

examples.en: As long as you get there by 3.30, you should be fine.
examples.zh: 只要你3点30分前到那儿，就没问题。

examples.en: The town produces a monthly magazine and Anyone who lives in the town can send in articles.
examples.zh: 镇上每月出版一份杂志，镇上任何人都可以投稿。

examples.en: In the meantime, ice caps would continue to melt and sea levels rise.
examples.zh: 与此同时，冰盖将继续融化，海平面将继续上升。

examples.en: The top is made of glass so that you can look down into it.
examples.zh: 顶部是玻璃做的，这样你可以向下看到里面。

examples.en: Of course, you will all have your own reasons for coming here.
examples.zh: 当然，你们每个人来这里都有自己的理由。

examples.en: I found it quite hard to follow - lots about the theory, which I hadn't expected.
examples.zh: 我觉得很难跟上——讲了很多理论，这是我没想到的。

examples.en: I think we should start by talking about the benefits.
examples.zh: 我认为我们应该先谈谈好处。

examples.en: Fear is a major impediment to thinking like an iconoclast and stops the average person in his tracks.
examples.zh: 恐惧是阻碍人像离经叛道者那样思考的主要障碍，让普通人止步不前。

examples.en: Parking is available with permits costing £90 for the academic year.
examples.zh: 有停车位，整个学年的许可证为90英镑。

examples.en: We considered buying a garden seat to put there, but the authorities weren't happy with that idea.
examples.zh: 我们考虑过在那里放一张花园长椅，但当局不同意这个主意。

examples.en: The development of women's pockets was a little different.
examples.zh: 女性口袋的发展则略有不同。

examples.zh: Desolenator运行所需的能量来自阳光。

examples.en: The rivers were a big part of people's lives.
examples.zh: 河流是人们生活的重要组成部分。

examples.en: The meeting room is the last one on the right, and I'm afraid there's no natural daylight in the room.
examples.zh: 会议室是右边最后一间，恐怕房间里没有自然光。

examples.en: While it can be good to include slides, you could end up spending too long looking for suitable ones.
examples.zh: 虽然加入幻灯片可能不错，但你最后可能会花太长时间去找合适的。

examples.en: I didn't know that first started with workers in the textile industry.
examples.zh: 我不知道那是从纺织业的工人开始的。

examples.en: The clinic only opened a year ago, so the facilities are all very modern.
examples.zh: 诊所一年前才开业，所以设施都很现代。

examples.en: Painting continues to be one of the most popular activities.
examples.zh: 绘画仍然是最受欢迎的活动之一。

examples.en: We need another approach, and there is a promising candidate.
examples.zh: 我们需要另一种方法，而且有一个很有希望的候选方案。

examples.en: We had to make sure we gave a really high level of service.
examples.zh: 我们必须确保提供非常高水准的服务。

examples.en: I'm not sure I understand how it improves children's imagination though.
examples.zh: 我不确定我是否明白它如何提升孩子的想象力。

examples.en: I know I've got to work on my study skills.
examples.zh: 我知道我得提高自己的学习技能。

examples.en: I'm not sure it's the easiest for people to use but at least you get the full story.
examples.zh: 我不确定它是不是最便于使用，但至少你能了解完整的情况。

examples.en: The key word in heritage display is now 'experience', the more exciting the better and if possible, involving all the senses.
examples.zh: 文化遗产展示的关键词现在是"体验"，越刺激越好，最好能调动所有感官。

senses.zh: 事件；可能发生的事；结果

examples.en: There are several events that go on the whole time.
examples.zh: 有几项活动全程持续进行。

examples.en: At present it's a bit of a ghost town.
examples.zh: 目前这里有点像座鬼城。

examples.en: Obviously most of you have already achieved a lot - I wish I could speak your language half as well.
examples.zh: 你们大多数人显然已经取得了很大成就——我真希望自己说你们的语言能有你们一半好。

examples.en: We would like to enlarge the building in the not-too-distant future, but this is by no means definite.
examples.zh: 我们希望在不久的将来扩建这座建筑，但绝不是板上钉钉。

examples.en: Ethnographic research has also been carried out in computer companies.
examples.zh: 民族志研究也已在计算机公司中开展。

examples.en: One or two of you asked me earlier about your level of spoken English.
examples.zh: 你们当中有一两位早些时候问过我的英语口语水平。

examples.en: I could get involved in one or two, particularly if there are any art groups.
examples.zh: 我可以参加一两个，尤其是如果有美术小组的话。

examples.en: As for the writing itself, I've annotated the proposal as and where I thought it could be improved.
examples.zh: 至于写作本身，我在我认为可以改进的地方给提案做了批注。

examples.en: People we've heard from are mainly worried about traffic in the area, and, in particular, the increasing speed of cars near schools.
examples.zh: 我们听到的人主要担心该地区的交通，尤其是学校附近车速越来越快。

examples.en: The trireme was superseded by larger ships with even more rowers.
examples.zh: 三列桨战船被配备更多桨手的更大战舰所取代。

examples.en: Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.
examples.zh: 与风能不同，它不太可能遭到环保方面的反对。

examples.en: The dominance of guilds not only prevented people from using their skills, but also held back even the simplest industrial innovation.
examples.zh: 行会的统治地位不仅阻碍人们运用自己的技能，甚至连最简单的工业创新也被阻挠。

examples.en: The Sheepmarket is one of the main centres for art and history in the whole of the country.
examples.zh: 羊市是全国艺术和历史的主要中心之一。

examples.en: The programme also provided pumps so that water could be brought from the river in pipes to the fields.
examples.zh: 该项目还提供了水泵，这样就能通过管道把河水引到田里。

examples.en: Some hotels aim to provide superior working conditions for their employees.
examples.zh: 一些酒店力求为员工提供更优越的工作条件。

examples.en: The soil would have become less productive and led to the abandonment of farming.
examples.zh: 土壤的生产力会下降，导致农耕被废弃。

examples.en: You'll be expected to work a 40-hour week but there may be opportunities to do overtime during busy periods.
examples.zh: 你需要每周工作40小时，但在繁忙时期可能有加班的机会。

examples.en: I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA.
examples.zh: 我想了解美国自驾游的一些信息。

examples.en: In terms of age groups, the over-65s are an important market, and one that's increasing steadily year on year.
examples.zh: 就年龄组而言，65岁以上的人群是一个重要市场，而且逐年稳步增长。

examples.en: We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money.
examples.zh: 我们尽可能压低成本，我们认为自己提供了物超所值的服务。

examples.en: I'd like to find out a few more details, if I may.
examples.zh: 如果可以的话，我想再了解一些细节。

examples.en: We could include something about changes in the source of funding, too.
examples.zh: 我们也可以加入一些关于资金来源变化的内容。

examples.en: When the theatre was built, people were generally slimmer and shorter than now, and the seats were very close together.
examples.zh: 剧院建成时，人们普遍比现在更瘦、更矮，座位挨得很近。

examples.en: You can picnic in the field, though do clear up behind you, of course.
examples.zh: 你可以在田里野餐，不过当然要把垃圾收拾干净。

examples.en: We usually ask for a minimum sum of £50.
examples.zh: 我们通常要求最低金额为50英镑。

examples.en: Most scientists don't speak language that policy-makers can understand, and vice versa.
examples.zh: 大多数科学家说的话政策制定者听不懂，反之亦然。

examples.en: The classes are held in the morning from ten to eleven.
examples.zh: 课程在上午十点到十一点举行。

examples.en: The Sheffield investigation, which involved sixteen primary schools and seven secondary schools, found that most schools succeeded in reducing bullying.
examples.zh: 谢菲尔德的调查涉及16所小学和7所中学，发现大多数学校成功减少了欺凌。

examples.en: The theory suggests that two factors affect which goals we are focusing on.
examples.zh: 该理论认为，有两个因素会影响我们专注于哪些目标。

examples.en: In the West at least, most food is now far cheaper to buy in relative terms than it was in 1960.
examples.zh: 至少在西方，大多数食品相对而言现在比1960年便宜得多。

examples.en: Every hotel relies on having loyal and experienced members of staff who make sure that everything runs smoothly.
examples.zh: 每家酒店都依靠忠诚而经验丰富的员工来确保一切顺利运转。

examples.en: The thing about surfing is that it's great for all ages and all abilities.
examples.zh: 冲浪的好处在于，它适合所有年龄和所有水平的人。

examples.en: Marketeers aim to create a huge demand for a food item which was previously unknown or not needed.
examples.zh: 营销人员的目标是为一种以前不为人知或不被需要的食品创造巨大的需求。

examples.en: For the first year of work, special accrual rules apply.
examples.zh: 工作第一年适用特殊的应计规则。

examples.en: Many ancient civilisations developed rites such as dances in order to make the weather gods look kindly on them.
examples.zh: 许多古代文明发展出舞蹈等仪式，以期让天神对他们施以善意。

examples.en: The farmers were able to grow enough produce not just for their own needs, but also to sell.
examples.zh: 农民不仅能种出足够自己所需的农产品，还能拿去出售。

examples.en: I'll start today with some general background information.
examples.zh: 今天我先介绍一些一般背景信息。

examples.en: One important factor is your mailing list - that is, who you contact.
examples.zh: 一个重要因素是你的邮寄名单，也就是你联系的对象。

examples.en: I know, I hadn't realised birth order was such a popular area of research.
examples.zh: 我知道，我没想到出生顺序竟是个如此热门的研究领域。

examples.en: I also think that's more fruitful than placing it within the history of the genre.
examples.zh: 我还认为，这样比把它放在该体裁的历史中更有成果。

examples.en: You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite.
examples.zh: 你可以选择住在小木屋或露营地。

examples.en: Sort out the admin in plenty of time - air tickets, visas, insurance and medical matters such as vaccinations for some destinations.
examples.zh: 提前把行政事务安排妥当——机票、签证、保险，以及某些目的地需要接种疫苗等医疗事项。

examples.en: If we could just improve the resources and facilities, I think it would be fine.
examples.zh: 如果我们能改善资源和设施，我想就没问题了。

examples.en: There's a whole file of local information in there too.
examples.zh: 那里还有一整个文件夹的本地信息。

examples.en: If you're lucky, you might start out on a big budget film where you'll get the most useful experience.
examples.zh: 如果幸运的话，你可能从一部大制作电影开始，那样你会获得最有用的经验。

examples.en: I'm hoping to be in the spring production, too.
examples.zh: 我也希望参加春季演出。

examples.en: I wanted some information about the workshops in the school holidays.
examples.zh: 我想了解学校假期期间工作坊的信息。

examples.en: We offer one which is tailored to the needs of families, which is particularly popular.
examples.zh: 我们提供一种专为家庭需求量身定制的方案，尤其受欢迎。

examples.en: The loan amount in S.K.I. programs have generally ranged from US$30-$100.
examples.zh: S.K.I.项目的贷款金额一般在30至100美元之间。

examples.en: Producing enough energy to meet our needs has become a serious problem.
examples.zh: 生产足够满足我们需求的能源已成为一个严重的问题。

examples.en: For the foreseeable future, records will be made to be broken.
examples.zh: 在可预见的未来，纪录就是用来被打破的。

examples.en: I think it's too much for a journey that only takes 45 minutes.
examples.zh: 我觉得对于一趟只要45分钟的路程来说，这太多了。

examples.en: Intermixed with the development of a number sense is the development of an ability to count.
examples.zh: 数感的发展中夹杂着计数能力的发展。

examples.en: Implicit theories provide a framework that is useful in defining the general scope of a phenomenon - especially a not-well-understood phenomenon.
examples.zh: 内隐理论提供了一个框架，有助于界定某一现象的总体范围，尤其是尚未被充分理解的现象。

examples.en: The result was that the worms lost weight rapidly.
examples.zh: 结果是这些蠕虫体重迅速下降。

examples.en: The way we travel around cities has a major impact on whether they are sustainable.
examples.zh: 我们在城市里的出行方式，对城市是否可持续有重大影响。

examples.en: People were generally satisfied with the state of the roads.
examples.zh: 人们对道路状况普遍感到满意。

examples.en: Cycling has become almost as popular as running in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，骑行几乎和跑步一样受欢迎。

examples.en: I've been asked to arrange a visit to the park for two of our classes.
examples.zh: 我受托安排我们两个班去公园参观。

examples.en: 'Speak up' is part of a series of workshops on the subject of mental health.
examples.zh: "Speak up"是一系列心理健康主题工作坊的一部分。

examples.en: I enjoyed singing when I was at school, so I joined a group when I came to college.
examples.zh: 我在学校时喜欢唱歌，所以上大学时加入了一个合唱团。

examples.en: I read different reports about how unethical it is to even shear sheep.
examples.zh: 我读到过不同的报道，说连给羊剪毛都多么不道德。

examples.en: As these two regions have long been linked with the experience of pleasure, this finding isn't particularly surprising.
examples.zh: 由于这两个区域长期以来与愉悦体验相关联，这一发现并不特别令人意外。

examples.en: At breakfast, I read and read my notes again.
examples.zh: 吃早饭时，我一遍又一遍地看笔记。

examples.en: We can cover the cost in our entry charges.
examples.zh: 我们可以用入场费来支付这笔费用。

examples.en: The rangers will be hard at work all day, but do come and join in, even for just a short while.
examples.zh: 护林员整天都在忙碌，但欢迎你来参与，哪怕只待一会儿。

examples.en: If you reach the river, you've gone too far.
examples.zh: 如果你走到河边，就走过头了。

examples.en: There's also a system that enables AUVs to share information from seabed scans, and other data.
examples.zh: 还有一个系统能让水下自主航行器共享海床扫描信息和其他数据。

examples.en: I had to stay for a minimum of three months.
examples.zh: 我必须至少待三个月。

examples.en: You should never pick all the mushrooms in one area - collect only enough for your own needs.
examples.zh: 你千万不要把一个地方的蘑菇都采光——只采够自己所需的量。

examples.en: Participants were allowed to quit the task at any point.
examples.zh: 参与者可以在任何时候退出该任务。

examples.en: I had to go and work four hours every week in a community pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我每周要去社区药房工作四个小时。

examples.en: A great deal of habitat was lost through forest clearance, and introduced species such as deer depleted the remaining forests of food.
examples.zh: 大量栖息地因森林砍伐而丧失，而鹿等引入的物种则耗尽了剩余森林中的食物。

examples.en: Ant societies existed in something like their present form more than seventy million years ago.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁社会以与今天相差无几的形态存在已有七千多万年。

examples.en: Until recently, not much was known about the topic, and little help was available to teachers to deal with bullying.
examples.zh: 直到最近，人们对这个话题所知甚少，教师应对欺凌的帮助也很有限。

examples.en: We also manage a nature reserve, and there's a lot to do there all year round.
examples.zh: 我们还管理一个自然保护区，那里全年都有很多活动可做。

examples.en: If we could reduce the amount of CO2, perhaps the rate of climate change could also be slowed down.
examples.zh: 如果我们能减少二氧化碳的量，也许气候变化的速度也能放缓。

examples.en: I think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera.
examples.zh: 我认为我们本该多用相机做些尝试。

examples.en: In most industrialised countries over the past few years the fastest growth has been seen in the area of services.
examples.zh: 在大多数工业化国家，过去几年增长最快的是服务业领域。

examples.en: If I wasn't there, I think she'd forget to eat, for example.
examples.zh: 比如，如果我不在，我想她会忘了吃饭。

examples.en: The acoustics are also adjustable according to the size of orchestra and the type of music being played.
examples.zh: 音响效果还可根据管弦乐团的规模和演奏的音乐类型进行调节。

examples.en: I'm afraid I missed the advert for the job but heard about it from a friend.
examples.zh: 恐怕我错过了那则招聘广告，是听朋友说起这份工作的。

examples.en: I don't think I've really said enough about the marvellous area you'll be walking in.
examples.zh: 我觉得我对你们将要徒步游览的绝美地区介绍得还不够。

examples.en: I'd like to tell you about the different areas of the museum.
examples.zh: 我想向大家介绍博物馆的不同区域。

examples.en: The effects of noise on the ability of children to learn effectively in typical classroom environment are now the subjects of increasing concern.
examples.zh: 噪音对儿童在典型课堂环境中有效学习能力的影响，现在正日益受到关注。

examples.en: I'm here to explain what we can offer you.
examples.zh: 我来这里是为了说明我们能为你提供什么。

examples.en: Echinacea is a distinctive perennial with erect, hairy, spotted stems up to a metre tall.
examples.zh: 紫锥菊是一种独特的多年生植物，茎直立、多毛、有斑点，高可达一米。

examples.en: The hourly rate is about £10, 11 if you're lucky.
examples.zh: 时薪大约10英镑，运气好的话11英镑。

examples.en: I saw your advertisement about copying pictures to disk and I'd like a bit more information about what you do.
examples.zh: 我看到了你们关于把照片拷贝到光盘的广告，想多了解一些你们的服务。

examples.en: A growing concern is that loud noises in the ocean cause strandings.
examples.zh: 越来越令人担忧的是，海洋中的巨大噪音会导致鲸豚搁浅。

examples.en: You can then tailor what you say to the company's issues.
examples.zh: 这样你就能根据公司的问题来调整你要说的话。

examples.en: Do you think our secondary-school education should have been more career-focused?
examples.zh: 你认为我们的中学教育是否应该更以职业为导向？

examples.en: Many products are now designed with the elderly in mind.
examples.zh: 现在许多产品在设计时都考虑到了老年人。

examples.en: There will be a lot of new information to take in but don't worry too much about trying to remember everything.
examples.zh: 会有很多新信息需要消化，但不用太担心要记住所有内容。

examples.en: Fosbury also required another element that lies behind many improvements in athletic performance: an innovation in athletic equipment.
examples.zh: 福斯贝里还需要另一个因素，它是许多运动成绩提高背后的原因：运动器材的创新。

examples.en: You should have everything that you might need at hand.
examples.zh: 你应该把可能需要的一切都放在手边。

examples.en: When the government imposed restrictions on the use of paper.
examples.zh: 当政府对纸张的使用施加限制时。

examples.en: Across species, play tends to peak about halfway through the suckling stage and then decline.
examples.zh: 纵观各个物种，玩耍往往在哺乳期进行到一半时达到高峰，然后逐渐减少。

examples.en: There are a wide range of neurological diseases and conditions that can affect episodic memory.
examples.zh: 有多种神经系统疾病和病症会影响情景记忆。

examples.en: I could meet you if you like and show you around.
examples.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以去接你，带你四处看看。

examples.en: There's always a queue for the machines and they're often out of order.
examples.zh: 这些机器总是要排队，而且经常出故障。

examples.en: As demand grew, farmers began working the land all year round in order to produce more quinoa.
examples.zh: 随着需求增长，农民开始全年耕作，以生产更多藜麦。

examples.en: In Europe, only orthodox doctors can prescribe herbal medicine.
examples.zh: 在欧洲，只有正统医生才能开具草药处方。

examples.en: The massage is meant to relax you and get rid of lines and wrinkles.
examples.zh: 按摩的目的是让你放松，并消除线条和皱纹。

examples.en: The scientists first had Gareyev perform some standard memory tests.
examples.zh: 科学家们首先让加雷耶夫做了一些标准的记忆测试。

examples.en: If you plan to return another time, you might like to book one of our VIP tours.
examples.zh: 如果你打算下次再来，不妨预订我们的贵宾导览之一。

examples.en: Tell us something about the role as a scientific base.
examples.zh: 请跟我们说说它作为科研基地的作用。

examples.en: If staff are constantly changing, it can make life difficult for everyone.
examples.zh: 如果员工不断更换，会给每个人的生活带来困难。

examples.en: We hope it will help to bring about more sustainable fishing practices.
examples.zh: 我们希望这有助于推动更可持续的捕鱼做法。

examples.en: Finally, we have a position for a farm worker.
examples.zh: 最后，我们有一个农场工人的职位。

examples.en: The AU is a cosmic measuring rod, and the basis of how we scale the Universe today.
examples.zh: 天文单位是一把宇宙尺子，也是我们如今丈量宇宙的基础。

senses.zh: 旅行；他到欧洲旅行去了；我路上花了

examples.en: I've seen your advert for people to lead cycle trips.
examples.zh: 我看到了你们招募带领骑行游的人员的广告。

senses.zh: 文化；希腊文明；文化群体

examples.en: We had that lecture about culture and geography last week.
examples.zh: 我们上周上过那堂关于文化和地理的讲座。

examples.en: At certain times of the year, people come here from far and wide.
examples.zh: 每年的某些时候，人们会从四面八方来到这里。

examples.en: The picture is made more complicated by the fact that these crystals occur in batches.
examples.zh: 这些晶体成批出现，使情况变得更加复杂。

senses.zh: 日期；年份；黑斯廷斯战役的年份

examples.en: I'd like to bring you up to date with changes in the school that will affect your children.
examples.zh: 我想向你们通报学校里将影响你们孩子的最新变化。

examples.en: The content was very similar to what I'd studied before.
examples.zh: 内容与我以前学过的非常相似。

examples.en: The condition appears to result from the cumulative effect of a number of factors, with atmospheric pollutants the principal culprits.
examples.zh: 这种病症似乎是多种因素累积作用的结果，其中大气污染物是主要元凶。

examples.en: If you are a trade union member, you should call in the union.
examples.zh: 如果你是工会会员，应该联系工会。

examples.en: I got a little confused at first about which students the study was based on.
examples.zh: 起初我有点困惑，不清楚这项研究是以哪些学生为基础的。

examples.en: As early as the 1970s, geologists have been adding their voices to the debate over how Stonehenge came into being.
examples.zh: 早在20世纪70年代，地质学家就已加入关于巨石阵如何形成的辩论。

examples.en: As soon as the elephants began to flop onto the ground, the team moved in to take care of them.
examples.zh: 大象一开始瘫倒在地，团队就立刻上前照料它们。

examples.en: We have a local school coming along, and a lot of the teachers are taking part too.
examples.zh: 有一所本地学校要来参加，很多老师也会参与。

examples.en: I sincerely believe that all species, however small and seemingly insignificant, have a right to exist for their own sake.
examples.zh: 我真心认为，所有物种，无论多么渺小、看似微不足道，都有为自身而存在的权利。

examples.en: I suppose even second-hand shoes should look the same!
examples.zh: 我想就连二手鞋看起来也应该一模一样！

examples.en: Recently, however, concern's been growing that supplies may soon be insufficient for the world's needs.
examples.zh: 然而最近，人们越来越担心，供应可能很快就满足不了全世界的需求。

examples.en: There's a range of ticket prices depending on when you travel and when you buy your ticket.
examples.zh: 票价有多种，取决于你出行的时间和购票的时间。

examples.en: One key issue is the way in which information is dealt with.
examples.zh: 一个关键问题是信息的处理方式。

examples.en: By applying more scientific methods, ‘they’re going to go much faster’.
examples.zh: 通过采用更科学的方法，"他们的速度会快得多"。

examples.en: My parents had been saying that as I already had a job, I ought to support myself through college.
examples.zh: 我父母一直说，既然我已经有工作了，就应该自己负担上大学的费用。

senses.zh: 图书馆；图书馆的；馆藏品

examples.en: On CD-ROM in the library we have about fifty databases, including many statistical sources.
examples.zh: 图书馆的光盘里有大约五十个数据库，包括许多统计资料来源。

examples.en: We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California.
examples.zh: 我们有几条自驾游线路，游览加利福尼亚的不同景点。

examples.en: There's some great surfing there, which people don't always realise.
examples.zh: 那里有一些很棒的冲浪点，人们并不总是意识到这一点。

examples.en: You'll certainly learn more quickly and won't tire as easily.
examples.zh: 你肯定会学得更快，也不会那么容易疲倦。

examples.en: If no-one else has booked the computer out, then you may be able to have another hour if you want.
examples.zh: 如果没有别人预约那台电脑，你想的话也许可以再用一个小时。

examples.en: I started off as a waitress there a few years ago and I'm a manager now.
examples.zh: 几年前我在那里从服务员做起，现在是经理了。

examples.en: Insisting on excellence in everything we do is time-consuming, wastes energy and leads to losing out on opportunities.
examples.zh: 事事都坚持追求卓越既耗时、又浪费精力，还会让人错失机会。

examples.en: In the developing world, the price will depend on what deal aid organisations can negotiate.
examples.zh: 在发展中国家，价格将取决于援助组织能谈成什么样的协议。

examples.en: STEP only gets involved again once you've been made a job offer.
examples.zh: 只有在你收到录用通知之后，STEP才会再次介入。

examples.en: As pterosaurs got larger, they discovered the benefits of gliding on air currents, making use of a free energy source.
examples.zh: 随着翼龙体型变大，它们发现了借助气流滑翔的好处，从而利用上了免费的能源。

examples.en: My name's Greg, and I'll tell you about the various collections as we go round.
examples.zh: 我叫格雷格，我们参观时我会为你们介绍各个藏品系列。

examples.en: You need to think about the best place to sell your street food.
examples.zh: 你需要考虑在哪里卖你的街头小吃最合适。

examples.en: Few mortals could stick to that harsh a regimen, especially for years on end.
examples.zh: 很少有凡人能坚持如此严苛的养生法，尤其是长年累月。

examples.en: I'm not sure exactly, but they'll be quite small.
examples.zh: 我不太确定，但它们会相当小。

examples.en: 'The crusade was part of a larger effort to bring a better life to the people,' says Cleland.
examples.zh: "这场十字军东征是改善民众生活的一项更大努力的一部分，"克莱兰说。

examples.en: A few desperate weavers began breaking into factories and smashing textile machines.
examples.zh: 一些绝望的织工开始闯入工厂，砸毁纺织机器。

examples.en: A friend of a friend mentioned them - the children do painting and make models and so forth.
examples.zh: 朋友的朋友提到过他们——孩子们画画、做模型之类的。

examples.en: We hope to reopen the shop in the next few months.
examples.zh: 我们希望在未来几个月内重新开业。

examples.en: Foul air, rather than germs, was believed to be the main driver of 'hospital fever', leading to disease and frequent death.
examples.zh: 人们曾认为，导致"医院热"、引发疾病和频繁死亡的主要原因是污浊的空气，而非细菌。

examples.en: I asked my farmer how much he depended on the vet to deal with health problems.
examples.zh: 我问我的农场主，处理健康问题时他有多依赖兽医。

examples.en: What's more, your efforts to improve the situation can end up making you feel worse.
examples.zh: 更糟的是，你为改善状况所做的努力最终可能让你感觉更糟。

examples.en: Nobody I know would be able to identify my handwriting now.
examples.zh: 我认识的人现在都认不出我的笔迹了。

examples.en: The times are pretty flexible so we can arrange it to suit you.
examples.zh: 时间相当灵活，所以我们可以按你的情况来安排。

examples.en: When an individual demonstrates the behaviour the organisation expects, some kind of incentive can be given.
examples.zh: 当个人表现出组织所期望的行为时，可以给予某种激励。

examples.en: At a very basic level, adults can enrich the child's environment by providing objects or experiences that promote aspects of a curriculum.
examples.zh: 在最基本的层面上，成人可以通过提供有助于课程某些方面的物品或体验来丰富孩子的环境。

examples.en: I've heard lots of good things about the training at JPNW.
examples.zh: 我听说过很多关于JPNW培训的好评。

examples.en: The more recent paintings show people in static poses.
examples.zh: 较近期的画作展现的是姿态静止的人物。

examples.en: Many people are also simply not familiar with many instances of AI actually working, because it often happens in the background.
examples.zh: 许多人也只是不熟悉人工智能的许多实际应用，因为它往往在后台运行。

examples.en: There are some attractive views from the cottage, which I haven't mentioned.
examples.zh: 从小屋可以看到一些迷人的景色，我还没提到呢。

examples.en: I'd like to mention some features of the tour.
examples.zh: 我想介绍一下这次旅行的一些特色。

examples.en: For more than forty years the cost of food has been rising.
examples.zh: 四十多年来，食品价格一直在上涨。

examples.en: In fact, about thirty-five per cent of our members are children.
examples.zh: 事实上，我们大约百分之三十五的会员是儿童。

examples.en: I've gone as far back as the late seventeenth century, though I know there were earlier children's stories.
examples.zh: 我一直追溯到17世纪末，不过我知道更早之前就有儿童故事了。

examples.en: Next time I would make a shorter one and try to get the quality better.
examples.zh: 下次我会做一个短一点的，并设法提高质量。

examples.en: The bell-miner is a bird, and the disease seems to be common where there are high populations of bell-miners.
examples.zh: 钟吻蜜雀是一种鸟，这种疾病似乎在钟吻蜜雀数量众多的地方很常见。

examples.en: We need to start planning our paper on public libraries.
examples.zh: 我们需要开始规划关于公共图书馆的论文了。

examples.en: In fact, I don't have that sort of problem, but I'll bear it in mind.
examples.zh: 其实我没有那种问题,不过我会记在心里的。

examples.en: The technology raises the prospect of Britain becoming self-sufficient in renewable energy and drastically reducing its carbon dioxide emissions.
examples.zh: 这项技术使英国有望实现可再生能源自给自足，并大幅减少二氧化碳排放。

examples.en: Let me start by briefly explaining what we mean by volunteering.
examples.zh: 首先让我简要解释一下我们所说的志愿服务是什么意思。

examples.en: The travel and tourism industry is the world's largest employer with almost 130 million jobs, or almost 7 per cent of all employees.
examples.zh: 旅游业是全球最大的雇主，提供近1.3亿个工作岗位，占全部就业人数的近7%。

examples.en: Iconoclasts face alienation and failure, but can also be a major asset to any organization.
examples.zh: 离经叛道者会面临被孤立和失败，但也可能成为任何组织的重要财富。

examples.en: The time seems right for abandoning the naive notions of intelligent design and genius, and for scientifically exploring the true origins of creative behavior.
examples.zh: 现在似乎正是时候摒弃关于智能设计和天才的天真观念，用科学方法探索创造性行为的真正起源。

examples.en: The rockets cost around $1,200 each, can only be fired at a limited frequency and their failure rate is about 40 per cent.
examples.zh: 这些火箭每枚造价约1200美元，只能以有限的频率发射，而且故障率约为40%。

examples.en: The nature of the game is to run through possible moves in the mind to see how they play out.
examples.zh: 这个游戏的本质是在脑海中推演各种可能的走法，看看结果如何。

examples.en: Your ticket allows standard class travel on any train between 10am and midnight.
examples.zh: 你的车票可在上午10点至午夜之间乘坐任何列车的标准座。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks were the first to develop a more scientific approach to explaining the weather.
examples.zh: 古希腊人最先发展出更科学的方法来解释天气。

examples.en: After 25 years of exposure to the freezing temperatures of deep space, the probe was beginning to show its age.
examples.zh: 在深空的严寒环境中暴露25年后，这颗探测器开始显出老态。

examples.en: I also write answers to questions for the exam practice.
examples.zh: 我还会为备考练习写问题的答案。

examples.en: To collect as wide a range of species as possible, several methods must be used.
examples.zh: 要采集尽可能多种类的物种，必须使用多种方法。

examples.en: For one thing, there is no agreed international system for classifying soil.
examples.zh: 首先，目前还没有公认的国际土壤分类体系。

examples.en: I have a couple of simple tips I always give to new runners.
examples.zh: 我总会给新手跑者几条简单的建议。

examples.en: Finally, the conference established the framework for a European research network on forest ecosystems.
examples.zh: 最后，会议确立了欧洲森林生态系统研究网络的框架。

examples.en: The air pocket in the seed, created as the endosperm solidifies, protects the embryo.
examples.zh: 种子中的气室是胚乳凝固时形成的，它保护着胚胎。

examples.en: You can also join in as many classes as you like for free.
examples.zh: 你还可以免费参加任意多的课程。

examples.en: In the second part of the talk I'll be giving you a lot more details, but back to the basic information.
examples.zh: 在演讲的第二部分我会给你们更多细节，现在先回到基本信息。

examples.en: We recently started a programme of workshops that anyone can join.
examples.zh: 我们最近启动了一个人人都可参加的工作坊项目。

examples.en: The volunteers then send a summary to the editors.
examples.zh: 然后，志愿者将摘要发送给编辑。

examples.en: The huge rise in online shopping has meant that another form of urban traffic just keeps on growing and that's deliveries.
examples.zh: 网购的大幅增长意味着另一种城市交通——送货——持续增长。

examples.en: If you like fish, it's probably the best restaurant in town for that.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢吃鱼，这大概是全城这方面最好的餐厅。

examples.en: Once over the age of three, children continue to expand on existing knowledge of the world.
examples.zh: 孩子一过三岁，会继续拓展对世界已有的认识。

examples.en: The problem starts when glass contains nickel sulphide impurities.
examples.zh: 当玻璃含有硫化镍杂质时，问题就开始了。

examples.en: 'We found that moms do exactly what you'd expect and what's been described many times over,' VanDam explains.
examples.zh: "我们发现，母亲们的做法正如你所料，也正如多次描述过的那样，"范达姆解释说。

examples.en: There was already a strong culture of cycling here.
examples.zh: 这里早已有浓厚的骑行文化。

examples.en: Throughout the course of history, people have travelled for purposes of trade, religious conviction, economic gain, war, migration and other equally compelling motivations.
examples.zh: 纵观历史，人们出行的目的包括贸易、宗教信仰、经济利益、战争、迁徙及其他同样迫切的动机。

examples.en: The shop may want to send the shoes back to head office for inspection.
examples.zh: 商店可能想把这双鞋寄回总部检验。

examples.en: Erosion is of course bad for people trying to grow crops or breed animals on that terrain.
examples.zh: 对于想在那片地形上种庄稼或养牲畜的人来说，侵蚀当然是有害的。

examples.en: Of a town of 28,000, only two people survived.
examples.zh: 在一个2.8万人的城镇里，只有两个人幸存。

examples.en: Snacks and drinks are also provided - so we've decided to introduce a no packed lunch policy.
examples.zh: 我们还提供点心和饮料，所以我们决定推行不得自带午餐的政策。

examples.en: Theoretically, in the world of trade, shipping costs do not matter.
examples.zh: 理论上，在贸易世界里，运输成本无关紧要。

examples.en: We're very happy to welcome you to your new apprenticeship.
examples.zh: 我们很高兴欢迎你开始新的学徒生涯。

examples.en: We run activities for children and students, such as the museum club, for which there's no charge.
examples.zh: 我们为儿童和学生举办活动，比如博物馆俱乐部，不收费。

examples.en: Machines will be free of many of the physical constraints on human intelligence.
examples.zh: 机器将不受人类智力诸多生理限制的束缚。

examples.en: In terms of technology, the computer industry will be able to shrink computer parts down to minute sizes.
examples.zh: 在技术方面，计算机行业将能把计算机部件缩小到微小的尺寸。

examples.en: We may need to bring the dog if I can't get anyone to look after him.
examples.zh: 如果我找不到人照看它，可能需要把狗带上。

examples.en: The hotel itself where you stay has great facilities.
examples.zh: 你们住的酒店本身设施很好。

examples.en: Ensure that each reply is dealt with quickly and professionally.
examples.zh: 确保每一份回复都得到迅速而专业的处理。

examples.en: As you can see, I'm very excited by the implications that could be available to us in the next few decades.
examples.zh: 如你所见，对于未来几十年可能给我们带来的影响，我感到非常兴奋。

examples.en: You have plenty of time to get into shape.
examples.zh: 你有足够的时间恢复状态。

examples.en: Ichthyosaurs were reptilian contemporaries of the dinosaurs, with fins and streamlined bodies.
examples.zh: 鱼龙是与恐龙同时代的爬行动物，有鳍和流线型的身体。

examples.en: At present, the average car spends more than 90 percent of its life parked.
examples.zh: 目前，普通汽车一生中有超过90%的时间都停放着。

examples.en: The public can also be encouraged to buy things which are more sustainably produced.
examples.zh: 也可以鼓励公众购买更可持续生产的商品。

senses.zh: 科学的；符合科学方法的

examples.en: Other parapsychologists believe the field is on the brink of collapse, having tried to produce definitive scientific proof and failed.
examples.zh: 其他超心理学家认为，该领域在试图拿出确凿的科学证据却失败之后，已濒临崩溃。

examples.en: Tourism today has grown significantly in both economic and social importance.
examples.zh: 如今旅游业在经济和社会方面的重要性都显著提升。

examples.en: Activity holidays usually involve rather less high-risk sports, or things like art and music.
examples.zh: 探险假期通常涉及的高风险运动较少，更多是艺术和音乐之类的活动。

examples.en: I think you'll be surprised at the variety we have here, even though we're not far from London.
examples.zh: 我想你会对我们这里种类之多感到惊讶，尽管我们离伦敦不远。

examples.en: There was no one who could run faster than me.
examples.zh: 没有人能跑得比我快。

examples.en: There's a big demand for houses in that area, so prices tend to be quite high.
examples.zh: 那个地区对房屋需求很大，所以价格往往相当高。

examples.en: Rents range from £58.50 to £68.50 for a single en-suite room or larger en-suite room respectively.
examples.zh: 单人套间或较大套间的租金分别为58.50英镑至68.50英镑。

examples.en: We aim to get the copying done in ten days.
examples.zh: 我们力争在十天内完成复印。

examples.en: Let's turn our attention now to the farming technology available at that time.
examples.zh: 现在让我们把注意力转向当时可用的农业技术。

examples.en: There were, however, a couple of problems with the system.
examples.zh: 不过，这个系统有几个问题。

examples.en: In the past, such children were considered to be at a disadvantage compared with their monolingual peers.
examples.zh: 过去，这类孩子被认为与只会一种语言的同龄人相比处于劣势。

examples.en: One thing I'd say is to make time to sit down with your child and share books with them.
examples.zh: 我想说的一点是，要抽时间坐下来和孩子一起读书。

examples.en: The shortest journey is 206 km and the longest is 632 kilometres.
examples.zh: 最短的行程是206公里，最长的是632公里。

examples.en: Scientists believe that a majority of the earth's bird population migrate in some fashion or other.
examples.zh: 科学家认为，地球上大多数鸟类都会以某种方式迁徙。

examples.en: Employers are legally required to provide well-maintained personal protective equipment or PPE.
examples.zh: 法律要求雇主提供维护良好的个人防护装备，即PPE。

examples.en: The farming methods of ants are at least sustainable.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁的耕作方式至少是可持续的。

examples.en: The damage starts when logging companies arrive to clear the trees.
examples.zh: 当伐木公司来砍伐树木时，破坏就开始了。

examples.en: There were several reasons why original science continued to be written in Latin.
examples.zh: 原创科学著作继续用拉丁语写作有好几个原因。

examples.en: One thing you can do to help yourself is to set manageable goals - be realistic and don't push yourself too far.
examples.zh: 你可以帮自己的一件事是设定可行的目标——要现实，不要把自己逼得太紧。

examples.en: We believe our holidays offer superb facilities for the whole family.
examples.zh: 我们相信我们的假期能为全家人提供一流的设施。

examples.en: Of course, for many places it's a difficult balance to achieve.
examples.zh: 当然，对许多地方来说，这是一种很难达成的平衡。

examples.en: The field is called space traffic management, because it's similar to managing traffic on the roads or in the air.
examples.zh: 这一领域被称为空间交通管理，因为它类似于管理道路或空中的交通。

examples.en: The line was not without its problems, mainly caused by an unreliable power supply.
examples.zh: 这条线路并非没有问题，主要是由不稳定的电力供应造成的。

examples.en: We've been discussing what to do here and we've decided to plant a poplar tree in the museum gardens.
examples.zh: 我们一直在讨论在这里做点什么，最后决定在博物馆花园里种一棵杨树。

examples.en: Sugars and meats or oils will attract different species and a range should be utilised.
examples.zh: 糖类、肉类或油类会吸引不同的物种，因此应使用多种诱饵。

examples.en: In many countries deregulation has helped to drive the process along.
examples.zh: 在许多国家，放松管制推动了这一进程。

examples.en: The poor turned to water and gin and in the 1720s the mortality rate began to rise again.
examples.zh: 穷人转而喝水和杜松子酒，18世纪20年代死亡率又开始上升。

examples.en: Cutting down native woodland leads to erosion, as there is nothing to keep the soil in place.
examples.zh: 砍伐原生林地会导致侵蚀，因为没有东西固住土壤。

examples.en: Automation means that initiatives for car-sharing become much more viable, particularly in urban areas with significant travel demand.
examples.zh: 自动化意味着拼车计划变得更加可行，尤其是在出行需求量大的城市地区。

examples.en: At this time of year it's usually around $300 but let me check.
examples.zh: 这个时节通常大约是300美元，不过让我查一下。

examples.en: Odours affect us on a physical, psychological and social level.
examples.zh: 气味在生理、心理和社交层面上都会影响我们。

examples.en: There are at least four reasons people's conceptions of intelligence matter.
examples.zh: 人们对智力的看法之所以重要，至少有四个原因。

examples.en: I don't think there are huge differences in the market there.
examples.zh: 我不认为那里的市场有很大差异。

examples.en: Knowing what happens when people initially encounter misinformation holds tremendous importance for estimating the potential for subsequent problems.
examples.zh: 了解人们最初接触错误信息时会发生什么，对于评估后续问题的可能性极为重要。

examples.en: As you hike through the dense woods in the valley bottom, the only things you'll hear are the sound of your own footsteps.
examples.zh: 当你徒步穿过谷底茂密的树林时，你唯一能听到的就是自己的脚步声。

examples.en: Some items were damaged during the move so I need to make a claim.
examples.zh: 有些物品在搬家时损坏了，所以我需要提出索赔。

examples.en: There are plenty of seats where parents can relax and keep an eye on their children at the same time.
examples.zh: 有很多座位，家长可以在休息的同时照看孩子。

examples.en: There are also ways of working with individual pupils, or in small groups.
examples.zh: 也有针对个别学生或小组的教学方式。

examples.en: Particular varieties of cane sugar and beet sugar spread very rapidly across the world, in accordance with local needs and demands.
examples.zh: 特定品种的甘蔗糖和甜菜糖根据各地的需求和需要迅速传遍了世界。

examples.en: Volunteers are teenagers and adults who choose to spend some time, unpaid, helping other people in some way.
examples.zh: 志愿者是选择抽出一些时间、无偿以某种方式帮助他人的青少年和成年人。

examples.en: Many societies are much more fluid and democratic, and the structure of companies is changing to reflect that.
examples.zh: 许多社会要灵活、民主得多，公司的结构也在随之改变。

examples.en: The caloric-restricted animals also look better on indicators of risk for age-related diseases.

examples.zh: 在我的演讲中，我将谈谈咖啡及其在经济和社会层面的重要性。

examples.en: An impairment of episodic memory can have a profound effect on individuals' lives.
examples.zh: 情景记忆受损会对个人生活产生深远影响。

examples.en: When the islanders cleared the forests for firewood and farming, the forests didn't grow back.
examples.zh: 岛民为了取柴和耕种而砍光森林后，森林再也没有长回来。

examples.en: In 1933, he became a member of a group of young artists called Unit One.
examples.zh: 1933年，他成为一个名为“第一单元”的青年艺术家团体的成员。

examples.en: Stories about the problems of tourism have become legion in the last few years.
examples.zh: 近几年来，关于旅游业问题的报道不胜枚举。

examples.en: The UN estimates that there will be 9.8 billion people living on the planet by mid-century.
examples.zh: 联合国估计，到本世纪中叶，地球上将有98亿人口。

examples.en: Like nearly everyone who comes here, I'm sure this is the first time you will have tried the art.
examples.zh: 和几乎所有来这里的人一样，我想这是你第一次尝试这门艺术。

examples.en: The technique could not only improve existing crops, but could also be used to turn thousands of wild plants into useful and appealing foods.
examples.zh: 这项技术不仅能改良现有作物，还能把成千上万种野生植物变成有用且诱人的食物。

examples.en: There are striking differences in life span between different species, but within one species the parameter is relatively constant.
examples.zh: 不同物种的寿命差异显著，但同一物种内这一参数相对恒定。

examples.en: Of course the ideal is to prevent it arising in the first place.
examples.zh: 当然，最理想的是从一开始就防止它出现。

examples.en: The type of rock could also influence construction times.
examples.zh: 岩石类型也可能影响施工时间。

examples.en: In the end, it comes down to whether more value is placed on human economic wellbeing or environmental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 归根结底，问题在于人们更看重人类的经济福祉，还是环境福祉。

examples.en: You do need to learn the rules and learn them fast.
examples.zh: 你确实需要学规则，而且要学得快。

examples.en: Analysis revealed that, as expected, high-status individuals produced more dominant laughs and fewer submissive laughs relative to the low-status individuals.
examples.zh: 分析显示，正如预期，与地位低的人相比，地位高的人发出更多支配性笑声，更少顺从性笑声。

examples.en: I know some students found it a lot harder to choose, and wasted a lot of time.
examples.zh: 我知道有些学生觉得选择困难得多，浪费了很多时间。

examples.en: The physical impact of visitors is another serious problem associated with the growth in adventure tourism.
examples.zh: 游客对环境造成的实际影响是与探险旅游增长相关的另一个严重问题。

examples.en: I must go and have a look inside the hall.
examples.zh: 我得去看看大厅里面。

examples.en: I've heard the pay isn't too bad - better than working in a shop or a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我听说薪水还不错——比在商店或餐馆工作要好。

examples.en: India's lions are particularly vulnerable because they have a limited gene pool.
examples.zh: 印度的狮子尤其脆弱，因为它们的基因库有限。

examples.en: Clients start the course with a consultation with a trainer, and together they draw up an individual programme.
examples.zh: 学员课程开始时先与教练面谈，然后一起制定个人计划。

examples.en: In a safe environment, however, it would have been wasteful to be on high alert constantly.
examples.zh: 然而，在安全的环境中，时刻保持高度警惕会是一种浪费。

examples.en: In cases like this, language co-activation occurs because what the listener hears could map onto words in either language.
examples.zh: 在这类情况下会出现语言共激活，因为听者听到的内容可能对应任一种语言中的词。

examples.en: The boiler has gone from there now, but there are lines of tin baths on the stone floor.
examples.zh: 锅炉现在已经不在那儿了，但石头地面上还排着一排排锡制浴盆。

examples.en: The research stations are really self-contained communities of about twenty people.
examples.zh: 这些科考站其实是约二十人组成的自给自足的小社区。

examples.en: We need the additional time because there are a few extra things to do.
examples.zh: 我们需要额外的时间，因为还有几件额外的事情要做。

examples.en: Doctors are increasingly prescribing time spent gardening outdoors for patients dealing with anxiety and depression.
examples.zh: 医生越来越多地开出户外园艺的“处方”，帮助焦虑症和抑郁症患者。

examples.en: If you are offered a credit note, you don't have to accept it.
examples.zh: 如果对方给你的是代金券，你不必接受。

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项

examples.en: A more imminent change concerns the catering facilities and the canteen.
examples.zh: 一项更迫在眉睫的变化涉及餐饮设施和食堂。

examples.en: In another piece of research, a team observed and talked to nurses working in hospitals.
examples.zh: 在另一项研究中，一个团队观察了医院护士并与之交谈。

examples.en: I've left you a local map, so you'll be able to find your way around easily.
examples.zh: 我给你留了一张本地地图，你能轻松找到路。

examples.en: Ever since then it has proved to be a great success.
examples.zh: 从那以后，事实证明它非常成功。

examples.en: Some growers have already started using an approach known as regenerative agriculture.
examples.zh: 一些种植者已开始采用一种称为再生农业的方法。

examples.en: Pterosaurs stand out as one of nature's great success stories.
examples.zh: 翼龙作为自然界最伟大的成功故事之一而格外突出。

examples.en: Roman tunnel projects were carefully planned and carried out.
examples.zh: 罗马人的隧道工程经过精心规划和实施。

examples.en: Not really - there's no underground, but there are trams and a good bus network.
examples.zh: 不一定——没有地铁，但有有轨电车和不错的公交网络。

examples.en: I think there are some in the interview with the recycling manager.
examples.zh: 我想采访回收经理的内容里有一些相关信息。

examples.en: Teachers say that they give individual help at the end of a lesson or after school, setting extra work if necessary.
examples.zh: 老师说，他们会在课后或放学后给予个别辅导，必要时还会布置额外作业。

examples.en: There's been a decline in some varieties of wild mushrooms in this part of the country.
examples.zh: 该国这一地区的某些野生蘑菇品种数量有所减少。

examples.en: To ensure the highest quality, inspection takes place at every stage.
examples.zh: 为确保最高质量，每个环节都要检验。

examples.en: I've always been taught to handle books carefully.
examples.zh: 我从小就被教导要小心对待书籍。

examples.en: Nobody knows what has happened to the rest of the book, but perhaps the other sketches still exist somewhere.
examples.zh: 没人知道书的其余部分怎么样了，但也许其他草图仍存在于某处。

examples.en: A small change, perhaps, but its importance should not be underestimated.
examples.zh: 这也许是个小变化，但其重要性不应低估。

examples.en: There are usually a range of habitats where mushrooms grow, such as playing fields and wooded areas.
examples.zh: 蘑菇通常生长在多种栖息地，如运动场和林地。

examples.en: Elderly people are growing healthier, happier and more independent, say American scientists.
examples.zh: 美国科学家说，老年人正变得更健康、更快乐、更独立。

examples.en: There was so much pressure to meet the project deadline.
examples.zh: 完成项目的最后期限带来了巨大的压力。

examples.en: There are one or two tricky sections, but nothing too challenging.
examples.zh: 有一两段路比较难走，但不算太有挑战。

examples.en: The trunk is surmounted by a rosette of leaves, each of which may be up to six metres long.
examples.zh: 树干顶端是一簇莲座状的叶子，每片叶子可长达六米。

examples.en: I can't see any advantage in having it there because the one in town is actually bigger.
examples.zh: 我看不出放在那儿有什么好处，因为城里的那个其实更大。

examples.en: Microplastics can enter the environment via a number of different sources.
examples.zh: 微塑料可通过多种不同来源进入环境。

examples.en: In order to track temporal hours during the day, inventors created sundials, which indicate time by the length or direction of the sun's shadow.
examples.zh: 为了追踪白天的时辰，发明家们创造了日晷，它通过太阳影子的长度或方向来指示时间。

examples.en: Once regarded as a luxury, sugar came to be promoted as a valuable source of energy.
examples.zh: 糖曾被视为奢侈品，后来被宣传为宝贵的能量来源。

examples.en: My cousins are coming to stay for a couple of days, and I have to cook for them.
examples.zh: 我的表兄弟姐妹要来住几天，我得给他们做饭。

examples.en: At first glance, spending resources to incorporate elements of a seemingly irrelevant trend into one's core offerings sounds like it's hardly worthwhile.
examples.zh: 乍一看，花资源把一个看似无关的潮流元素融入核心产品，似乎不太值得。

examples.en: Harnessing the wind would not have been a problem for accomplished sailors like the Egyptians.
examples.zh: 对埃及人这样经验丰富的水手来说，利用风力不成问题。

examples.en: Home visits allow staff the opportunity to know where the participants live, and to understand more about each individual’s situation.
examples.zh: 上门走访让工作人员有机会了解参与者的居住环境，并更深入地了解每个人的具体情况。

examples.en: I think he sailed there in a boat made out of reeds.
examples.zh: 我想他是乘着芦苇编成的船去那里的。

examples.en: The council have provided special signs but there's always a volunteer there to explain what's happening to any motorists.
examples.zh: 市政委员会设置了专门的标识，但总有志愿者在那儿向司机解释情况。

examples.en: Yes, I've led several bike tours in Africa.
examples.zh: 是的，我在非洲带过好几次自行车旅行团。

examples.en: We need to give the driver an address.
examples.zh: 我们需要给司机一个地址。

examples.en: Our latest addition is child-sized tractors, that you can drive around the grounds.
examples.zh: 我们最新增加的是儿童尺寸的拖拉机，你可以开着它在场地里转。

examples.en: I think it will change people's behaviour and stop mothers, in particular, buying the wrong things.
examples.zh: 我认为这会改变人们的行为，尤其会阻止母亲们买错东西。

examples.en: I've heard you need to be pretty fit.
examples.zh: 我听说你得相当健壮才行。

examples.en: On the 19th and 20th a local amateur group are performing one written by a member of the group.
examples.zh: 19日和20日，一个本地业余剧团将演出一部由团员创作的剧目。

examples.en: Our findings don't mean you're doomed if you're poor.
examples.zh: 我们的研究结果并不意味着贫穷就注定失败。

examples.en: Trains and cars initially allowed people to live at greater distances without taking longer to reach their destination.
examples.zh: 火车和汽车最初让人们可以住得更远，而不用花更长时间到达目的地。

examples.en: There are many reasons why technology is advancing so fast.
examples.zh: 科技发展如此之快有很多原因。

examples.en: The invention of agriculture some 10,000 years ago disrupted these ancient soil-building processes and led to the loss of carbon from the soil.
examples.zh: 约一万年前农业的发明破坏了这些古老的土壤形成过程，导致土壤中碳的流失。

examples.en: When Henderson died in 1913, his huge collection of glass negatives was stored in the basement of his house.
examples.zh: 1913年亨德森去世时，他数量庞大的玻璃底片收藏被存放在他家的地下室里。

examples.en: Exempt employees receive no additional compensation for overtime hours.
examples.zh: 免加班费的员工加班没有额外补偿。

examples.en: You will be visiting centres in the region to ensure their high levels of customer service are maintained.
examples.zh: 你将走访该地区的各个中心，确保它们保持高水平的客户服务。

examples.en: Wood energy markets can accept less expensive wood material of lower quality than would be suitable for traditional timber markets.
examples.zh: 能源用木材市场可以接受比传统木材市场更便宜、质量更低的木料。

examples.en: In all cases, someone has to act as a source of language data — an informant.
examples.zh: 在所有情况下，都得有人充当语言数据的来源——即信息提供者。

examples.en: I think you can put that down to lack of practice.
examples.zh: 我想你可以把这归因于缺乏练习。

examples.en: There is no point in encouraging potential customers to contact you if your service is slow or non-existent.
examples.zh: 如果你的服务缓慢或根本没有，鼓励潜在客户联系你就毫无意义。

examples.en: As the wheel rotates, the gondolas are kept in the upright position by a simple gearing system.
examples.zh: 随着摩天轮转动，简单的齿轮系统使吊舱始终保持直立。

examples.en: Until recently, most scientists would not have put pterosaurs in the same class as birds in terms of flying ability.
examples.zh: 直到最近，大多数科学家还不会把翼龙在飞行能力上与鸟类归为一类。

examples.en: On our local craft tour you can find out about the traditional activities in the island.
examples.zh: 参加我们的本地手工艺之旅，你可以了解岛上的传统活动。

examples.en: My mind just goes blank when I read anything about chemicals.
examples.zh: 一读到化学品方面的东西，我脑子就一片空白。

examples.en: Other actions can be taken to back up the policy.
examples.zh: 还可以采取其他行动来支持这项政策。

examples.en: I think food manufacturers could do more to encourage healthy eating.
examples.zh: 我认为食品制造商可以多做些工作来鼓励健康饮食。

examples.en: In short, a threat state makes people more anxious - they make worse decisions and perform more poorly.
examples.zh: 简言之，威胁状态会让人更焦虑——他们的决策更糟，表现也更差。

examples.en: Last year, we discovered a fish pond in the ancient village.
examples.zh: 去年，我们在这个古村落发现了一个鱼塘。

examples.en: Biking is not allowed and it's impossible to drive around the area in private vehicles.
examples.zh: 这里禁止骑自行车，也无法驾驶私家车游览该区域。

examples.en: Float glass is sold by the square metre, and at the final stage computers translate customer requirements into patterns of cuts designed to minimise waste.
examples.zh: 浮法玻璃按平方米出售，在最后阶段，计算机会把客户需求转化为切割方案，以尽量减少浪费。

examples.en: There's a small charge, which you should pay when you turn up.
examples.zh: 需要付一小笔费用，到场时支付即可。

examples.en: There's a new area of wooden sculptures, which are on the river bank, where the path from the east gate makes a sharp bend.
examples.zh: 河岸上新增了一片木雕区，就在东门小路急转弯的地方。

examples.en: Clearly, certain diseases are beating a retreat in the face of medical advances.
examples.zh: 显然，某些疾病在医学进步面前正节节败退。

examples.en: The fireflies' almost magical light has attracted human attention for generations.
examples.zh: 萤火虫近乎神奇的光芒世世代代吸引着人们的目光。

examples.en: The evidence indicates that guard dogs are highly effective.
examples.zh: 证据表明，护卫犬非常有效。

examples.en: Just search online for the festival website, and you'll find it.
examples.zh: 在网上搜一下音乐节的网站就能找到。

examples.en: The two we used to have were very small and slow.
examples.zh: 我们以前有的那两个又小又慢。

examples.en: There is evidence that winter ice was stored to preserve food in the summer as far back as 10,000 years ago.
examples.zh: 有证据表明，早在一万年前人们就开始储存冬天的冰，用来在夏天保存食物。

examples.en: The railway remains the central feature and there's now 1.2 kilometres of the line laid but we'd like to lay more.
examples.zh: 铁路仍是核心景观，现已铺设了1.2公里线路，但我们想铺得更多。

examples.en: Other inventions - the wheel, agriculture, sliced bread - may have transformed our material existence, but the advent of language is what made us human.
examples.zh: 其他发明——轮子、农业、切片面包——也许改变了我们的物质生活，但语言的出现才让我们成为人类。

examples.en: In recent years, however, as increased efforts have been made to protect wild animals, predators have become more widespread again.
examples.zh: 然而近年来，随着保护野生动物的力度加大，捕食动物的分布再度扩大。

examples.en: The results tell us a lot more about how the bridge was built.
examples.zh: 这些结果让我们对这座桥的建造方式了解得多得多。

examples.en: I saw your group's performance last night at the student theatre.
examples.zh: 我昨晚在学生剧院看了你们小组的演出。

examples.en: Large deviations could happen, and they could result in one end of the tunnel not being usable.
examples.zh: 可能出现很大的偏差，导致隧道一端无法使用。

examples.en: Eastwood's team is now trying to explore why the attention system fails.
examples.zh: 伊斯特伍德的团队目前正试图探究注意力系统为何会失灵。

examples.en: Obviously, it's worth going there just for the view, but the food is supposed to be really special.
examples.zh: 显然，光是为了景色就值得去，而且那里的食物据说也很特别。

examples.en: In such cases the human resources department often gets involved.
examples.zh: 这种情况下，人力资源部门往往会介入。

examples.en: I'd like to start with some general advice about being an apprentice.
examples.zh: 我想先给大家一些关于当学徒的一般性建议。

examples.en: As the speed of the new locomotives increased, it was essential to have a fast and effective means of avoiding collisions.
examples.zh: 随着新型机车速度提高，必须有一种快速有效的避免碰撞的手段。

examples.en: I wonder if you could let us know what your interests are.
examples.zh: 不知你能否告诉我们你的兴趣是什么。

examples.en: The growing unpredictability of weather patterns increases farmers' difficulty in managing weather-related risks.
examples.zh: 天气模式日益难以预测，增加了农民管理气象风险的难度。

examples.en: Caught in a trap, a slow merchant ship laden with goods had no other option but to surrender.
examples.zh: 满载货物的慢速商船落入陷阱，别无选择，只能投降。

examples.en: Unfortunately, attempts like these usually turn out to be misguided and lead to problems.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，这类尝试往往被证明是误入歧途，并引发问题。

examples.en: Prior to Djoser's reign, tombs were rectangular monuments made of dried clay brick, which covered underground passages where the deceased person was buried.
examples.zh: 在左塞尔统治之前，陵墓是用晾干的泥砖砌成的长方形建筑，覆盖着埋葬逝者的地下通道。

examples.en: For the installation of hard-wired smoke alarms, powered from the mains electricity supply, however, you will need the services of a licensed professional.
examples.zh: 不过，安装由市电供电的硬接线烟雾报警器，需要请持证专业人员。

examples.en: There was an experiment some students did here last term to see at what age kids should stop having naps.
examples.zh: 上学期这里有些学生做过一项实验，看孩子到几岁就不该再午睡了。

examples.en: You can just have evening meal provided, which is half board.
examples.zh: 你可以只订晚餐，也就是半食宿。

examples.en: For a one-bedroom flat we're probably looking at about two hours for a clean.
examples.zh: 一居室的公寓，打扫大概要两个小时。

examples.en: One thing is already clear, she says: the relationship between education and economic growth is far from straightforward.
examples.zh: 她说，有一点已经很清楚：教育与经济增长之间的关系绝非简单直接。

collocations: the relationship between A and B

examples.en: I'll just go to the office and pick one up.
examples.zh: 我去办公室拿一份就行。

examples.en: The most bizarre case was a telephone interview I did with a teacher at a university in France.
examples.zh: 最离奇的一次是我对法国一所大学的老师做的电话采访。

examples.en: If you're pretty serious about cycling, there's the Full membership.
examples.zh: 如果你对骑行相当认真，可以选择全额会员。

examples.en: I'll look forward to seeing a big improvement, then.
examples.zh: 那我期待看到很大的进步。

examples.en: Over the years, attitudes towards workers have changed considerably.
examples.zh: 多年来，人们对工人的态度发生了很大变化。

examples.en: People fear they may be the next to be made redundant.
examples.zh: 人们担心自己可能是下一个被裁掉的人。

examples.en: Some scientists recommend that nano-particles be treated as new chemicals with separate safety tests and clear labelling.
examples.zh: 一些科学家建议把纳米颗粒视为新化学品，进行单独的安全测试并贴上明确标签。

examples.en: Up to 499 students live in 6, 7 and 8 bedroom flats, all with en-suite shower rooms.
examples.zh: 多达499名学生住在六、七、八居室的公寓里，每套都带独立卫浴。

examples.en: Bikes are provided and there are different routes according to people's ability.
examples.zh: 我们提供自行车，并根据不同能力设有不同路线。

examples.en: The iPad is the new pacifier for babies and toddlers.
examples.zh: iPad成了婴幼儿的新型安抚奶嘴。

senses.zh: 不破坏环境的；可持续的

examples.en: Hemp is another really good sustainable fabric from a natural source.
examples.zh: 大麻纤维是另一种来自天然材料的优质可持续面料。

examples.en: I gave up reading after the first chapter - I just couldn't follow it.
examples.zh: 读完第一章我就放弃了——实在看不懂。

examples.en: If the bark is stripped on a day when it's too cold - or when the air is damp - the tree will be damaged.
examples.zh: 如果在太冷或空气潮湿的日子剥树皮，树会受损。

examples.en: The aim is to make children aware of how both the town and people's lives have changed over the centuries.
examples.zh: 目的是让孩子们了解这座城镇和人们的生活在几个世纪里发生了怎样的变化。

examples.en: The owners of Chip Chop had found a perfect venue near a beach where there weren't any other street food trucks.

examples.zh: 到目前为止，我们主要关注教育和培训方面的项目。

examples.zh: 更具体地说，他关注蝙蝠如何应对人类活动，尤其是森林砍伐。

examples.en: Thousands of acres of grassland have been built upon and glow-worm sites have become increasingly isolated from each other.
examples.zh: 成千上万英亩的草地被开发建设，萤火虫栖息地彼此日益孤立。

examples.en: We obviously need to look at the impact of new technology, particularly the internet.
examples.zh: 我们显然需要研究新技术，尤其是互联网的影响。

examples.zh: 然而从长远看，拖延并不是管理情绪的有效方式。

examples.en: There's a famous stone bridge - it's one of the oldest in the region, and you can see it from the living room.
examples.zh: 有一座著名的石桥——它是该地区最古老的桥之一，在客厅就能看到。

examples.en: Give yourself a really nice treat every time you reach one of your goals.
examples.zh: 每达成一个目标，就好好犒劳一下自己。

examples.en: Having to deal with this persistent linguistic competition can result in difficulties, however.
examples.zh: 不过，应对这种持续的语言竞争可能会带来困难。

examples.en: The physical act of writing helps children to remember letters.
examples.zh: 书写这一身体动作有助于孩子记住字母。

examples.en: If you're a complete beginner, I wouldn't recommend going alone or relying on photos in a book, even the one I've written!
examples.zh: 如果你是纯新手，我不建议单独去，也不建议只靠书里的照片，哪怕是我写的那本！

examples.en: The wall of the fruit has three layers: a waterproof outer layer, a fibrous middle layer and a hard, inner layer.
examples.zh: 果实的壁有三层：防水的外层、纤维状的中层和坚硬的内层。

examples.en: At the same time, our understanding of its importance to humans has grown.
examples.zh: 与此同时，我们对其对人类重要性的认识也在加深。

examples.en: I suppose another approach to this problem is to get people to exercise more.
examples.zh: 我想解决这个问题的另一种方法是让人们多锻炼。

examples.en: If you've got a strong cardboard box, that's best.
examples.zh: 如果你有结实的纸板箱，那最好。

examples.en: Recently there's been a greater awareness that there are large quantities of plastic waste - big and small - in the environment.
examples.zh: 最近人们越来越意识到，环境中存在大量大大小小的塑料垃圾。

examples.en: Our hospital closed 15 years ago, which means journeys to other towns are unavoidable.
examples.zh: 我们的医院15年前关闭了，这意味着去其他城镇就医不可避免。

examples.en: For a few days people can pretend they are free of responsibilities and can indulge themselves.
examples.zh: 有那么几天，人们可以假装摆脱了责任，尽情放纵自己。

examples.en: Our noses are able to recognise thousands of smells, and to perceive odours which are present only in extremely small quantities.
examples.zh: 我们的鼻子能识别成千上万种气味，并能察觉极微量的气味。

examples.en: I've just read an article suggesting why we tend to forget most of our dreams soon after we wake up.
examples.zh: 我刚读了一篇文章，解释了我们为什么醒来不久就会忘掉大部分梦。

examples.en: The grain itself was destroyed by the firing, but it left an impression on the pot which could be studied and identified by botanists.
examples.zh: 谷物本身在烧制中被毁，但在陶器上留下了印痕，植物学家可以据此研究和鉴定。

examples.en: We can organise a wide range of activities and adapt them to suit all ages.
examples.zh: 我们可以组织各种活动，并加以调整以适合各个年龄段。

examples.en: There isn't any ballet, I'm afraid, but there'll be a demonstration of traditional dances from all round the country.
examples.zh: 恐怕没有芭蕾，但会有全国各地传统舞蹈的展示。

examples.en: A thinly scattered permanent population and development of leisure activities, particularly skiing, have resulted in significant long-term changes to the local ecosystems.
examples.zh: 稀疏分散的常住人口和休闲活动的发展，尤其是滑雪，已使当地生态系统发生了重大的长期变化。

examples.en: One 2015 study found that even a gentle dance workout helps to promote a healthy heart.
examples.zh: 2015年的一项研究发现，即使是轻柔的舞蹈锻炼也有助于促进心脏健康。

examples.en: Finding better ways of managing our emotions is one route out of the vicious cycle of procrastination.
examples.zh: 找到更好的情绪管理方法，是走出拖延恶性循环的途径之一。

examples.en: There are many training programmes available online which aim to help people build up to running 5 kilometres.
examples.zh: 网上有很多训练项目，旨在帮助人们逐步做到跑5公里。

examples.en: The archaeologist has to develop a picture of the past, just as the scientist has to develop a coherent view of the natural world.
examples.zh: 考古学家必须勾勒出过去的图景，正如科学家必须形成对自然世界的连贯认识。

examples.en: The history of today's plastics begins with the discovery of a series of semi-synthetic thermoplastic materials in the mid-nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 当今塑料的历史始于19世纪中叶一系列半合成热塑性材料的发现。

examples.en: I'm losing touch with my friends and colleagues.
examples.zh: 我正在和朋友、同事失去联系。

examples.en: The original house was replaced in the late seventeenth century, and of course it has had a large number of owners.
examples.zh: 原来的房子在17世纪后期被取代，当然它也经历了许多任主人。

examples.en: The kitchen gardens are rectangular and surrounded by a wall.
examples.zh: 菜园是长方形的，四周有围墙。

examples.en: In one company, IT systems administrators were observed for several weeks.
examples.zh: 在一家公司里，IT系统管理员被观察了几周。

examples.en: There are some less obvious benefits of dance for older people too.
examples.zh: 舞蹈对老年人还有一些不那么明显的益处。

examples.en: I'd like to find out if you have any excursions suitable for families.
examples.zh: 我想了解你们有没有适合家庭的短途游览项目。

examples.en: There is a lake there, as well as a river, and they provide a very attractive habitat.
examples.zh: 那里有湖也有河，它们构成了非常有吸引力的栖息地。

examples.en: I think some people will be prepared to pay a little extra for something that looks different.
examples.zh: 我想有些人会愿意多花一点钱买看起来与众不同的东西。

examples.en: The result is devastating habitat and biodiversity loss on the island, but not all species are suffering.
examples.zh: 结果是岛上的栖息地和生物多样性遭到毁灭性破坏，但并非所有物种都受害。

examples.en: If you like animals there's also a display of hunting birds - falcons and eagles and so on.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢动物，还有猛禽展示——猎鹰、老鹰等等。

examples.en: I've had to do so much reading this semester just to help me make sense of the lectures.
examples.zh: 这学期我不得不读大量资料，才能听懂那些讲座。

examples.en: I want to know what my options are, really.
examples.zh: 我其实想知道我有哪些选择。

examples.en: Many ignore trends in their innovation strategies or adopt a wait-and-see approach and let competitors take the lead.
examples.zh: 许多人在创新策略中忽视趋势，或采取观望态度，让竞争对手抢占先机。

examples.en: Half the world’s 6,800 languages are likely to vanish within two generations—that’s one language lost every ten days.
examples.zh: 世界上6800种语言中，有一半可能在两代人之内消失——相当于每十天就消失一种语言。

examples.en: Silbo has proved particularly useful when fires have occurred on the island and rapid communication across large areas has been vital.
examples.zh: 岛上发生火灾、需要在大片区域快速通讯时，口哨语被证明格外有用。

examples.en: As you walk out of the main door into the park there is a path you can follow.

examples.en: Legal protection ensured its survival for a while, and numbers steadily recovered throughout most of the 20th century.
examples.zh: 法律保护使其一度得以存续，其数量在20世纪的大部分时间里稳步恢复。

examples.zh: 为什么棕榈油对制造商如此有吸引力？

examples.zh: 我希望音乐节期间会有一场戏剧，最好是喜剧。

examples.zh: 由此得到的颗粒状粉末就是原始的电木，可以制成各种各样的制品。

examples.en: Employment prospects have improved enormously, contributing to rising living standards for the whole community.
examples.zh: 就业前景大为改善，使整个社区的生活水平不断提高。

examples.zh: 前方的道路无疑漫长而艰辛。

examples.zh: 总有几个人抱怨，但他们只是极少数。

examples.zh: 有不少老年人来这里，想跟上计算机技术的步伐。

examples.zh: 我对你们在附近海岸一带提供的假期项目感兴趣。

examples.zh: 大家都说，到年底你会获得很大的自信。

examples.zh: 低年级部将搬入主校区新建的大楼。

examples.zh: 医学诊断程序和语音识别软件的原型似乎正在取得进展。

examples.zh: 由于国家公园内的食物有限，一些大象开始到更远的地方觅食。

examples.zh: 巴哈杰博士在奥尔德尼岛做了大部分工作，那里水流湍急。

examples.zh: 收集完信息后，我们必须对其进行分析！

examples.zh: 制定国家预防政策所用的全部信息都将向公众开放。

examples.zh: 有两个班次——早班从7点到2点，晚班从4点到11点。

examples.zh: 下午每天都有不同的艺术活动，包括海报比赛或模型制作。

examples.zh: 藜麦的流行虽然让农民在经济上受益，但也带来了其他负面后果。

examples.zh: 我对儿童工作坊感兴趣，想多了解一些信息。

examples.zh: 道路网络的变化正在影响这座城镇。

examples.zh: 如果你立即退回有瑕疵的鞋子，你有权坚持要求退款。

examples.zh: 深海鱼类和鲸鱼无论白天黑夜都几乎没有光线。

examples.zh: 我们水资源政策的后果不仅限于危害人类健康。

examples.zh: 尖锐的棱角被证明不实用，因而被避免，由此产生了1930年代流行的圆滑“流线型”风格。

examples.zh: 我们最担心的是无法向老师请教。

examples.zh: 一起跳舞的人说感觉更快乐，而独自跳舞的人则没有。

examples.zh: 我们认为把本地居民街道与主干道分隔开非常重要。

examples.en: I'm glad we chose quite a specific topic - cities built next to the sea.
examples.zh: 我很高兴我们选了一个相当具体的主题——海滨城市。

examples.zh: 与大多数果树不同，无花果全年结果，为许多物种提供稳定的食物来源。
