examples.en: Sunlight floods in through the glass wall, and to maximise it there are lots of mirrors and windows inside the house.
examples.zh: 阳光透过玻璃墙倾泻而入，为了最大限度利用阳光，屋内设置了许多镜子和窗户。

examples.en: Let's have a look at some of the sights you'll be seeing.
examples.zh: 我们来看看你将要看到的一些景点。

examples.en: As is the case with stage drama, dialogue serves to tell the story and expresses feelings and motivations of characters as well.
examples.zh: 与舞台剧一样，对白用来讲述故事，同时也表达角色的情感和动机。

examples.en: If an investigation of implicit theories reveals little correspondence between the extant implicit and explicit theories, the implicit theories may be wrong.
examples.zh: 如果对内隐理论的调查显示，现有的内隐理论与外显理论几乎没有对应关系，那么内隐理论可能是错误的。

examples.en: The students have signed up for a course in order to learn how to market effectively.
examples.zh: 这些学生报名参加了一门课程，以学习如何有效地营销。

examples.en: A facial expression, for example, can dramatically alter the meaning of what is said.
examples.zh: 例如，面部表情可以极大地改变所说内容的含义。

examples.en: We need to look for patterns, most commonly those of causes and consequences.
examples.zh: 我们需要寻找规律，最常见的是因果规律。

examples.en: I need to take down a few details of the actual damage over the phone before you put in a full report.
examples.zh: 在你提交完整报告之前，我需要在电话里记下实际损失的一些细节。

examples.en: The Sheepmarket is a centre for fashion, and there's a policy of encouraging new young designers.
examples.zh: 羊市是时尚中心，并有鼓励新晋年轻设计师的政策。

examples.en: Out to the east, the large buildings about a kilometre away are on the Olympic site.
examples.zh: 往东看，大约一公里外的那些大型建筑位于奥运场地内。

examples.en: 'A lot of the archaeological debate has really only been well-argued speculation.'
examples.zh: “许多考古学争论其实只是论证充分的推测。”

examples.en: Many women are unwilling to invest in stocks and shares, for instance, but these can be extremely profitable.
examples.zh: 例如，许多女性不愿投资股票，但这些投资可能获利丰厚。

examples.en: Viewed from this angle, humour is just a form of creative insight, a sudden leap to a new perspective.
examples.zh: 从这个角度看，幽默只是创造性洞察的一种形式，是向新视角的突然跃升。

examples.en: The last two decades of the artist's life were relatively unproductive as ill health and blindness hindered her ability to work.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家生命的最后二十年相对缺乏创作，因为疾病和失明妨碍了她的工作。

examples.en: Apart from these spectacular snow-covered peaks and valleys, there are marvellous historic villages.
examples.zh: 除了这些壮观的雪峰和山谷，还有迷人的历史村落。

examples.en: You will turn these pages much more slowly than when reading a novel or a newspaper.
examples.zh: 你翻这些书页会比读小说或报纸时慢得多。

examples.en: Strategies are needed to obtain the optimum classroom construction and perhaps a change in classroom culture and methods of teaching.
examples.zh: 需要采取策略来获得最佳的课堂构造，也许还要改变课堂文化和教学方法。

examples.en: A good place to get your first job would be on a low budget short film.
examples.zh: 找第一份工作的好去处是低成本短片剧组。

examples.en: I'll start by telling you about some of the excursions that are available for guests.
examples.zh: 我先给你们介绍一些为住客提供的短途游览项目。

examples.en: Choreographers have deep understanding of the psychological, aesthetic, and physical implications of different ways of moving.
examples.zh: 编舞者深刻理解不同动作方式在心理、美学和身体方面的含义。

examples.en: It helps that lecturers speak clearly, don't have to compete with background chatter, and say much the same thing each year.
examples.zh: 讲师讲话清晰、不必与背景闲聊声竞争，而且每年讲的内容大同小异，这很有帮助。

examples.en: Over the years, kauri gum has also been used in a number of minor products, such as an ingredient in marine glue and candles.
examples.zh: 多年来，贝壳杉树胶还被用于一些次要产品，例如用作船用胶和蜡烛的成分。

examples.en: In fact there's even a saying in English, 'as dead as the dodo', used to refer to something which no longer exists.
examples.zh: 事实上，英语中甚至有一句谚语“as dead as the dodo”（像渡渡鸟一样灭绝），用来指不复存在的事物。

examples.en: The lighting box has a window into the auditorium, which of course is below us.
examples.zh: 灯光控制室有一扇通向观众席的窗户，观众席当然在我们下方。

examples.en: You can be flexible with travel plans but you must research job opportunities in advance.
examples.zh: 旅行计划可以灵活，但必须提前调查工作机会。

examples.en: By 2000, the global saiga population had hit an all-time low of just 21,000 individuals.
examples.zh: 到2000年，全球高鼻羚羊数量降至历史最低，仅有2.1万只。

examples.en: More than the physical reality of photons or sound waves, perception is a product of the brain.
examples.zh: 比起光子或声波的物理现实，知觉更是大脑的产物。

examples.en: Researchers have also found that different types of laughter serve as codes to complex human social hierarchies.
examples.zh: 研究人员还发现，不同类型的笑声是复杂人类社会等级的密码。

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的

examples.en: The real mental challenge comes from playing multiple games at once in the head.
examples.zh: 真正的脑力挑战来自在脑海中同时下多盘棋。

examples.en: I don't think so because players still use wooden sticks today.
examples.zh: 我不这么认为，因为球员今天仍然使用木制球棍。

examples.en: Conditions have improved a lot, but conflict in the workplace is still common.
examples.zh: 状况已大有改善，但职场冲突仍然很常见。

examples.en: We have a new powerful technology to deal with - itself, literally, a new way of thinking.
examples.zh: 我们要应对一项强大的新技术，它本身从字面上讲就是一种新的思维方式。

examples.en: More generally, parents' implicit theories of intelligence will determine at what ages they believe their children are ready to perform various cognitive tasks.
examples.zh: 更一般地说，父母关于智力的内隐理论将决定他们认为孩子在什么年龄准备好完成各种认知任务。

examples.en: Make sure that all the physical equipment that you use, such as a desk, chair etc. is at a good height for you.
examples.zh: 确保你使用的所有实物设备，如书桌、椅子等，高度对你来说都合适。

examples.en: In order to succeed, Whaley needs to get the local people on board, and that has meant overcoming local prejudices.
examples.zh: 为了成功，惠利需要争取当地人的支持，这意味着要克服当地的偏见。

examples.en: In fact it's 147 miles to be exact, so it'll take you at least - say, three to four hours by road.
examples.zh: 确切地说是147英里，所以走公路至少要三到四个小时。

examples.en: Something else you might be interested in is the boat race along the river.
examples.zh: 你可能还感兴趣的是沿河举行的赛艇比赛。

examples.en: In reality, says Yong, bacteria should not be viewed as either friends or foes, villains or heroes.
examples.zh: 容说，实际上不应把细菌看作朋友或敌人、坏人或英雄。

examples.en: The local council took action to limit cruise passengers to a more manageable level.
examples.zh: 当地议会采取措施，把邮轮乘客数量限制在更易管理的水平。

examples.en: In the following century much of this momentum was lost as German established itself as the leading European language of science.
examples.zh: 在接下来的一个世纪里，随着德语确立了欧洲主要科学语言的地位，这种势头在很大程度上消失了。

examples.en: Elsewhere, in uncontrolled airspace, pilots are bound by fewer regulations.
examples.zh: 在其他非管制空域，飞行员受到的规定约束较少。

examples.en: I'm one of the tutors, so I should be able to help you.
examples.zh: 我是导师之一，应该能帮到你。

examples.en: I'm always considering my own clothes but now I can see you should be focusing on your client!
examples.zh: 我总是考虑自己的衣服，但现在我明白你应该把重点放在客户身上！

examples.en: We have a wide range of databases, so the computers are in great demand.
examples.zh: 我们有各种各样的数据库，所以电脑非常抢手。

senses.zh: 会说两种语言的；双语的
熟练使用两种语言的人

examples.en: For this reason, bilingual people often perform better on tasks that require conflict management.
examples.zh: 因此，双语者在需要处理冲突的任务中往往表现更好。

examples.en: Not all objects in orbit are known, and even those included in databases are not tracked consistently.
examples.zh: 并非所有轨道上的物体都为人所知，即使是数据库中收录的也没有得到持续追踪。

examples.en: The school will be on that road, at the corner of the second turning to the left.
examples.zh: 学校就在那条路上，位于左边第二个路口的拐角处。

examples.en: Make sure you don't go to the primary school by mistake!
examples.zh: 千万别错去了小学！

senses.zh: 令人激动的；使人兴奋的

examples.en: Like other handheld games, the device featured a host of exciting interactive games, a full-color LCD screen, and advanced 3D graphics.
examples.zh: 与其他掌上游戏机一样，该设备配有大量精彩的互动游戏、全彩液晶屏和先进的3D图形。

examples.en: In the 1930s, few grocery stores could afford to buy freezers for a market that wasn't established yet.
examples.zh: 20世纪30年代，很少有杂货店买得起冰柜来应对一个尚未形成的市场。

examples.en: Some spin-off research, which looked in detail at 24 of the 3,000 children being studied who were succeeding despite difficult circumstances, found something remarkable.
examples.zh: 一项衍生研究详细考察了所研究的3000名儿童中24名在困境中仍取得成功的孩子，发现了引人注目的结果。

examples.en: Similarly, a report recently emerged of a sleeping octopus apparently having a nightmare.
examples.zh: 同样，最近有报道称，一只睡着的章鱼似乎在做噩梦。

examples.en: I'm sure we can help with all those areas that you've outlined.
examples.zh: 我相信你提到的所有这些方面我们都能帮上忙。

senses.zh: 从戏剧角度；戏剧性地；激动人心地

examples.en: In the years that have followed, more and more rail systems have been put in, dramatically changing the nature of the city.
examples.zh: 此后几年，越来越多的轨道交通系统投入使用，极大地改变了这座城市的面貌。

senses.zh: 戏剧的；戏剧性的；激动人心的

examples.en: In the endurance events the results have been more dramatic.
examples.zh: 在耐力项目中，结果更加显著。

examples.en: At least doing the research made us much more careful.
examples.zh: 至少做了这项调研后，我们变得谨慎多了。

examples.en: For the home grower, the roots of all species seem equally effective.
examples.zh: 对家庭种植者来说，所有品种的根似乎同样有效。

senses.zh: 劳动；异常艰巨的任务；劳动力的

examples.en: The book provides a global labour history, investigating the wide range of labour regimes associated with growing sugar.
examples.zh: 这本书提供了一部全球劳动史，考察了与甘蔗种植相关的各种劳动制度。

examples.en: The ship's crew had the daunting task of repairing the rudder at sea, and only succeeded at the second attempt.
examples.zh: 船员们面临着在海上修理船舵的艰巨任务，第二次尝试才成功。

examples.en: One final piece of interesting information - in ancient India one of the greatest tests of leadership for a man was to fight a lion.
examples.zh: 最后一条有趣的信息：在古印度，对一个男人领导力的最大考验之一是与狮子搏斗。

examples.en: You may be asked to help prep an actor ready for makeup.
examples.zh: 你可能会被要求协助给演员做好化妆前的准备。

examples.en: Sales increased in the early 1940s, when World War II gave a boost to the frozen food industry because tin was being used for munitions.
examples.zh: 20世纪40年代初销量增长，因为锡被用于军需品，第二次世界大战推动了冷冻食品行业。

examples.en: The traditional emphasis of business was manufacturing, and of course the service sector is very important.
examples.zh: 商业传统上侧重于制造业，当然服务业也非常重要。

examples.en: The park is a great environment to learn and practise reading a map and using a compass to navigate around the park.
examples.zh: 公园是学习和练习看地图、用指南针在园内导航的绝佳环境。

examples.en: One story is selected for adaptation into a short play and group performance.
examples.zh: 选出一个故事，改编成短剧并由小组表演。

examples.en: On a keyboard, they can be more willing to have a go.
examples.zh: 在键盘上，他们可能更愿意尝试。

examples.en: Barr's thorough technological history discusses not only how caissons work, but also the dangers involved.
examples.zh: 巴尔对技术史的详尽论述，不仅探讨了沉箱的工作原理，还谈到了其中的危险。

examples.en: Whenever a sought-for answer snaps into place, there is a shudder of pleased recognition.
examples.zh: 每当寻找的答案豁然就位，人们都会因认出它而感到一阵愉悦的震颤。

examples.en: I thought the research methods he used were very sound, although I must say I found the overall tone somewhat old-fashioned.
examples.zh: 我觉得他采用的研究方法很可靠，不过我得说，整体基调有点老派。

examples.en: More than two dozen elephants have been born at Nkhotakota since relocation.
examples.zh: 自迁移以来，恩霍塔科塔已有两打多头大象出生。

examples.en: Mixed-ability classes bore students, frustrate parents and burn out teachers.
examples.zh: 混合能力班级让学生厌倦，让家长沮丧，让教师精疲力竭。

senses.zh: 正确的；您会帮我们吗；合乎规范的

examples.en: The researchers in the San Diego study were correct in their predictions regarding the behaviour of the high-status individuals.
examples.zh: 圣迭戈研究中的研究人员对高地位个体行为的预测是正确的。

examples.en: The longer we are denied the pattern we expect, the greater the emotional release when the pattern returns, safe and sound.
examples.zh: 我们被剥夺预期模式的时间越长，该模式安然回归时的情感释放就越强烈。

examples.en: The shape of an artifact may have been lost.
examples.zh: 人工制品的形状可能已经无从得知。

examples.en: Like any placebo, it must be dispensed with authority to be effective.
examples.zh: 和任何安慰剂一样，它必须带着权威性给出才有效。

senses.zh: 脆弱的；地位不稳固的；易受影响的

examples.en: Women were more vulnerable to theft and wealthy women, in particular, worried constantly about pickpockets.
examples.zh: 女性更容易遭窃，尤其是富有的女性，总是担心扒手。

examples.en: You said you wanted to talk about the course I'm taking on literature for children.
examples.zh: 你说想谈谈我正在修的儿童文学课程。

examples.en: The device has a very simple filter to trap particles, and this can easily be shaken to remove them.
examples.zh: 该装置有一个非常简单的过滤器来截留颗粒，轻轻一摇就能把它们去除。

examples.en: I've worked with many very famous actors over the years.
examples.zh: 这些年来，我与许多非常著名的演员合作过。

examples.en: We just remember the ones where something in the real world, like a view or an action, happens to trigger a dream memory.
examples.zh: 我们只记得那些现实世界中的某样东西，比如一处景色或一个动作，恰好触发了梦境记忆的梦。

examples.en: The price includes early morning tea or coffee and biscuits.
examples.zh: 价格包括清晨的茶或咖啡以及饼干。

examples.en: Recent years have seen the emergence of tall buildings constructed almost entirely from timber.
examples.zh: 近年来出现了几乎完全由木材建造的高层建筑。

examples.en: The Leblanc process yielded quantities of good-quality, inexpensive soda ash.
examples.zh: 吕布兰法生产出大量优质而廉价的苏打灰。

examples.en: As we know, carbon dioxide emissions are causing the planet to warm.
examples.zh: 众所周知，二氧化碳排放正在使地球变暖。

examples.en: Venetian merchants traded extensively in silk and encouraged silk growers to settle in Italy.
examples.zh: 威尼斯商人大量经营丝绸贸易，并鼓励蚕丝种植者在意大利定居。

senses.zh: 围墙内的场地或建筑群

examples.en: Compounds of nitrogen and sulphur dioxide should be particularly closely watched.
examples.zh: 氮化合物和二氧化硫尤其应受到密切监测。

examples.en: My particular interest is Asiatic lions, which are a sub-species of African lions.
examples.zh: 我特别感兴趣的是亚洲狮，它是非洲狮的一个亚种。

examples.en: Various theories have been put forward, many focusing on esoteric ideas from theoretical physics.
examples.zh: 人们提出了各种理论，其中许多侧重于理论物理学中深奥的观点。

examples.en: Your teams are always winning, work is always just great, there's always money in your pocket, your car never breaks down.
examples.zh: 你支持的球队总在赢，工作总是很顺利，口袋里总有钱，车从不抛锚。

examples.en: Individual systems can play chess or transcribe speech, but a general theory of machine intelligence still remains elusive.
examples.zh: 单个系统可以下国际象棋或转录语音，但机器智能的一般理论仍然难以捉摸。

examples.en: As the chapters will illustrate, mathematics is not restricted to the analytical and numerical; intuition plays a significant role.
examples.zh: 正如各章将说明的那样，数学并不局限于分析和数字，直觉也起着重要作用。

examples.en: An additional problem is that there is no authoritative catalogue that accurately lists the orbits of all known space debris.
examples.zh: 另一个问题是，没有权威的目录能准确列出所有已知太空碎片的轨道。

examples.en: A trench about ten metres wide and six metres deep was dug, and the sides temporarily held up with timber beams.
examples.zh: 挖了一条约十米宽、六米深的壕沟，两侧用木梁临时支撑。

examples.en: Polar bears may therefore be an important study model to understand heart disease in humans.
examples.zh: 因此，北极熊可能是了解人类心脏病的重要研究模型。

examples.en: Finally, I'd like to mention another study that involved collecting data by tracking the lizards.
examples.zh: 最后，我想提一下另一项通过追踪蜥蜴来收集数据的研究。

examples.en: Nearly one fifth of all the electricity generated worldwide is produced by turbines spun by the power of falling water.
examples.zh: 全球近五分之一的电力由落水驱动的涡轮机产生。

examples.en: The failure to translate the growth mindset into the classroom might reflect a misunderstanding of the nature of teaching and learning itself.
examples.zh: 未能将成长型思维模式应用于课堂，可能反映出对教与学本质的误解。

examples.en: The salmon is always very good and the shellfish.
examples.zh: 三文鱼一直很好，贝类也是。

examples.en: I chose a portrait of a little boy.
examples.zh: 我选了一幅小男孩的肖像。

examples.en: The road improvements and accompanying maintenance system had helped make the district centre accessible throughout the year.
examples.zh: 道路改善和配套的养护体系使区中心全年都可通达。

examples.en: The most dangerous threat is a fungus, which destroyed large numbers of rubber trees in Brazil, and which could cause devastation to plantations worldwide.
examples.zh: 最危险的威胁是一种真菌，它摧毁了巴西大量橡胶树，并可能给全球种植园带来灾难。

examples.en: Other species, however, are less flexible and restricted to a single reproductive cycle per year.
examples.zh: 然而，其他物种就没那么灵活，每年只能进行一个繁殖周期。

examples.en: Fish and other creatures are thought unlikely to be at risk from the relatively slow-turning blades.
examples.zh: 人们认为鱼类和其他生物不太可能受到转速相对较慢的叶片的威胁。

examples.en: I thought comparing the different labelling systems used by food manufacturers was interesting.
examples.zh: 我觉得比较食品制造商使用的不同标签系统很有意思。

senses.zh: 分布广的；普遍的；广泛的

examples.en: We live at a time when widespread misinformation is common.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个错误信息泛滥的时代。

examples.en: In terms of their diet, tardigrades consume liquids in order to survive.
examples.zh: 就饮食而言，缓步动物靠摄取液体来维持生存。

senses.zh: 意想不到的事物；惊讶；惊喜

examples.en: We've been surprised by the positive reaction of residents all over the city.
examples.zh: 全市居民的积极反应令我们感到惊讶。

examples.en: I thought spatial awareness was more to do with knowing where you are in relation to objects or other people.
examples.zh: 我原以为空间意识更多是指知道自己相对于物体或其他人所处的位置。

examples.en: While you're on the phone, we haven't managed to find a few things we need, like extra pillows for the beds and some washing powder.
examples.zh: 你打电话的时候，我们还没找齐一些需要的东西，比如床用的备用枕头和洗衣粉。

examples.en: For every one-point increase on a measure of chronic procrastination, annual income decreased by US$15,000.
examples.zh: 长期拖延症指标每增加一分，年收入就减少1.5万美元。

examples.en: When the sole purpose of a tunnel was mineral extraction, construction required less planning, as the tunnel route was determined by the mineral vein.
examples.zh: 当隧道的唯一目的是开采矿物时，建造所需的规划较少，因为隧道路线由矿脉决定。

senses.zh: 落成典礼；开幕式；首映式

examples.en: Two of her earliest and most celebrated Southwestern paintings exquisitely reproduce a cow skull's weathered surfaces, jagged edges, and irregular openings.
examples.zh: 她最早也最著名的两幅西南部题材画作，精致地再现了牛头骨风化的表面、锯齿状的边缘和不规则的孔洞。

examples.en: In 83 percent of cases, the perceived dangers of ocean trash were proven true.
examples.zh: 在83%的案例中，人们所认为的海洋垃圾危害被证明是真实的。

examples.en: We have economic geography - in which we examine all kinds of resources and their use - agriculture, for example.
examples.zh: 我们有经济地理学，研究各种资源及其利用，例如农业。

examples.en: The company's research covered a whole range of different hotel types, both independent hotels and those which are part of large chains.
examples.zh: 该公司的研究涵盖各种类型的酒店，既有独立酒店，也有大型连锁酒店旗下的酒店。

examples.en: I think the best way to appreciate the area would be to hire horses instead and trek around on those.
examples.zh: 我认为欣赏该地区的最佳方式是租马，骑着马四处徒步游览。

examples.en: I'm thinking of doing some writing and I might need to access national newspapers.
examples.zh: 我打算写点东西，可能需要查阅全国性报纸。

examples.en: Many believe an entirely new approach to indoor farming is required, employing cutting-edge technologies.
examples.zh: 许多人认为，室内农业需要一种采用尖端技术的全新方法。

examples.en: All our subjects deemed the circle soft and the square hard.
examples.zh: 我们所有的受试者都认为圆形柔软，方形坚硬。

examples.en: Some found no association between loneliness and dementia and others found the opposite.
examples.zh: 一些研究没有发现孤独与痴呆之间的关联，另一些则发现了相反的结果。

examples.en: There should be some more instructions on the side of the heater.
examples.zh: 加热器侧面应该还有一些说明。

examples.en: You can imagine the damage to players' necks when the ball was headed.
examples.zh: 你可以想象球员用头顶球时对颈部造成的伤害。

examples.en: An initial scan like this can help you identify the emails that require your prompt attention.
examples.zh: 这样的初步浏览可以帮你找出需要优先处理的邮件。

examples.en: Norway's mountains are probably still hiding a lot of history - and prehistory - in remote ice patches.
examples.zh: 挪威的群山中，偏远的冰斑里可能仍藏着大量历史和史前的遗存。

examples.en: If superintelligent machines don't do a lot better than us, we'll be in deep trouble.
examples.zh: 如果超级智能机器不比我们强很多，我们就会陷入大麻烦。

examples.en: Obviously, you'll start by flying out to Kishba, the capital city, on Day One.
examples.zh: 显然，第一天你会先飞往首都基什巴。

examples.en: There's a standard open ticket which doesn't have any restrictions.
examples.zh: 有一种标准的不定期机票，没有任何限制。

examples.en: The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests.
examples.zh: 第四个问题涉及雨林遭到破坏的原因。

examples.en: From badger skins to Bibles, sewing machines to scarlet bodices - the villagers' entire worldly goods are included.
examples.zh: 从獾皮到《圣经》，从缝纫机到猩红色紧身胸衣，村民的全部家当都包括在内。

examples.en: The good news is that several cities have been working to turn the volume down.
examples.zh: 好消息是，一些城市一直在努力降低噪音。

examples.en: Just about 4kg of the dried plant would be enough to cater for a large family's daily energy needs, early research predicted.
examples.zh: 早期研究预测，约4公斤干燥植物就足以满足一个大家庭每天的能量需求。

examples.en: If I'm free on a Monday, that's when I choose to come into town.
examples.zh: 如果周一有空，我就会选那天进城。

examples.en: The study demonstrates that bears are capable of agile and thought-out behaviours.
examples.zh: 这项研究表明，熊能够做出敏捷且经过思考的行为。

examples.en: Some participating authors and commentators argued in favour of community-based and autonomous risk management strategies through collective action groups, co-operatives or producers' groups.
examples.zh: 一些参与讨论的作者和评论者主张通过集体行动小组、合作社或生产者团体，开展以社区为基础的自主风险管理策略。

examples.en: As well as manufacturing, there were new technologies in transport, contributing to the growth of consumerism.
examples.zh: 除了制造业，交通领域也出现了新技术，推动了消费主义的兴起。

examples.en: The auditorium, stage and dressing rooms for the actors are all below ground level.
examples.zh: 观众席、舞台和演员更衣室都在地面以下。

examples.en: The women who smoke the lake fish are already getting sick less often.
examples.zh: 熏制湖鱼的妇女生病的次数已经减少了。

examples.en: I'm your host - Dave Green - and this is your very own local radio programme.
examples.zh: 我是主持人戴夫·格林，这里是属于你们自己的本地广播节目。

examples.en: At first this looked like a series of stitches and was just around the tops of the pots.
examples.zh: 起初这看起来像一排针脚，只出现在罐口一圈。

examples.en: Strawberries are being grown in disused shipping containers, mushrooms in underground carparks.
examples.zh: 草莓种在废弃的集装箱里，蘑菇种在地下停车场里。

examples.en: I think supermarkets like the idea of having a colour-coded system - red, orange or green - for levels of fat, sugar and salt in a product.
examples.zh: 我认为超市喜欢用颜色编码系统，即红、橙、绿，来标示产品中脂肪、糖和盐的含量。

examples.en: As well as improving general fitness, clients find that they end up losing much of the stress they've built.
examples.zh: 除了提升整体体能，客户还发现自己积累的许多压力也消除了。

examples.en: The most extraordinary thing about language, however, is that one doesn't have to be a genius to set its wheels in motion.
examples.zh: 然而，语言最非凡之处在于，不必是天才也能让它运转起来。

examples.en: The pyramids of Egypt were built more than three thousand years ago, and no one knows how.
examples.zh: 埃及金字塔建于三千多年前，没有人知道是怎么建成的。

examples.en: All members must pay a joining fee of £90 in addition to the rates for the monthly membership fees.
examples.zh: 所有会员除缴纳月会费外，还须支付90英镑入会费。

examples.en: Dancing, like other forms of exercise, releases hormones, such as dopamine, which make us feel relaxed and happy.
examples.zh: 跳舞和其他形式的运动一样，会释放多巴胺等激素，让我们感到放松和快乐。

examples.en: Many archaeology projects happen when an ancient object is found.
examples.zh: 许多考古项目都是因为发现了古代物品而开展的。

examples.en: In today's lecture, I'm going to be talking about microplastics.
examples.zh: 在今天的讲座中，我要讲的是微塑料。

examples.en: The teenagers took the seven scrolls to a nearby town where they were sold for a small sum to a local antiquities dealer.
examples.zh: 这几个少年把七卷卷轴带到附近的城镇，以很低的价钱卖给了当地一位古董商。

examples.en: Remember that climbing on rocks and in caves can destroy in a moment what has lasted for centuries.
examples.zh: 请记住，攀爬岩石和洞穴可能瞬间毁掉已存续数百年的东西。

examples.en: Art also seems to have been invented by older hominins.
examples.zh: 艺术似乎也是由更古老的古人类发明的。

examples.en: I've got a permanent job starting in a few months' time, and I want to do something else until then.
examples.zh: 几个月后我有一份固定工作，在那之前我想做点别的。

examples.en: Eventually, one tiny tortoise came across a fully grown giant who had been lumbering around the island for around a hundred years.
examples.zh: 最终，一只小陆龟遇到了一只已在岛上缓缓行走了约一百年的成年巨龟。

examples.en: I'd thought if it's a legal food colouring, it must be safe.
examples.zh: 我原以为既然是合法的食用色素，就一定安全。

senses.zh: 幸运的；我；你没那么走运吧

examples.en: We're very lucky that one of our staff is a member of a folk band.
examples.zh: 我们很幸运,有一位员工是民谣乐队的成员。

examples.en: You can also discuss your more long-term ambitions with them as well.
examples.zh: 你也可以和他们讨论你更长远的志向。

examples.en: Cycling is another favourite, and I'm delighted that dozens of pupils make use of the chance to learn to ride in off-road conditions.
examples.zh: 骑自行车是另一项深受喜爱的活动，我很高兴有几十名学生利用机会学习在越野条件下骑行。

examples.en: The Byzantines were as secretive as the Chinese, however, and for many centuries the weaving and trading of silk fabric was a strict imperial monopoly.
examples.zh: 然而，拜占庭人和中国人一样守口如瓶，几个世纪里丝绸的织造与贸易都是严格的帝国专营。

examples.en: Children's educational environment contributes to the IQ score and the way intelligence is used.
examples.zh: 儿童的教育环境影响智商分数以及智力的运用方式。

examples.en: The psychological laboratory has a strong claim to legitimacy and evokes trust and confidence in those who perform there.
examples.zh: 心理学实验室有很强的合法性依据，能让在其中工作的人产生信任和信心。

examples.en: We ask all campers to show due care and consideration whilst staying here and to observe the following camp rules.
examples.zh: 我们请所有露营者在此逗留期间适当谨慎、体谅他人，并遵守以下营地规则。

examples.en: You should run at a speed that feels comfortable, but time yourself and try to run a bit faster each time.
examples.zh: 你应该以感觉舒适的速度跑步，但要给自己计时，争取每次跑得快一点。

examples.en: The fluid is then released into the dishwasher where it cleans the dishes all by itself.
examples.zh: 然后液体被释放到洗碗机中，自己就能把碗碟洗干净。

examples.en: Merchant ships were built to transport lots of cargo over long distances and at a reasonable cost.
examples.zh: 商船的建造目的是以合理的成本长距离运输大量货物。

examples.en: There are quite a number of new methods which can help, such as child-initiated learning, ability-peer tutoring, etc.
examples.zh: 有不少新方法可以起到帮助，比如儿童主导式学习、能力相近的同伴辅导等。

examples.en: All three manatee species are endangered or at a heightened risk of extinction.
examples.zh: 三种海牛均已濒危或灭绝风险升高。

examples.en: As we continue to push forward new developments, congestion of the space environment is only going to increase.
examples.zh: 随着我们不断推进新的发展，太空环境的拥挤程度只会增加。

examples.en: A field of knowledge or a professional endeavor is defined by both the means and the end; hence both deserve scrutiny.
examples.zh: 一个知识领域或一项专业事业，既由手段也由目的来界定，因此两者都值得审视。

examples.en: For washing, we recommend you use melted snow, though, to conserve supplies.
examples.zh: 不过，洗漱时我们建议你用融化的雪水，以节约补给。

examples.en: Whether a joke gives pleasure or pain depends on a person's outlook.
examples.zh: 一个笑话带来的是愉悦还是痛苦，取决于一个人的看法。

examples.en: If you're feeling competitive, you can take our memory test in which you answer questions about things you've seen in the museum.
examples.zh: 如果你好胜心强，可以参加我们的记忆测试，回答关于你在博物馆里所见事物的问题。

examples.en: The agencies in town are pretty good - it's just a matter of contacting them in good time.
examples.zh: 镇上的中介机构都相当不错，关键是要及时联系它们。

examples.en: The only one closed down last year, and it's now in the process of being converted into a film museum.
examples.zh: 唯一的那家去年关门了，现在正在改建成一座电影博物馆。

examples.en: On our boat trips, we pretty well guarantee you'll see dolphins - if you don't you can repeat the trip free of charge.
examples.zh: 我们的乘船游基本保证你能看到海豚，如果没看到，可以免费再游一次。

examples.en: I got the idea of exporting bicycles to developing countries while I was in Ecuador.
examples.zh: 我在厄瓜多尔时萌生了向发展中国家出口自行车的想法。

examples.en: As a writer, I'm interested in the exploration of ideas.
examples.zh: 作为作家，我对思想的探索很感兴趣。

examples.en: There have been centuries of academic debate over the origins of the coconut.
examples.zh: 关于椰子的起源，学术界已争论了几个世纪。

examples.en: I'm afraid this service is only available to full-time students.
examples.zh: 恐怕这项服务只对全日制学生开放。

examples.en: In the seventeenth century, the East End was still a series of separate, semi-rural settlements.
examples.zh: 在十七世纪，东区仍是一连串各自独立的半乡村聚居地。

senses.zh: 反应；不良反应；化学反应

examples.en: The reaction of the public to the new building has generally been positive.
examples.zh: 公众对这座新建筑的反应总体上是积极的。

examples.en: During the Empire, Rome was a huge city by ancient standards of about one million inhabitants.
examples.zh: 帝国时期，罗马按古代标准是座约有一百万居民的大城市。

examples.en: Most tunnels had inscriptions showing the names of patrons who ordered construction and sometimes the name of the architect.
examples.zh: 大多数隧道都有铭文，显示下令建造的资助者姓名，有时还有建筑师的姓名。

examples.en: In tennis players, cortisol has been associated with more unsuccessful serves and greater anxiety.
examples.zh: 在网球运动员中，皮质醇与更多发球失误和更大焦虑有关。

examples.en: The underlying assumption was that the time saved would be used instead for activities that would improve the social and economic development of the communities.
examples.zh: 这一潜在假设是，节省下来的时间将转而用于能够促进社区社会和经济发展的活动。

examples.en: You see I feel I don't have sufficient background information.
examples.zh: 你看，我觉得自己没有足够的背景信息。

examples.en: If further details are requested, these must be sent out promptly.
examples.zh: 如果被要求提供更多细节，必须及时寄出。

examples.en: Ants can't digest the cellulose in leaves - but some fungi can.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁无法消化树叶中的纤维素——但某些真菌可以。

examples.en: In 2017, researchers from the University of Haifa restored and deciphered one of the last untranslated scrolls.
examples.zh: 2017年，海法大学的研究人员修复并破译了最后几卷未译古卷之一。

examples.en: In fact, maybe the focus could be on whether mice can control their own diet.
examples.zh: 事实上，焦点或许可以放在小鼠能否控制自己的饮食上。

examples.en: The earliest axes at Kelo were made using clam shells.
examples.zh: 基洛最早的斧头是用蛤壳制成的。

examples.en: Archaeology, then, is both a physical activity out in the field, and an intellectual pursuit in the study or laboratory.
examples.zh: 因此，考古学既是野外的体力活动，也是书房或实验室里的脑力探索。

examples.en: You wanted to see me to get some feedback on your group's proposal.
examples.zh: 你想见我，以获取关于你们小组提案的一些反馈。

examples.en: I'll need to discuss it with my colleagues, and I hope to get back to you soon to make a booking.
examples.zh: 我需要和同事商量一下，希望能尽快回复您并进行预订。

examples.en: If analysis reveals an increasing disparity between your category and consumers' new focus, your innovations need to transcend the category to integrate the two worlds.
examples.zh: 如果分析显示你的产品类别与消费者的新关注点之间差距日益拉大，你的创新就需要超越该类别，将两个世界融为一体。

examples.en: Diligent preparation is also necessary to effectively answer any interview question, say senior executives.
examples.zh: 高管们表示，要想有效回答任何面试问题，充分的准备也是必不可少的。

examples.en: Sam Phillips, who owned Sun, wanted to revolutionise popular music with songs that fused black and white music, and country and blues.
examples.zh: 太阳唱片公司的老板萨姆·菲利普斯希望用融合黑人与白人音乐、乡村音乐与蓝调的歌曲来彻底革新流行音乐。

examples.en: I'm looking for a cleaning service for my apartment - do you do domestic cleaning?
examples.zh: 我正在为我的公寓找清洁服务——你们做家庭保洁吗？

examples.en: I had to prepare the fabric so the dye would take.
examples.zh: 我得先处理一下布料，好让染料能染上去。

examples.en: In a sense, the development of co-polyester strings has revolutionised the game.
examples.zh: 从某种意义上说，共聚酯球线的研发彻底改变了这项运动。

examples.en: The use of bicycles was constrained by their high cost and the lack of available spare parts.
examples.zh: 自行车的使用受到其高昂成本和缺乏可用零配件的限制。

examples.en: In Ireland and Italy we run one-week general fitness classes for all ages and levels of fitness.
examples.zh: 在爱尔兰和意大利，我们为各个年龄段和体能水平的人开设为期一周的综合健身课程。

examples.en: Ancient philosophy is not just about talking or lecturing, or even reading long, dense books.
examples.zh: 古代哲学不仅仅是交谈或讲学，甚至也不仅仅是阅读冗长晦涩的书籍。

examples.en: A multi-storey facility with no natural overhead light would require far more.
examples.zh: 一个没有自然顶光的多层设施则需要多得多的能源。

examples.en: You can renew any item a maximum of three times.
examples.zh: 任何借阅物品最多可以续借三次。

examples.en: A major drawback of vertical farming, however, is that the plants would require artificial light.
examples.zh: 然而，垂直农业的一个主要缺点是植物需要人工照明。

examples.en: The sisters collected French Impressionist paintings at a time when such art was routinely ignored by individuals and institutions alike.
examples.zh: 当法国印象派画作普遍遭到个人和机构忽视时，这对姐妹收藏了这些作品。

examples.en: When I viewed the house, I told you I'll most probably need to rent some furniture.
examples.zh: 我看房的时候跟您说过，我很可能需要租一些家具。

examples.en: Rent is £64 per week, including bills (not telephone).
examples.zh: 房租为每周64英镑，包含水电等账单（不含电话费）。

examples.en: I think I heard something about a plan to replace the existing concert hall with a larger one.
examples.zh: 我好像听说过一个用更大的音乐厅取代现有音乐厅的计划。

examples.en: I was more interested in just joining a group to do some cycling in my free time.
examples.zh: 我更感兴趣的是只加入一个团体，在空闲时间骑骑自行车。

examples.en: One problem with working in the makeup department is that it's a high-pressure environment.
examples.zh: 在化妆部门工作的一个问题是，那是一个高压环境。

examples.en: Butterflies prefer outdoor conditions to be 'just right', which means neither too hot nor too cold.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶喜欢“恰到好处”的户外环境，也就是说既不太热也不太冷。

examples.en: Modern industrial societies appear to need the possibility of ever-increasing happiness to motivate them in their labours.
examples.zh: 现代工业社会似乎需要不断增加幸福感的可能性，以此激励人们辛勤劳动。

examples.en: Clearly, the maple forests are a valuable resource in many Canadian and North American communities.
examples.zh: 显然，枫树林是许多加拿大和北美社区的宝贵资源。

examples.en: One issue has been that the fertility of the soil decreased dramatically which could potentially lead to desertification in some areas.
examples.zh: 其中一个问题是土壤肥力急剧下降，这可能会导致某些地区出现荒漠化。

examples.en: The view is propounded especially in relation to grammar and vocabulary, and frequently with reference to pronunciation.
examples.zh: 这种观点尤其在语法和词汇方面被提出，而且经常涉及发音。

examples.en: I specifically wanted to do a questionnaire, and interviews with a focus group.
examples.zh: 我特别想做一份问卷调查，并对焦点小组进行访谈。

examples.en: I must give you some advice and safety tips before we go any further.
examples.zh: 在我们继续之前，我必须给大家一些建议和安全提示。

examples.en: At best, Yong informs us, we are only 50 per cent human.
examples.zh: 杨告诉我们，往最好里说，我们也只有50%算得上是人类。

examples.en: Apparently people lined up around the block to see the wonderful new invention.
examples.zh: 据说人们排着长队绕了整个街区，只为一睹这项奇妙的新发明。

examples.en: As you may know, we run skills workshops here, where you can learn traditional crafts like woodwork and basket-making.
examples.zh: 如大家所知，我们在这里开设技能工作坊，您可以学习木工和编篮等传统手工艺。

examples.en: Apes get a large proportion of their food by 'fishing' ants from ant hills.
examples.zh: 猿类很大一部分食物是通过从蚁丘中“钓”蚂蚁获得的。

examples.en: There's the study of political geography and social geography too, of course, which is the study of communities of people.
examples.zh: 当然，还有政治地理学和社会地理学的研究，也就是对人类群体的研究。

examples.en: The research involved testing music before, during or after operations or a combination.
examples.zh: 这项研究涉及在手术前、手术中、手术后或将这些阶段结合起来测试音乐的效果。

examples.en: In public discussion of business, we take certain values for granted.
examples.zh: 在关于商业的公共讨论中，我们把某些价值观视为理所当然。

examples.en: For the best protection, you should install one of each.
examples.zh: 为了获得最佳保护，这两种你应该各安装一个。

examples.en: The crop rotation system was partly responsible for this as it would have been very intensive and was not sustainable.
examples.zh: 轮作制度对此负有部分责任，因为这种制度原本非常集约，且不可持续。

examples.en: Just next to it we have our outdoor classroom, a favourite spot for school parties.
examples.zh: 紧挨着它的是我们的户外教室，这是学校团体最喜欢的地方。

examples.en: Once a location is established as a main tourist destination, the effects on the local community are profound.
examples.zh: 一旦某个地点被确立为主要旅游目的地，对当地社区的影响是深远的。

examples.en: I promised myself that I'd go through this course and keep an open mind till the end.
examples.zh: 我向自己保证，我会读完这门课程，并一直保持开放的心态直到最后。

examples.en: There are biologists throughout the state constantly monitoring adult fish as they show up to spawn.
examples.zh: 全州各地都有生物学家在成年鱼类出现产卵时对其进行持续监测。

examples.en: Long periods in the sun or bush fires could transform dull, cloudy lumps into higher quality transparent gum.
examples.zh: 长时间的日晒或丛林大火可以将暗淡浑浊的树脂块转化为品质更高的透明树胶。

examples.en: Today members of the firefly family can be found almost anywhere outside the Arctic and Antarctic circles.
examples.zh: 如今，在北极圈和南极圈以外的几乎任何地方都能找到萤火虫科的成员。

examples.en: Jah illustrates this with a web-based database that he has developed.
examples.zh: 贾用他开发的一个基于网络的数据库来说明这一点。

examples.en: The notion that you could create anything at all has major implications for our health.
examples.zh: 你可以创造出任何东西的这一概念，对我们的健康具有重大意义。

examples.en: The system was found to amplify structural racial discrimination and was later abandoned.
examples.zh: 该系统被发现会加剧结构性种族歧视，随后被废弃。

examples.en: The team is now calling for further research to quantify this contribution.
examples.zh: 该团队目前呼吁开展进一步研究，以量化这一贡献。

examples.en: Jones and 12 farmers are working to build up soil carbon by cultivating grasses that stay green all year round.
examples.zh: 琼斯和12位农民正通过种植常年保持翠绿的牧草来增加土壤碳储量。

examples.en: The faecal filth of salmon farming has driven wild salmon from many of the sea lochs and rivers of Scotland.
examples.zh: 鲑鱼养殖产生的粪便污物已将野生鲑鱼赶出了苏格兰的许多海湾和河流。

examples.en: You have to look for it as it's a bit hidden in the trees.
examples.zh: 你得仔细找找，因为它有点隐蔽在树林里。

examples.en: A continental or hot breakfast can be ordered if you wish.
examples.zh: 如果您需要，可以点欧陆式早餐或热早餐。

examples.en: The idea is to pressurise the carbon dioxide so that it becomes a liquid.
examples.zh: 其思路是对二氧化碳加压，使其变成液体。

examples.en: At the moment, we've got a salad bar which is very popular.
examples.zh: 目前，我们有一个非常受欢迎的沙拉吧。

examples.en: Bloom's team looked at a group of extraordinarily high achieving people in disciplines as varied as ballet, swimming, piano, tennis, maths, sculpture and neurology.
examples.zh: 布鲁姆的团队考察了一群在芭蕾、游泳、钢琴、网球、数学、雕塑和神经学等不同领域取得极高成就的人。

examples.en: For almost a decade, baseball has used instant replay on the base paths.
examples.zh: 近十年来，棒球运动一直在跑垒道判罚中使用即时回放。

examples.en: You can watch a variety of water birds, but most visitors expect to see black swans when they come to the shelter.
examples.zh: 你可以观赏各种各样的水鸟，但大多数游客来到保护区时都希望看到黑天鹅。

examples.en: Many collectors collect to develop their social life, attending meetings of a group of collectors and exchanging information on items.
examples.zh: 许多收藏家通过收藏来拓展社交生活，参加收藏家团体聚会并交流藏品信息。

examples.en: We do have some written records from sailors, and a few pictures, but we don't know how reliable these are.
examples.zh: 我们确实有一些水手留下的文字记录和几幅图画，但我们不知道这些有多可靠。

examples.en: Lucy, we really need to get working on this marketing assignment.
examples.zh: 露西，我们真的得开始做这个市场营销作业了。

examples.en: ICCO Cooperation has been working with 10,000 farmers in Bangladesh to start cultivating naturally salt-tolerant crops in the region.
examples.zh: ICCO合作组织一直在与孟加拉国的10,000名农民合作，开始在该地区种植天然耐盐作物。

examples.en: The show is about how people communicate, or fail to communicate, with each other, so it's got the rather strange name, Chat.
examples.zh: 这部剧讲述的是人们如何彼此交流或交流失败，因此它有了一个相当奇怪的名字——《闲聊》。

examples.en: I'm arranging a party for my parents fiftieth wedding anniversary, and I'm ringing to ask about hiring a room some time next September.
examples.zh: 我正在为父母的五十周年结婚纪念日筹办派对，打电话是想咨询明年九月某个时间租用房间的事。

examples.en: The sculpture gallery has a number of fine exhibits, but I'm afraid it's currently closed for refurbishment.
examples.zh: 雕塑展厅有许多精美的展品，但恐怕目前因翻修而闭馆。

examples.en: I'd like to get to know the local countryside, as I'm new to the area.
examples.zh: 因为我刚搬来这里，所以想了解一下当地的乡村。

examples.en: The water between the gates is then pumped out.
examples.zh: 然后，两道闸门之间的水被抽出。

examples.en: I know there were paper shortages after the war, but only for 5 or 10 years.
examples.zh: 我知道战后出现过纸张短缺，但只持续了5到10年。

examples.en: Some readers may be disappointed or outraged that I place the ultimate responsibility for business practices harming the public on the public itself.
examples.zh: 我把商业行为损害公众的最终责任归咎于公众自身，一些读者可能会对此感到失望或愤慨。

sceneHook: it would be a good idea

examples.en: I was a bit surprised by the contemporary dress, I must say.
examples.zh: 我必须说，我对剧中的现代服饰感到有点惊讶。

examples.en: I'm sure you'd enjoy the entertainment programme there too, with Greek dancing in the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我相信你也会喜欢那里的娱乐节目，餐厅里有希腊舞蹈表演。

examples.en: How we detect disease will change as tiny biosensors are developed to analyse tests in minutes rather than days.
examples.zh: 随着能够在几分钟而非几天内分析检测结果的微型生物传感器的研发，我们检测疾病的方式将会改变。

examples.en: The walk covers part of the coastal path trail.
examples.zh: 这段徒步路线涵盖了部分海岸步道。

examples.en: From medical decisions to financial and professional ones, we are all sometimes required to weigh up information under stressful conditions.
examples.zh: 从医疗决策到财务和职业决策，我们有时都需要在压力条件下权衡信息。

examples.en: Between 1600 and 1900, literacy rates and book ownership were high and yet the region remained poor.
examples.zh: 在1600年至1900年间，尽管识字率和图书拥有量都很高，但该地区依然贫困。

examples.en: Peachtree created a grid of streets and towers intended as a new pedestrian-friendly downtown for Atlanta.
examples.zh: 桃树街区构建了由街道和塔楼组成的网格，旨在为亚特兰大打造一个适合步行的新市中心。

examples.en: Pupils stay in the same class for all lessons throughout the school and develop considerable class identity and loyalty.
examples.zh: 学生在整个在校期间的所有课程都在同一个班级里上，从而形成了很强的班级认同感和归属感。

examples.en: Admittedly, the rehabilitation of the term has a long way to go, and some firms still prefer to avoid using it.
examples.zh: 诚然，恢复这一术语的声誉还有很长的路要走，一些公司仍然倾向于避免使用它。

examples.en: Bakelite had the distinction of being the first totally synthetic thermosetting plastic.
examples.zh: 酚醛塑料（电木）具有独特的地位，它是第一种完全人工合成的热固性塑料。

examples.en: We're also very pleased with a new installation of the Go-Kart arena which is 120 square metres in area.
examples.zh: 我们对新安装的占地120平方米的卡丁车赛场也非常满意。

examples.en: The fastest commercial sailing vessels of all time were clippers, three-masted ships built to transport goods around the world, although some also took passengers.
examples.zh: 有史以来最快的商用帆船是飞剪式帆船，这种三桅船专为向世界各地运送货物而建造，不过有些也搭载乘客。

examples.en: My spoken Spanish was already pretty good in fact.
examples.zh: 事实上，我的西班牙语口语本来就相当不错了。

examples.en: Using wood to construct buildings, however, is not straightforward.
examples.zh: 然而，用木材建造房屋并非易事。

examples.en: There's no doubt that pottery has given archaeologists a fascinating insight into how ancient humans lived.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，陶器让考古学家得以深入洞察古代人类的生活方式。

examples.en: We suggest you start with the visit to the copper mine.
examples.zh: 我们建议您从参观铜矿开始。

examples.en: Even though over a thousand pterosaur specimens are known today, such wing impressions remain rare.
examples.zh: 尽管如今已知的翼龙标本超过一千件，但这样的翅膀印痕仍然罕见。

examples.en: Pirate raids provided a steady source of slaves, essential for Rome's agriculture and mining industries.
examples.zh: 海盗的袭击提供了稳定的奴隶来源，这对罗马的农业和采矿业至关重要。

examples.en: The identity of the moai builders was in doubt until well into the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 直到二十世纪相当晚的时候，摩艾石像建造者的身份一直存疑。

examples.en: Undoubtedly, Quetzalcoatlus would have used thermals as well, lazily circling over the river deltas that once covered parts of Texas.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，风神翼龙也会利用热气流，在曾经覆盖得克萨斯州部分地区的河流三角洲上空悠闲地盘旋。

examples.en: Usually, books like this are quite sad, but this one actually made me cry with laughter.
examples.zh: 通常这类书都相当悲伤，但这本书却让我笑出了眼泪。

examples.en: 'We think we could prevent hail by inducing lightning,' he says.
examples.zh: “我们认为可以通过引雷来防止冰雹，”他说。

senses.zh: 肆意蔓延的；扩散性的；开刀的

examples.en: Let me start by saying what an invasive species is and what it's not.
examples.zh: 让我先说说什么是入侵物种，什么不是。

examples.en: Job interviewers will make hiring decisions on the basis of their implicit theories of intelligence.
examples.zh: 面试官会根据自己对智力的内隐理论来做出录用决定。

examples.en: If you treat staff fairly, they'll be more likely to step in and help when extra staff are needed.
examples.zh: 如果你公平对待员工，当需要额外人手时，他们就更有可能挺身而出提供帮助。

examples.en: Though new processes have greatly reduced consumption, there is still plenty of room for big savings in industrial uses of water.
examples.zh: 尽管新工艺已大幅减少了用水量，但工业用水仍有很大的节约空间。

examples.en: After a year, I did a one-week residential course, led by specialists.
examples.zh: 一年后，我参加了一个由专家主讲的为期一周的住宿课程。

examples.en: Not only was elm common in European forests, it became a key component of birch, ash and hazel woodlands.
examples.zh: 榆树不仅在欧洲森林中很常见，还成为了桦木、梣木和榛木林地的重要组成部分。

examples.en: Cosimo Alessandro Collini, the first natural historian to study the fossil and describe it, was unable to classify it.
examples.zh: 科西莫·亚历山德罗·科利尼是第一位研究并描述该化石的自然历史学家，但他无法对其进行分类。

examples.en: There is a wide range of photosynthetic responses of plants to variations in light intensity.
examples.zh: 植物对光照强度变化的光合作用反应千差万别。

examples.en: Each new demand or change in circumstances affects whether a person responds positively or negatively to stress.
examples.zh: 每一个新要求或处境变化都会影响一个人对压力做出积极还是消极的反应。

examples.en: I'm not convinced these qualities are actually the most important.
examples.zh: 我并不认为这些品质实际上是最重要的。

examples.en: From the 1840s until 1869, when the Suez Canal opened and steam propulsion was replacing sail, clippers dominated world trade.
examples.zh: 从19世纪40年代到1869年苏伊士运河开通、蒸汽动力逐渐取代风帆之前，飞剪式帆船一直主导着世界贸易。

examples.en: Sensitivity to the possibility of change in social relations is also key, along with compromise or integration of different attitudes and beliefs.
examples.zh: 对社会关系变化可能性的敏感度也很关键，同时还需要对不同态度和信念的妥协或融合。

examples.en: There would be no weather-related crop failures due to droughts, floods or pests.
examples.zh: 将不会再因干旱、洪水或害虫而导致与天气相关的作物歉收。

examples.en: A large sports centre is planned with facilities for indoor and outdoor activities.
examples.zh: 计划建造一个配备室内和户外活动设施的大型体育中心。

examples.en: Altogether the park covers 170 acres, that's 69 hectares.
examples.zh: 该公园总共占地170英亩，即69公顷。

examples.en: For Greeks, piracy was a part of everyday life.
examples.zh: 对希腊人来说，海盗活动是日常生活的一部分。

examples.en: Others have called for a withdrawal of new nano products such as cosmetics and a temporary halt to many kinds of nanotech research.
examples.zh: 也有人呼吁撤回化妆品等新型纳米产品,并暂停多种纳米技术研究。

examples.en: Each day kicks off with a sports match, perhaps football, or volleyball, followed by an hour of drama for everyone.
examples.zh: 每天以一场体育比赛拉开帷幕，可能是足球或排球，随后是面向所有人的一个小时戏剧活动。

examples.en: Nitroglycerine was known to be volatile and unpredictable, often exploding as a result of very small knocks.
examples.zh: 众所周知，硝化甘油极不稳定且难以预测，常常因为非常轻微的碰撞而发生爆炸。

examples.en: The revolution involved intensive commercial farming and the growing of animal fodder on land not previously used for crops.
examples.zh: 这场革命涉及集约化商业农业，以及在以前未曾用于种植作物的土地上种植动物饲料。

examples.en: There is a standard setting for air conditioning to be at a temperature of 21° designed to suit men.
examples.zh: 空调的标准设定温度是21度，这是专为适合男性而设计的。

examples.en: Whereas most exercises are designed to build up strength or endurance, plyometrics focuses on increasing power — the rate at which an athlete can expend energy.
examples.zh: 大多数训练旨在增强力量或耐力，而增强式训练则专注于提高爆发力——即运动员消耗能量的速率。

examples.en: Significant advances have been made in the understanding of the biological and chemical nature of olfaction, but many fundamental questions have yet to be answered.
examples.zh: 人们对嗅觉的生物和化学本质的理解已取得重大进展，但许多基本问题仍有待解答。

examples.en: I wrote down my impressions when I got home.
examples.zh: 回到家后，我写下了自己的观后感。

examples.en: I made the suggestion, which may sound downright crazy in light of the evidence, that perhaps marketing is by definition principled.
examples.zh: 鉴于现有证据，我提出的这个建议听起来可能完全疯了：也许市场营销在定义上就是讲原则的。

examples.en: Hibernating brown bears do not have this capacity and must therefore resort to major bone reformation in the following spring.
examples.zh: 冬眠的棕熊不具备这种能力，因此必须在次年春天依靠大规模的骨骼重塑。

examples.en: I can see you've got some shopping with you.
examples.zh: 我看到你随身带了一些买的东西。

examples.en: I understand you help fix up students with host families.
examples.zh: 我了解到你们帮学生安排寄宿家庭。

examples.en: Birdseye products also came in convenient size packages that could be prepared with a minimum of effort.
examples.zh: 博姿（Birdseye）的产品还采用尺寸方便的包装，只需花很少的精力就能做好。

examples.en: Background music may aid viewer understanding by linking scenes.
examples.zh: 背景音乐可以通过串联场景来帮助观众理解。

examples.en: I enjoy working with children, and I probably need some more experience before I go on a really challenging trip.
examples.zh: 我喜欢和孩子们一起工作，在参加真正具有挑战性的旅行之前，我可能还需要积累更多经验。

examples.en: For the most part, however, we breathe in the aromas which surround us without being consciously aware of their importance to us.
examples.zh: 然而在大多数情况下，我们吸入周围的气味时，并未有意识地察觉到它们对我们的重要性。

examples.en: I've also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing, but we had a really good time.
examples.zh: 我还去过梅奥郡冲浪，那里在冲浪方面没那么出名，但我们玩得非常开心。

examples.en: Be prepared for questions that require you to show how you handled difficult challenges.
examples.zh: 准备好回答那些要求你展示自己如何应对棘手挑战的问题。

examples.en: Global warming is bound to affect rainfall patterns, though there is considerable disagreement about its precise effects.
examples.zh: 全球变暖势必会影响降雨模式，尽管人们对其确切影响仍存在很大分歧。

examples.en: In Stockholm, car use has actually fallen in recent years as the city has become larger and wealthier.
examples.zh: 在斯德哥尔摩，随着城市规模扩大和变得更加富裕，近年来汽车使用量实际上有所下降。

examples.en: I'm sure I don't have to ask you not to throw anything into the sea.
examples.zh: 我相信我无需提醒大家不要往海里扔任何东西。

examples.en: Would the human race face the culture shock if faced with a superior and much older civilization?
examples.zh: 如果面对一个更高等且古老得多的文明，人类会遭遇文化冲击吗？

examples.en: Many introduced - or non-native - species thrive in new areas without posing any threat.
examples.zh: 许多引进物种（或非本地物种）在新地区繁衍生息，而不会构成任何威胁。

examples.en: The study was the start of research into the effects of oxytocin on human interactions.
examples.zh: 这项研究开启了催产素对人际互动影响的研究。

examples.en: The company has quite a powerful computer and I managed to borrow some scanning software from the university.
examples.zh: 公司有一台性能相当强大的电脑，而且我设法从大学借到了一些扫描软件。

examples.en: Interference with the ecosystem can have a severe effect on both local rainfall patterns and water run-off.
examples.zh: 对生态系统的干扰会对当地的降雨模式和水流径流产生严重影响。

examples.en: 'We know that what we are doing today is not enough, and we have to be willing to take some calculated and measured risks.'
examples.zh: “我们知道今天所做的还不够，我们必须愿意承担一些经过深思熟虑和权衡的风险。”

examples.en: Anxiety can also reduce concentration and self-control and cause overthinking.
examples.zh: 焦虑还会降低注意力和自控力，并导致过度思考。

senses.zh: 使做好应对困难的准备

examples.en: Two hydraulic steel gates are raised, so as to seal the gondola off from the water in the canal basin.
examples.zh: 两道液压钢闸门升起，从而将吊船与运河水池中的水隔离开来。

examples.en: Firstly, we need to set up more reserves in our oceans, places where marine species are protected.
examples.zh: 首先，我们需要在海洋中建立更多的保护区，即保护海洋物种的地方。

examples.en: The processing begins from when we have received the completed application form.
examples.zh: 收到填写完整的申请表后，审批处理流程即开始。

examples.en: The ancient Greek historian Thucydides, for instance, glorified pirates' daring attacks on ships or even cities.
examples.zh: 例如，古希腊历史学家修昔底德曾赞美海盗对船只甚至城市的大胆袭击。

examples.en: New shores were formed and totally different creatures would have washed up onto the shores.
examples.zh: 新的海岸形成了，完全不同的生物会被冲上海岸。

examples.en: Forming strong memories depends on the frequency with which you try to retrieve them.
examples.zh: 形成牢固的记忆取决于你尝试提取这些记忆的频率。

senses.zh: 革新的；富有创新精神的；有创意的

examples.en: The new engine design, though innovative, was still plagued with serious glitches.
examples.zh: 新的发动机设计虽然颇具创新性，但仍受到严重故障的困扰。

examples.en: Novelty releases the perceptual process from the chains of past experience and forces the brain to make new judgments.
examples.zh: 新奇事物将感知过程从过往经验的束缚中解放出来，迫使大脑做出新的判断。

examples.en: Productivity often suffers, as employees spend their time sharing rumours and providing one another with moral support rather than focusing on their jobs.
examples.zh: 工作效率往往会受到影响，因为员工把时间花在传播谣言和相互提供精神支持上，而不是专注于工作。

examples.en: Aside from the deep sea and deep underground, it's the era of specialists.
examples.zh: 除了深海和深层地下之外，这是一个专家的时代。

examples.en: The food industry in the UK in particular is obsessed with finding and exploiting the next big food trend.
examples.zh: 尤其是英国的食品行业，热衷于寻找并利用下一个重大食品潮流。

examples.en: In most of the world, the senior managers of large businesses are mainly men in their fifties and sixties.
examples.zh: 在世界上大多数地方，大企业的高级管理人员主要是五六十岁的男性。

examples.en: As well as this, action needs to be taken to lower the levels of fishing quotas to prevent overfishing of endangered species.
examples.zh: 此外，还需要采取行动降低捕捞配额水平，以防止对濒危物种的过度捕捞。

examples.en: For nearly 2,000 years, Aristotle's work was accepted as the chief authority on weather theory.
examples.zh: 在近两千年的时间里，亚里士多德的著作一直被公认为气象理论的最高权威。

examples.en: The few digitised sources of data that exist tend to be buried in bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 现有的少数数字化数据源往往被埋没在官僚机构中。

examples.en: Blood is even re-directed to the muscles in our legs.
examples.zh: 血液甚至被重新导向我们腿部的肌肉。

examples.en: On the downside, the data also reveals failures in public health that have caused surges in some illnesses.
examples.zh: 不利的一面是，数据也揭示了公共卫生方面的失误，这些失误导致某些疾病激增。

examples.en: Carbon-rich soil is dark, crumbly and fertile, and retains some water.
examples.zh: 富含碳的土壤呈深色、松软且肥沃，并能锁住一部分水分。

examples.en: At a macro level, it requires the establishment of academically selective schools for the brightest students, and comprehensive schools for the rest.
examples.zh: 在宏观层面上，这需要为最聪明的学生建立学术选拔性学校，并为其余学生建立综合学校。

examples.en: Just a minute, I think it's some time around the end of June.
examples.zh: 等一下，我想大概是在六月底左右。

examples.en: The idea of artificial speech translation has been around for a long time.
examples.zh: 人工语音翻译的想法已经存在很长时间了。

examples.en: You will be sleeping in tents so you must have quite a bit of equipment with you but you will be helped by local assistants.
examples.zh: 你们将睡在帐篷里，所以必须随身携带相当多的装备，但会有当地助手协助你们。

examples.en: Residents wanted open space for outdoor activities, rather than housing or even an indoor sports complex.
examples.zh: 居民们想要用于户外活动的开放空间，而不是住宅，甚至也不是室内体育馆。

examples.en: There are cloths and bottles of spray by the sink.
examples.zh: 水槽旁有抹布和几瓶喷雾剂。

examples.en: People who are motivated by pleasure seem to suffer particularly badly.
examples.zh: 受享乐驱动的人似乎受害尤为严重。

examples.en: The former US policy of running Indian reservation schools in English, for example, effectively put languages such as Navajo on the danger list.
examples.zh: 例如，美国过去在印第安人保留地学校用英语教学的政策，实际上把纳瓦霍语等语言推上了濒危名单。

examples.en: The few plants that grew in the control plots, fed with traditional fertilisers, were small and weak.
examples.zh: 在施用传统化肥的对照试验田里，长出的少数几株植物又小又弱。

examples.en: Manatees' teeth are all molars - flat, rounded teeth for grinding food.
examples.zh: 海牛的牙齿全都是臼齿——用于磨碎食物的扁平圆形牙齿。

examples.en: The values can easily get in the way of what's actually intended.
examples.zh: 这些价值观很容易妨碍原本真正想要实现的目标。

examples.en: Imagine a similar number of volcanoes smoking away for the last 3,500 million years.
examples.zh: 想象一下，在过去的35亿年里，有差不多数量的火山一直在冒烟。

examples.en: Forests are one of the main elements of our natural heritage.
examples.zh: 森林是我们自然遗产的主要组成部分之一。

examples.en: Like order, disorder should be embraced only so far as it is useful.
examples.zh: 与秩序一样，只有在混乱有用的时候才应该接纳它。

examples.en: Birdseye was responsible for several key innovations that made the frozen food industry possible.
examples.zh: 博姿（Birdseye）促成了几项关键创新，使冷冻食品行业成为可能。

examples.en: Nano means tiny, so it's science and engineering on the scale of atoms and molecules.
examples.zh: “纳米”意味着极小，因此它是在原子和分子尺度上的科学与工程。

examples.en: I'll start with a brief history of the district, and then focus on life in the first half of the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 我将从该地区的简史开始，然后重点介绍二十世纪上半叶的生活。

examples.en: The canals, regulated by clocks and basins, were supposed to make it easier for boats to navigate inland.
examples.zh: 由水闸和水池调节的运河，原本是为了让船只更容易向内陆航行。

examples.en: Part two of the book begins with a discussion of the economics of skyscraper height.
examples.zh: 全书第二部分以对摩天大楼高度的经济学的讨论开篇。

examples.en: If you have fewer than ten ionization alarms to get rid of, you may put them in your domestic waste.
examples.zh: 如果您需要丢弃的电离烟雾报警器少于十个，可以将它们放入生活垃圾中。

examples.en: The students then were randomly assigned to watch a video clip eliciting either humour, contentment, or neutral feelings.
examples.zh: 随后，学生们被随机分配观看一段能引发幽默、满足或中性情绪的视频片段。

examples.en: Well, the honey from Australian bees is of excellent quality, much better than the stuff the Asian bees produce.
examples.zh: 嗯，澳大利亚蜜蜂酿的蜂蜜品质极佳，比亚洲蜜蜂产的蜂蜜好得多。

examples.en: Go along the corridor past the courtyard, right to the end.
examples.zh: 沿着走廊走，经过庭院，一直走到尽头。

examples.en: Should we look at the relationship between loneliness and mental health now?
examples.zh: 我们现在要探讨一下孤独与心理健康之间的关系吗？

examples.en: We're planning to add judo and stretch classes soon.
examples.zh: 我们计划很快增加柔道和拉伸课程。

examples.en: An algorithm calculated risk assessment scores and advised judges on the sentencing.
examples.zh: 算法计算出风险评估分数，并就量刑向法官提供建议。

examples.en: Your system will totally do away with the need for strong detergents.
examples.zh: 你们的系统将完全消除对强效洗涤剂的需求。

examples.en: In that respect, this book differs from most books on mathematics written for the general public.
examples.zh: 在这方面，这本书不同于大多数面向普通大众撰写的数学书籍。

examples.en: We have also seen growing evidence of women occupying positions of authority in ancient societies.
examples.zh: 我们还看到越来越多的证据表明，在古代社会中女性担任着权威职位。

examples.en: Other countries will experience changes in rainfall which could have a major impact on agricultural yield - either for better or for worse.
examples.zh: 其他国家将经历降雨量的变化，这可能会对农业产量产生重大影响——或好或坏。

examples.en: The government is now requiring logging companies to adopt a better logging method, which is a positive step.
examples.zh: 政府现在要求伐木公司采用更好的采伐方法，这是积极的一步。

examples.en: The system would greatly reduce the incidence of many infectious diseases that are acquired at the agricultural interface.
examples.zh: 该系统将大大减少许多在农业接触界面感染的传染病的发病率。

examples.en: The bones of P. questedti and P. talampayensis leave us in no doubt.
examples.zh: P. questedti 和 P. talampayensis 的骨骼让我们确信无疑。

examples.en: Merely restricting tourism cannot be the solution to the imbalance, because people's desire to see new places will not just disappear.
examples.zh: 仅仅限制旅游业不可能是解决失衡的办法，因为人们游览新地方的愿望不会凭空消失。

examples.en: In 16th century London, the quickest way to get from one part of the city to another was by river.
examples.zh: 在16世纪的伦敦，从城市的一个地方到另一个地方最快捷的方式是走水路。

examples.en: The only thing is that you need to pay a £50 deposit to book a table.
examples.zh: 唯一的要求是，您需要支付50英镑的押金来预订餐桌。

examples.en: In 1872 and 73, many other clubs were established both here and abroad.
examples.zh: 在1872年和1873年，国内外还成立了许多其他俱乐部。

examples.en: Houses were arranged in blocks, with wide main streets and narrow alleyways, and many had their own wells and drainage systems.
examples.zh: 房屋按街区排列，有宽阔的主干道和狭窄的小巷，许多房屋还有自己的水井和排水系统。

examples.en: Fish were a vital commodity in growing towns and cities, where food supplies were a constant concern.
examples.zh: 在不断发展的城镇和城市中，食物供应始终是个令人担忧的问题，而鱼类是一种至关重要的商品。

examples.en: The increasing self-reliance of many elderly people is probably linked to a massive increase in the use of simple home medical aids.
examples.zh: 许多老年人自理能力的增强，可能与简易家用医疗辅助器具使用量的大幅增加有关。

examples.en: The details are all in our conference pack, which I'll send you.
examples.zh: 详细内容都在我们的会议资料包里，我会发给您。

examples.en: As soon as animals evolved moderately complex lifestyles, they would have needed to dream in order to manage these lifestyles.
examples.zh: 一旦动物进化出较为复杂的生活方式，它们就需要通过做梦来管理这些生活方式。

examples.en: These baits can be placed either on the ground or on the trunks of trees or large shrubs.
examples.zh: 这些诱饵可以放在地面上，也可以放在树干或大型灌木的枝干上。

examples.en: I think people will be surprised to hear that the weather in the USA was badly affected too.
examples.zh: 我想人们听说美国的天气也受到严重影响时会感到惊讶。

examples.en: Women, young girls and children are particularly vulnerable because they are the ones who cook in the kitchen or outside over fires.
examples.zh: 妇女、年轻女孩和儿童尤其脆弱，因为她们是在厨房里或户外明火上做饭的人。

examples.en: Fifty years ago, buses linked virtually every part of the town and the neighbouring towns and villages.
examples.zh: 五十年前，公交车几乎连接了镇上的每一个角落以及邻近的城镇和村庄。

examples.en: ‘The patterns and connections we make among various concepts may be structured by the linguistic habits of our community.’
examples.zh: “我们在各种概念之间建立的模式和联系，可能受到我们群体语言习惯的塑造。”

examples.en: What's essential though is being able to get on well with other people and also to deal with someone who's behaving badly, as occasionally happens.
examples.zh: 不过，至关重要的一点是能够与他人融洽相处，并且能够应对偶尔出现的举止不当的人。

examples.en: Plants absorb CO2 from the air and transform it into sugars and other carbon-based substances.
examples.zh: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳，并将其转化为糖分和其他碳基物质。

examples.en: There are some crucial lessons here for everyone aiming to boost investments in national AI programmes.
examples.zh: 对于所有旨在加大国家人工智能项目投资的人来说，这里有一些至关重要的经验教训。

examples.en: We propose that science is constantly evolving, much as species of animals do.
examples.zh: 我们认为科学在不断进化，就像动物物种一样。

examples.en: In fact, to qualify as a witness in a court of law a man had to be able to count to nine!
examples.zh: 事实上，要想在法庭上具备作证资格，一个人必须能数到九！

examples.en: I'm calling for some information about the cycle camp - I'm thinking of sending my son.
examples.zh: 我打电话是想咨询一些关于自行车夏令营的信息——我正在考虑送我儿子去。

examples.en: Our client here is a very large fresh food producer supplying a range of top supermarkets.
examples.zh: 我们这里的客户是一家非常大型的生鲜食品生产商，向多家顶级超市供货。

examples.en: The excavations suggest people successfully lived in the two Kelo shelters for about 10,000 years.
examples.zh: 发掘工作表明，人们在基洛的两个洞穴居所中成功生活了大约10,000年。

examples.en: As the bears eat the salmon, they discard the skin and bones in great amounts on the forest floor, which provide vital nutrients.
examples.zh: 熊在吃鲑鱼时，会将大量的鱼皮和鱼骨丢弃在森林地面上，这提供了重要的营养物质。

examples.en: At the same time, extreme weather events like Category 5 hurricanes are becoming more frequent.
examples.zh: 与此同时，像五级飓风这样的极端天气事件正变得越来越频繁。

senses.zh: 主动性；主动行为；主动权

examples.en: The initiative outlined above could break that cycle of disadvantage.
examples.zh: 上述倡议可能会打破那种弱势循环。

examples.en: All right, what I'll do is I'll talk to my partner and get back to you.
examples.zh: 好的，我先和我的伴侣商量一下，然后再回复您。

examples.en: There was to be a new order of chivalry, the Knights of the Royal Oak.
examples.zh: 原本计划设立一个新的骑士团，即“皇家橡树骑士团”。

examples.en: The cash price is going to be somewhere in the region of seven and a half thousand.
examples.zh: 现金价格大约在七千五百左右。

examples.en: In this project, participants were lent money to purchase shoe shine boxes.
examples.zh: 在这个项目中，参与者借到钱去购买擦鞋箱。

examples.en: We borrow books from the town library, and individuals also donate them.
examples.zh: 我们从镇图书馆借书，个人也会捐赠书籍。

examples.en: The colour's great, it's a really strong yellow.
examples.zh: 这个颜色棒极了，是一种非常浓郁的黄色。

examples.en: For passenger transport, the determining factor is the spectacular growth in car use.
examples.zh: 对于客运而言，决定性因素是汽车使用量的惊人增长。

examples.en: I was thinking of registering for your internet service at some stage.
examples.zh: 我想在某个时候注册你们的互联网服务。

examples.en: Donkeys, which were imported to the district, have become more common and contribute, in particular, to the transportation of crops and goods to market.
examples.zh: 引进到该地区的驴子变得更加普遍，尤其在将农作物和货物运往市场方面发挥了作用。

examples.en: There is a widespread belief that increasing wealth encourages people to live farther out where cars are the only viable transport.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，财富的增长促使人们住得更远，而在那些地方汽车是唯一可行的交通工具。

examples.en: The resulting limit, given in units of bits per second, is the absolute maximum rate of error-free communication given signal strength and noise level.
examples.zh: 由此得出的上限以比特每秒为单位，是在给定信号强度和噪声水平下无差错通信的绝对最大速率。

examples.en: The concept of genius and of gifts has become part of our folk culture, and attitudes are ambivalent towards them.
examples.zh: 天才和天赋的概念已成为我们民间文化的一部分，人们对它们的态度是矛盾的。

examples.en: In the first century AD, methods of creating colourless glass were developed, which was then tinted by the addition of colouring materials.
examples.zh: 公元一世纪，人们开发出了制造无色玻璃的方法，随后通过添加着色材料对其进行染色。

examples.en: Few merchants travelled the entire route; goods were handled mostly by a series of middlemen.
examples.zh: 很少有商人走完全程；货物主要由一系列中间商经手。

examples.zh: 学过数学的律师能够以大多数其他人无法企及的方式掌握法律原则。

examples.zh: 该团体的目标是让英国公众相信现代艺术和建筑领域新兴国际运动的价值。

examples.en: In more northern climes, however, where seasonal agriculture was practised, the solar year became more crucial.
examples.zh: 然而，在实行季节性农业的更偏北地区，太阳年变得更加重要。

examples.en: The company grew rapidly and has been providing holidays in continental Europe for the last fifteen years.
examples.zh: 该公司发展迅速，在过去十五年里一直提供欧洲大陆的度假服务。

examples.en: A similar emphasis on conservation will be the best and cheapest option for bridging the gap between water supply and demand.
examples.zh: 同样重视节约用水，将是弥合水资源供需缺口最佳且最经济的选择。

examples.en: To help ensure loud or unexpected noises get the attention they deserve, our internal chemistry alters in response to them.
examples.zh: 为了确保巨大或突如其来的噪音得到应有的注意，我们体内的化学机制会对此做出反应并发生改变。

examples.en: I'm sure I can handle all that without a problem.
examples.zh: 我确信自己能毫无问题地处理好这一切。

examples.en: We offer school leavers the chance for outdoor adventure, to teach things like sailing and snowboarding.
examples.zh: 我们为中学毕业生提供户外探险的机会，教授帆船和单板滑雪等项目。

examples.en: Last week, we started looking at reptiles, including crocodiles and snakes.
examples.zh: 上周，我们开始研究爬行动物，包括鳄鱼和蛇。

examples.en: Make sure you stay in touch so they know your choices for the optional modules.
examples.zh: 一定要保持联系，以便他们知道你对选修课模块的选择。

examples.zh: 新西兰早期的欧洲定居者收集并出售这种树胶。

examples.zh: 那我就得仔细算算这笔账了。

examples.zh: 我一直在研究海洋生物多样性，也就是生活在世界海洋中的物种多样性。

examples.zh: 整个洋底都有一层火山玄武岩基底。

examples.zh: 我小时候父母常笑话我，因为我喜欢把书凑到鼻子跟前。

examples.en: Certain irrigation practices degrade soil quality and reduce agricultural productivity.
examples.zh: 某些灌溉方式会降低土壤质量并削弱农业生产力。

examples.zh: 参加警觉性测试就像当一名军用雷达操作员。

examples.zh: 论文接着指出：“开采方法会产生巨大的沉积物羽流，并将废料排回海洋，从而严重干扰海底环境。”

examples.en: The star as magnified human self is one of cinema's most strange and enduring legacies.
examples.zh: 作为被放大的人类自我，明星是电影留下的最奇特且最持久的遗产之一。

examples.en: To think of geniuses and the gifted as having uniquely different brains is only reasonable if we accept that each human brain is uniquely different.
examples.zh: 只有当我们接受每个人的大脑都是独一无二的时候，认为天才和有天赋的人拥有独特大脑的想法才算合理。

examples.en: We should run through some of the terrible consequences of the eruption experienced in different countries.
examples.zh: 我们应该梳理一下这次火山喷发在不同国家造成的一些可怕后果。

examples.en: The field of health geography is often overlooked, but it constitutes a huge area of need in the fields of geography and healthcare.
examples.zh: 健康地理学领域常常被忽视，但它在地理学和医疗保健领域构成了一个巨大的需求领域。

examples.en: The crisis was completely unexpected, but researchers believe it had nothing to do with impacts of fisheries.
examples.zh: 这场危机完全出乎意料，但研究人员认为它与渔业的影响无关。

examples.en: An important factor in trying to salvage the Mary Rose was that the remaining hull was an open shell.
examples.zh: 尝试打捞“玛丽·罗斯”号的一个重要因素是，残存的船体是一个开放的空壳。

examples.en: Any prospect of the elm returning relies heavily on trees being either resistant to, or tolerant of, the disease.
examples.zh: 榆树重现的任何希望，都很大程度上取决于树木对该疾病具有抗性或耐受性。

examples.en: One that's been known about for some time seems initially to be a rather unlikely source.
examples.zh: 有一种人们早已了解的物质，起初看起来似乎是一个相当不太可能的来源。

examples.en: Thanks to nanotechnology, there could be a major breakthrough in the field of transportation with the production of more durable metals.
examples.zh: 多亏了纳米技术，随着更耐用金属的生产，交通运输领域可能会迎来重大突破。

examples.en: If we have links with them we can do a direct transfer.
examples.zh: 如果我们与他们有合作关系，就可以直接转学分。

examples.zh: 随着狩猎、设陷和制皮等传统技能开始消失，人们出现了身份认同危机。

examples.en: If you rent living room furniture, I believe that's a set of chairs and a TV table.
examples.zh: 如果你租客厅家具，我记得那是一套椅子和一张电视桌。

examples.zh: 答案仍未可知，但一项新研究正试图解答这些问题。

examples.zh: 正如我所说，这是一家大商店，后面还有一个储藏区。

examples.zh: 起初我听不懂讲师们在讲什么，所以我不得不求助于书籍和期刊。

examples.zh: 减少欺凌行为——以及由此带来的学生幸福感的提升——无疑是一个有价值的目标。

examples.en: We possess both the science and the technology to identify and redress the changes in how we read before they become entrenched.
examples.zh: 我们拥有科学和技术，可以在阅读方式的变化根深蒂固之前识别并加以纠正。

examples.en: Above all, the public sector typically lacks the human talent with the right technological capabilities to fully reap the benefits of machine intelligence.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，公共部门通常缺乏具备相应技术能力的人才，无法充分获取机器智能带来的益处。

examples.en: Bentham was also a pioneer of the 'science of happiness'.
examples.zh: 边沁也是“幸福科学”的先驱。

examples.en: On a hot summer's day the trees along this path provide welcome shade.
examples.zh: 在炎热的夏日，这条小路两旁的树木提供了宜人的树荫。

examples.en: Silk quickly grew into a symbol of status, and originally, only royalty were entitled to have clothes made of silk.
examples.zh: 丝绸很快成为地位的象征，最初只有皇室成员才有权穿着丝绸制成的衣服。

examples.en: Several researchers are agitating for the immediate creation of protected zones for endangered soils.
examples.zh: 几位研究人员正极力呼吁立即为濒危土壤建立保护区。

examples.en: The Pond isn't deep and there's a fence around it, so it's perfectly safe for children.
examples.zh: 池塘不深，而且周围有围栏，因此对儿童来说非常安全。

examples.en: Plumb lines were also used to measure the depth of the shaft and to determine the slope of the tunnel.
examples.zh: 铅垂线也被用来测量竖井的深度并确定隧道的坡度。

examples.en: Physical barriers such as railways, pipelines and fences can block the seasonal migration routes of this transboundary species.
examples.zh: 铁路、管道和围栏等物理屏障会阻断这一跨界物种的季节性迁徙路线。

examples.en: Generally, weather was attributed to the whims of the gods, as the wide range of weather gods in various cultures shows.
examples.zh: 正如不同文化中众多的气象神所表明的那样，人们通常将天气归因于神灵的喜怒无常。

examples.en: Smartcards can't be used as the mechanical readers aren't working either, forcing passengers to buy individual paper tickets for every journey.
examples.zh: 由于机械读卡器也无法使用，智能卡用不了，迫使乘客每次出行都得购买单程纸质车票。

examples.en: Many researchers have warned against the rolling out of AI without appropriate security standards and defence mechanisms.
examples.zh: 许多研究人员警告称，在没有适当安全标准和防御机制的情况下，切勿贸然推广人工智能。

examples.en: I was interested in the amount of supplements they add to animals' feed nowadays.
examples.zh: 我对如今人们在动物饲料中添加的补充剂数量很感兴趣。

examples.en: Records from India and tropical Africa are even more recent.
examples.zh: 来自印度和热带非洲的记录甚至更晚近。

examples.en: In my case, far from making me feel isolated, it actually does the opposite.
examples.zh: 就我而言，它非但没有让我感到孤立，反而起到了相反的作用。

examples.en: Of course, using timber in a building also locks away the carbon that it absorbed as it grew.
examples.zh: 当然，在建筑中使用木材也能锁住树木在生长过程中吸收的碳。

examples.en: Macfarlane's case has been strengthened by support from notable quarters - Roy Porter, the distinguished medical historian, recently wrote a favourable appraisal of his research.
examples.zh: 麦克法兰的观点得到了知名人士的支持而更具说服力——杰出的医学史学家罗伊·波特最近对他的研究写了一份好评。

examples.en: You can harvest the tops throughout the summer and even eat small amounts of leaf straight from the plant.
examples.zh: 整个夏天你都可以采收顶部嫩叶，甚至可以直接从植株上摘下少量叶子食用。

examples.en: Anthropology, at its broadest, is the study of humanity — our physical characteristic as animals and our unique non-biological characteristics that we call culture.
examples.zh: 从最广泛的意义上讲，人类学是对人类的研究——研究我们作为动物的生理特征，以及我们称之为文化的独特非生物特征。

examples.en: The UK is relatively new to developing green roofs, and local governments and institutions are playing a major role in spreading the practice.
examples.zh: 英国在发展绿色屋顶方面起步较晚，地方政府和机构在推广这一做法方面正发挥着重要作用。

examples.en: Nearly all the expansion is happening on the periphery, and nearly all takes place informally without any agreed strategy.
examples.zh: 几乎所有的扩张都发生在城市边缘地带，而且几乎都是在没有任何商定战略的情况下非正式进行的。

examples.en: Cleland warns that the Nicaraguan crusade was special in many ways, and similar campaigns elsewhere might not work as well.
examples.zh: 克莱兰警告说，尼加拉瓜的这场运动在很多方面都很特殊，在其他地方开展类似的运动可能效果没那么好。

examples.en: For many people, lack of sleep is rarely a matter of choice.
examples.zh: 对许多人来说，睡眠不足很少是出于自己的选择。

examples.en: After the battle, attempts were made to recover the ship, but these failed.
examples.zh: 海战结束后，人们曾试图打捞这艘船，但都失败了。

examples.en: Only the thick vegetation at the skirt of the often cloud-covered peak of Sierra Negra offers respite from the barren terrain below.
examples.zh: 内格拉山顶常年云雾缭绕，只有山麓地带茂密的植被，才能让人稍稍摆脱下方贫瘠地貌的单调荒凉。

examples.en: The early farmers kept various animals, including cattle and sheep.
examples.zh: 早期的农民饲养了各种动物，包括牛和羊。

examples.en: Firstly, managers should stop making basic errors which leave their staff feeling upset and resentful.
examples.zh: 首先，管理者应该停止犯那些会让员工感到沮丧和怨恨的基本错误。

examples.en: In the lab, P. dentata worker ants typically live for around 140 days.
examples.zh: 在实验室里，P. dentata 工蚁通常能活140天左右。

examples.en: Teachers begin with a formal address and mutual bowing, and then concentrate on whole-class teaching.
examples.zh: 教师以正式的问候和相互鞠躬开始上课，然后集中进行全班教学。

examples.en: Modifications to the original design by local carpenters cut production time and costs.
examples.zh: 当地木匠对原始设计的改进缩短了生产时间并降低了成本。

examples.en: In the aftermath, the elm, once so dominant in the British landscape, was largely forgotten.
examples.zh: 在这场浩劫之后，曾经在英国乡村景观中占据主导地位的榆树很大程度上被遗忘了。

examples.en: Getting a personal trainer is a good way to start your fitness programme.
examples.zh: 聘请私人教练是开始健身计划的好方法。

examples.en: Using solid fuels like these for cooking increases indoor pollution.
examples.zh: 使用这类固体燃料做饭会增加室内污染。

examples.en: People are rewarded for what they accomplish, if given equal opportunity.
examples.zh: 如果给予平等的机会，人们会因其所取得的成就而获得回报。

examples.en: The hypothesis will need to be thoroughly tested, however.
examples.zh: 然而，这一假说仍需要接受彻底的检验。

examples.en: I played a recording I came across, of a drummer talking about how playing in a band had changed his life.
examples.zh: 我播放了一段偶然发现的录音，里面有一位鼓手讲述在乐队演出如何改变了他的一生。

examples.en: I think businesses are becoming more open to external influences.
examples.zh: 我认为企业对外部影响正变得更加开放。

examples.en: The carts are old and fragile, so we ask you to keep your children close to you and ensure they don't climb on the carts.
examples.zh: 这些马车年代久远且脆弱易损，因此请看管好您的孩子，确保他们不要攀爬马车。

examples.en: In the meantime, we're putting on a series of guided tours for school groups this autumn.
examples.zh: 与此同时，我们今年秋天将为学校团体推出一系列导览活动。

examples.en: In some hospitals, patients who can't walk can have a paper 'finger labyrinth' brought to their bed.
examples.zh: 在一些医院里，无法行走的患者可以让人把纸质“手指迷宫”拿到床边。

examples.en: The minimum let is six months, as you probably realise.
examples.zh: 最短租期为六个月，这一点您可能也清楚。

examples.en: An improvement of the road network was considered necessary to ensure the import and export of goods to the district.
examples.zh: 为了确保货物能够进出该地区，改善道路网被认为是必要的。

examples.en: Several teams are trying to improve methods for assessing what is in orbit, so that satellite operators can work more efficiently in ever-more-crowded space.
examples.zh: 几个团队正试图改进评估在轨物体的方法，以便卫星运营商能在日益拥挤的太空中更高效地工作。

examples.en: Before Europeans arrived, the Rapanui had descended into civil war and cannibalism, he maintains.
examples.zh: 他坚称，在欧洲人到来之前，拉帕努伊人就已经陷入了内战和同类相食的境地。

examples.en: The overall result is that the smart stay smart and the dumb get dumber, further entrenching the social divide.
examples.zh: 总体结果是聪明的人依然聪明，笨的人变得更笨，从而进一步加深了社会鸿沟。

examples.en: In the kitchen area there's a fridge-freezer and we've just put in an electric cooker.
examples.zh: 厨房区域有一台带冷冻室的冰箱，而且我们刚刚安装了一个电炉。

examples.en: Writers and artists have also been inspired by the stoics.
examples.zh: 作家和艺术家也受到了斯多葛学派的启发。

examples.en: Japanese scholars have been mystified for ages about why these tall, slender buildings are so stable.
examples.zh: 长期以来，日本学者一直对这些高耸纤细的建筑为何如此稳固感到困惑不解。

examples.en: In the classic Stroop Task, people see a word and are asked to name the colour of the word's font.
examples.zh: 在经典的斯特鲁普任务中，人们看到一个词，并被要求说出该词字体的颜色。

examples.en: And if they are within the central, tensile region of the pane, the stresses this unleashes can shatter the whole sheet.
examples.zh: 如果它们位于玻璃板的中央受拉区域内，由此释放的应力可能会使整块玻璃板粉碎。

examples.en: At the same time, forests provide raw materials for human activities through their constantly renewed production of wood.
examples.zh: 与此同时，森林通过不断再生的木材生产，为人类活动提供原材料。

examples.en: The entire sound track consists of three essential ingredients: the human voice, sound effects and music.
examples.zh: 整个音轨由三个基本要素组成：人声、音效和音乐。

examples.en: If you have live music, there's room for four or five musicians in the gallery overlooking the room.
examples.zh: 如果您安排现场音乐表演，俯瞰房间的廊台上有可容纳四五名乐手的空间。

examples.en: In fact, hundreds of thousands of tonnes of MSG are produced all over the world today.
examples.zh: 事实上，如今全世界每年生产数十万吨味精。

examples.en: The trip starts after lunch on Thursday, and you'll return by 6 pm.
examples.zh: 行程在周四午饭后开始，您将在下午6点前返回。

examples.en: Some advertising campaigns are remembered for their creativity, without having any effect on sales.
examples.zh: 有些广告宣传活动因其创意而被人们铭记，但对销售额却没有任何影响。

examples.en: In the ancient times, the inhabitants of these areas relied heavily on marine resources, including fish and salt.
examples.zh: 在古代，这些地区的居民高度依赖包括鱼类和盐在内的海洋资源。

examples.en: Steam ships posed a growing threat to clippers, as their speed and cargo capacity increased.
examples.zh: 随着航速和载货能力的提升，蒸汽船对飞剪式帆船构成了越来越大的威胁。

examples.en: Children will probably be most interested in the adventure playground.
examples.zh: 孩子们可能对冒险游乐场最感兴趣。

examples.en: The efficiency of the translator is less important than the social function.
examples.zh: 与社交功能相比，翻译工具的效率没那么重要。

examples.en: In particular, Shannon showed that noise sets a limit on the rate at which information can pass along communication channels while remaining error-free.
examples.zh: 特别是，香农证明了噪声决定了信息在通信信道中保持无差错传输的速率上限。

examples.en: My parents were surprised when I asked to stay longer - six months in the end.
examples.zh: 当我提出想多留一段时间——最终留了六个月时，我父母都很惊讶。

examples.en: After a break of two weeks, Daguerre systematically placed new photographic plates in the cupboard, removing one chemical each day.
examples.zh: 休息两周后，达盖尔有条不紊地将新的感光板放入橱柜中，每天取出一种化学药品。

examples.en: Extracted seawater is pumped back down and discharged close to the sea floor.
examples.zh: 抽取出的海水被重新泵回海底，并在靠近海床的地方排放。

examples.en: Oat milk had an advantage over other alternative milk products such as almond milk.
examples.zh: 相比杏仁奶等其他替代奶制品，燕麦奶具有优势。

examples.en: The result has been that many people in these regions have turned to outside supplies of rice and other foods.
examples.zh: 结果是，这些地区的许多人转而依赖外部供应的大米和其他食物。

examples.en: You'll see lots of flat cardboard boxes at one end of the counter.
examples.zh: 你会在柜台的一端看到许多扁平的纸箱。

examples.en: The cloakroom, where you should leave coats, umbrellas and any large bags, is on the left hand side of the sitting area.
examples.zh: 衣帽间位于休息区的左侧，您应该把外套、雨伞和任何大包存放在那里。

examples.en: How will you know if Asian bees have entered Australia?
examples.zh: 你们怎么知道亚洲蜜蜂是否已经进入澳大利亚了呢？

examples.en: Exploring further, he uncovered several other timbers and a bronze gun.
examples.zh: 进一步探查后，他发现了其他几根船木和一门青铜火炮。

examples.en: Local goods, including coal, iron products, wool, grain and cider, were sent by river.
examples.zh: 包括煤炭、铁制品、羊毛、谷物和苹果酒在内的当地货物通过河道运输。

examples.en: 1950s families were also looking for convenience at mealtimes, so the moment was right for the arrival of the 'TV Dinner'.
examples.zh: 20世纪50年代的家庭在用餐时也追求便利，因此“电视便餐”面世的时机正好成熟。

examples.en: The sweet-toothed British first bought cane sugar from their own slavery-dependent colonial plantations.
examples.zh: 喜爱甜食的英国人最初是从本国依赖奴隶制的殖民地种植园购买甘蔗糖的。

examples.en: The bedroom window looks in the opposite direction, and has a lovely view of the hills and the monument at the top.
examples.zh: 卧室的窗户朝向相反的方向，可以欣赏到山丘和山顶纪念碑的美丽景色。

examples.en: As a student at the city of London School, Perkin became immersed in the study at chemistry.
examples.zh: 作为伦敦城学校的一名学生，珀金全身心投入到了化学研究中。

examples.en: An interesting angle - how do you reply to letters from customers?
examples.zh: 这是一个有趣的切入点——你们是如何回复客户来信的？

examples.en: On the question of mitigating the risks farmers face, most essayists called for greater state intervention.
examples.zh: 在缓解农民面临的风险这一问题上，大多数撰文者呼吁加强国家干预。

examples.en: So how else can farmers protect their chickens from birds of prey?
examples.zh: 那么，农民还能如何保护他们的鸡免受猛禽侵害呢？

examples.en: Linguistic issues, it is argued, cannot be solved by logic and legislation.
examples.zh: 有人认为，语言问题无法通过逻辑和立法来解决。
