examples.en: In order to protect their hold on the market, the Dutch, like the Portuguese before them, treated the native inhabitants harshly.
examples.zh: 为了保住对市场的控制权，荷兰人像之前的葡萄牙人一样，残酷地对待当地原住民。

examples.en: Maybe we could show a video clip of a cartoon about mammoths.
examples.zh: 也许我们可以播放一段关于猛犸象的动画短片。

examples.en: Today we're going to look at another natural food product and that's maple syrup.
examples.zh: 今天我们要了解另一种天然食品，那就是枫糖浆。

examples.en: While the early transit timings were as precise as instruments would allow, the measurements were dogged by the 'black drop' effect.
examples.zh: 尽管早期的凌日计时已达到了仪器所允许的最精确程度，但测量结果仍受到“黑滴”效应的困扰。

examples.en: Now you wanted to consult me about your class presentation on nanotechnology - you're due to give it in next week, aren't you?
examples.zh: 你想向我咨询关于纳米技术的课堂展示——你下周就要展示了，对吧？

examples.en: In the process, almost everything that could possibly go wrong did so.
examples.zh: 在这个过程中，几乎所有可能出错的地方都出错了。

examples.en: The council has managed to secure funding to keep the library open later into the evening, twice a week.
examples.zh: 市政委员会已成功获得资金，使图书馆每周有两个晚上延长开放时间。

examples.en: Taps that you activate by sensor require no pressing or twisting movements.
examples.zh: 通过传感器激活的水龙头无需按压或旋转操作。

examples.en: Basically, not enough's been spent on increasing the number of cycle lanes.
examples.zh: 基本上，用于增加自行车道数量的资金投入还不够。

examples.en: Some 50 of these stones are now visible on the site, which may once have contained many more.
examples.zh: 该遗址现有约50块石头可见,这里过去可能还有更多。

examples.en: In her magnified images depicting flowers, begun in 1924, O'Keeffe brings the viewer right into the picture.
examples.zh: 在奥基夫始于1924年描绘花朵的放大画作中，她将观者直接带入了画面之中。

examples.en: The main reason why MSG is more commonly used in Japanese meals is tradition.
examples.zh: 味精在日本饮食中更为常用的主要原因是传统。

examples.en: Nearly all computers contain a quartz-crystal clock to regulate their operation.
examples.zh: 几乎所有计算机都包含一个石英晶体时钟来调节其运行。

examples.en: When I applied, I had to have a health assessment.
examples.zh: 我申请的时候，必须接受一次健康评估。

senses.zh: 伦理的；道德的；合乎道德的

examples.en: Knauft has observed that individuals in such groups don't accumulate property or possessions and have an ethical obligation to share everything.
examples.zh: 克瑙夫特观察到，这类群体中的个人不积累财产或所有物，并且有分享一切的道德义务。

examples.en: Measurements were taken of each elephant's tusks - elephants with large tusks would be at greater risk from poachers - and also of their feet.
examples.zh: 研究人员测量了每头大象的象牙——长着巨大象牙的大象面临更大的盗猎风险——并且还测量了它们的脚。

examples.en: What seems entirely predictable and controllable on screen has unexpected results when translated into reality.
examples.zh: 在屏幕上看起来完全可预测和可控的事物，转化到现实中却会产生意想不到的结果。

examples.en: As populations increased, cities were built that had great baths, craft workshops, palaces and halls laid out in distinct sectors.
examples.zh: 随着人口的增长，人们建造了分布在不同区域的城市，其中设有大型浴场、手工作坊、宫殿和厅堂。

senses.zh: 连续不断的人流或事物

examples.en: The logging of the trees along the streams has damaged the places where the bears fish.
examples.zh: 砍伐溪流沿岸的树木破坏了熊捕鱼的地方。

examples.en: Of course hard work is valuable, but only when properly targeted.
examples.zh: 努力工作固然宝贵，但只有在目标恰当的情况下才如此。

examples.en: The effects of sound are often largely subtle and often are noted by only our subconscious minds.
examples.zh: 声音的效果通常非常微妙，往往只有我们的潜意识才会注意到。

examples.en: Your written style is very clear and you've included lots of interesting descriptions of education in your target area.
examples.zh: 你的写作风格非常清晰，而且你加入了很多关于目标地区教育情况的有趣描述。

examples.en: I got so involved I forgot all about making arrangements for when I came back here for the final year.
examples.zh: 我太投入了，以至于完全忘了为回校读最后一年做安排。

examples.en: The main problem is that the lecturers expect you to be critical.
examples.zh: 主要问题在于讲师们期望你具备批判性思维。

examples.en: The audience is caught up in a whirlwind of activity in simply managing to follow the plot.
examples.zh: 观众仅仅是为了跟上剧情发展，就已被卷入一连串令人眼花缭乱的活动之中。

examples.en: Most volunteers devote two or three hours to this every week, while a few do much more.
examples.zh: 大多数志愿者每周在这上面投入两三个小时，而少数人则投入得多得多。

examples.en: The main attraction is the large swimming pool with salt water.
examples.zh: 主要的吸引物是那个大型海水游泳池。

examples.en: There's no limit on access to the nature reserve on the edge of town, and this will continue to be the case.
examples.zh: 进入镇边缘的自然保护区没有任何限制，而且这种情况将会继续保持。

examples.en: Coins are often found by people using metal detectors to look for things buried in the ground.
examples.zh: 硬币通常是由人们使用金属探测器寻找埋在地下的物品时发现的。

examples.en: I'll see what beans they have in the organic shop and I think I'll get something for dessert there.
examples.zh: 我去看看有机商店里有什么豆子，我想我会在那里买点甜点。

examples.en: At the same time, cultural values are highly entrenched in food and agricultural systems worldwide.
examples.zh: 与此同时，文化价值观在世界各地的粮食和农业体系中根深蒂固。

examples.en: Procrastination also correlates with serious health and well-being problems.
examples.zh: 拖延症还与严重的健康和福祉问题相关。

examples.en: The adult flies have no mouth parts, cannot eat and therefore only live a few days.
examples.zh: 成年蜉蝣没有口器，无法进食，因此只能存活几天。

examples.en: In workplaces, it is common to see desks which can be adjusted to suit people of different heights or for wheelchair users.
examples.zh: 在工作场所，经常可以看到能够调节以适应不同身高人群或轮椅使用者的办公桌。

examples.en: The preparatory work for the conference had been undertaken at two meetings of experts.
examples.zh: 大会的筹备工作已在两次专家会议上开展。

examples.en: The practice is intuitively appealing to almost every stakeholder.
examples.zh: 这种做法凭直觉就对几乎所有利益相关者都有吸引力。

examples.en: I suppose you need a bit more than your normal winter coat!
examples.zh: 我想你需要的可不止是一件普通的冬大衣！

examples.en: An important question for ecologists worldwide is, what can we do to tackle the problem of invasive species?
examples.zh: 全球生态学家面临的一个重要问题是，我们能做些什么来解决入侵物种问题？

examples.en: We hope to build a patio in the near future, but I wouldn't like to guarantee it'll be finished by May.
examples.zh: 我们希望在不久的将来建一个露台，但我不敢保证它能在五月前完工。

examples.en: The contents of each copy vary significantly and have proved a useful source for evaluating Henderson's early work.
examples.zh: 每本画册的内容差异很大，事实证明它们是评估亨德森早期作品的有用资料。

examples.en: Many ants are small and forage primarily in the layer of leaves and other debris on the ground.
examples.zh: 许多蚂蚁体型很小，主要在地面上的落叶层和其他碎屑中觅食。

examples.en: The workers wanted employers to stop installing new machinery, but the British government responded to the uprisings by making machine-breaking punishable by death.
examples.zh: 工人们要求雇主停止安装新机器，但英国政府对起义的回应是将破坏机器定为死罪。

examples.en: Was there a sudden change in the viruses and bacteria around?
examples.zh: 是周围的病毒和细菌发生了突然变化吗？

examples.en: At the end he spends about five minutes telling us what to practise for the following week.
examples.zh: 最后他会花大约五分钟告诉我们下周要练习什么。

examples.en: Initially, though, your priority will be to take in a lot of information and not forget any important steps or details.
examples.zh: 不过起初，你的首要任务是吸收大量信息，不要忘记任何重要的步骤或细节。

examples.en: A leading supermarket is looking for a fresh produce buyer who is available for a 12-month maternity cover contract.
examples.zh: 一家领先的超市正在招聘一名生鲜采购员，需能接受为期12个月的产假顶岗合同。

examples.en: I thought you might also be interested in some of the problems I encountered in collecting my data.
examples.zh: 我想你们可能也对我在收集数据时遇到的一些问题感兴趣。

examples.en: Bellerby's father finally did receive his eightieth birthday present, albeit two years late.
examples.zh: 贝勒比的父亲最终确实收到了他的八十岁生日礼物，尽管晚了两年。

examples.en: The charity uses its money to support campaigns - for example, for changes in fishing policy and so forth.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构利用其资金支持各类活动——例如推动渔业政策变革等等。

examples.en: The MSC has established a set of criteria by which commercial fisheries can be judged.
examples.zh: 海洋管理委员会（MSC）制定了一套可用于评判商业渔业的标准。

examples.en: I like to know all the ingredients in a product - not just how much fat, salt and sugar they contain.
examples.zh: 我喜欢了解产品中的所有成分——而不仅仅是它们含有多少脂肪、盐和糖。

examples.en: I'd been worried about the quality, but it worked out all right.
examples.zh: 我本来一直担心质量问题，但结果一切都很好。

examples.en: Luckily, we've managed to keep entry to the museum free.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，我们设法保持了博物馆的免费入场。

examples.en: Using a studio camera, a photographer went up in a cradle to take photos of every pane.
examples.zh: 一名摄影师使用影室照相机，乘坐吊篮升空，为每一块玻璃板拍照。

examples.en: Few coaches, for instance, understand how deficiencies in trace mineral can lead to injuries.
examples.zh: 例如，很少有教练了解微量矿物质缺乏会如何导致受伤。

examples.en: Interestingly, almost no science fiction envisages a future without robots.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，几乎没有哪部科幻小说设想过一个没有机器人的未来。

examples.en: I think that having to do a seminar presentation really helped me.
examples.zh: 我认为必须做研讨会展示这件事真的帮了我很大的忙。

examples.en: As with halls of residence, the rent is payable termly.
examples.zh: 与学生宿舍一样，房租按学期支付。

examples.en: We have a limit of eight children in each class, so their instructor really gets to know them well.
examples.zh: 我们每个班限制八名儿童，因此教练能非常深入地了解他们。

examples.en: If the music is too obvious, it is annoyingly boring, like an alarm clock.
examples.zh: 如果音乐过于直白,就会像闹钟一样令人厌烦地乏味。

examples.en: The stadium of today now brings together multiple functions, thus helping cities to create a sustainable future.
examples.zh: 如今的体育场汇集了多种功能，从而帮助城市创造可持续发展的未来。

examples.en: Arguments can start as easily over minor points of usage as over major policies of linguistic education.
examples.zh: 微小的用法问题与重大的语言教育政策一样，都容易引发争论。

examples.en: Among the goods coming upstream were luxuries such as sugar, tea, coffee and wine.
examples.zh: 逆流运来的货物中有糖、茶、咖啡和葡萄酒等奢侈品。

examples.en: Artworks painted by a robot have sold for thousands of dollars and been hung in prestigious galleries.
examples.zh: 由机器人绘制的艺术品已售出数千美元，并被悬挂在久负盛名的画廊中。

examples.en: One reason, conscious or not, for what someone chooses to collect is to show the collector's individualism.
examples.zh: 无论是出于有意识还是无意识，一个人选择收藏某物的部分原因是为了展示收藏者的个性。

examples.en: All the food could be grown organically, eliminating the need for herbicides, pesticides and fertilisers.
examples.zh: 所有食物都可以采用有机方式种植，从而消除对除草剂、杀虫剂和化肥的需求。

examples.en: Hunters would have easily misplaced arrows and they often discarded broken bows rather than take them all the way home.
examples.zh: 猎人们很容易丢失箭矢，而且他们经常丢弃损坏的弓，而不是一路带回家。

examples.en: The falling water level denoted the passing hour as it dipped below hour lines inscribed on the inner surface.
examples.zh: 当下降的水位低于刻在内表面的小时刻度线时，便表示又过去了一个小时。

examples.en: The rail proposal won and the railway worked spectacularly well.
examples.zh: 铁路方案最终胜出，而且这条铁路运行得极其出色。

examples.en: As I said - all the bread is home-made and there's lots of variety.
examples.zh: 正如我所说——所有的面包都是自制的，而且种类繁多。

examples.en: Flower heads look like daisies, with purple rayed florets and a dark brown central cone.
examples.zh: 花头看起来像雏菊，带有紫色的舌状小花和深棕色的中央花盘。

examples.en: Abstract art offers both a challenge and the freedom to play with different interpretations.
examples.zh: 抽象艺术既带来了挑战，也提供了尝试不同解读的自由。

examples.en: I'll be in touch when I've had a chance to look at the brochure.
examples.zh: 等我有机会看了宣传册之后，会再跟您联系。

examples.en: Too much dependence on the teacher risks loss of autonomy and motivation to discover.
examples.zh: 过度依赖老师会有失去自主性和探索动力的风险。

examples.en: One outdoor activity that we need volunteers for is litter collection and for this it's useful if you can walk for long periods, sometimes uphill.
examples.zh: 我们需要志愿者参与的一项户外活动是收集垃圾，做这件事如果能长时间步行（有时还要上坡）会很有帮助。

examples.en: The witch is depicted in Cutty Sark's figurehead - the carving of a woman typically at the front of old sailing ships.
examples.zh: 这个女巫形象被刻画在“卡蒂萨克”号的船首像上——即旧式帆船船头通常雕有的女性雕像。

examples.en: Every organism has a life span which is highly characteristic.
examples.zh: 每种生物都有极具自身特征的寿命。

examples.en: To make the axes, sources of suitable stone had to be found and systematically exploited.
examples.zh: 为了制作这些斧头，必须找到并进行系统性开采合适的石材来源。

examples.en: Consequently, when pouring molten glass onto the molten tin, the underside of the glass would also be perfectly flat.
examples.zh: 因此，当把熔融玻璃倒在熔融锡液上时，玻璃的底面也会完全平整。

examples.en: Deane dived down, and found the equipment caught on a timber protruding slightly from the seabed.
examples.zh: 迪恩潜入水中，发现设备挂在了一根略微突出海床的船木上。

examples.en: There are thought to be as many as 70 whistled languages still in use, though only 12 have been described and studied scientifically.
examples.zh: 据认为，目前仍有约70种口哨语言在使用，但只有12种得到了科学描述和研究。

examples.en: Elaborate precautions were taken to prevent the foraging team using odour clues.
examples.zh: 研究人员采取了严密的预防措施，以防止觅食团队利用气味线索。

examples.en: You'd be in a small group, usually about eight people but no more than ten - and everyone's always very friendly.
examples.zh: 你会在一个小团队里，通常八人左右，但最多不超过十人——而且大家都非常友好。

examples.en: The child could use the points to enhance various virtual skills needed for the video game.
examples.zh: 孩子可以用这些积分来提升电子游戏所需的各种虚拟技能。

examples.en: One helpful step is to train lunchtime supervisors to distinguish bullying from playful fighting, and help them break up conflicts.
examples.zh: 一个有益的举措是培训午休监管员区分欺凌行为和嬉闹打斗，并帮助他们平息冲突。

examples.en: We looked up restaurants in the area and found an Italian one in a village nearby.
examples.zh: 我们查了这一带的餐厅，并在附近的一个村子里找到了一家意大利餐厅。

examples.en: We'd expected more complaints by commuters about the reduction in the train service, but it doesn't seem to have affected people too much.
examples.zh: 我们原本预计通勤者会对列车班次减少提出更多投诉，但这似乎并没有对人们造成太大影响。

examples.en: Imagine using the immense capacity of shipping to take these trucks off the road.
examples.zh: 想象一下，利用航运的巨大运力让这些卡车不再上路。

examples.en: The club members really welcome the chance to chat to the volunteers at these events.
examples.zh: 俱乐部成员非常欢迎有机会在这些活动中与志愿者聊天。

examples.en: Leonardo designed extensive hydraulic plants to create artificial canals throughout the city.
examples.zh: 达·芬奇设计了庞大的水利设施，以在全城开凿人工运河。

examples.en: Having detailed and up-to-date maps identifying high-priority areas for intervention is essential.
examples.zh: 拥有标明重点干预区域的详细且最新的地图至关重要。

examples.en: When we get to the rocky area inhabited by fur seals, we'll stop and watch them swimming around the coast.
examples.zh: 当我们到达海狗栖息的岩石区时，我们会停下来观看它们在海岸附近游弋。

examples.en: I'm supposed to have been a sociable and confident child who made friends easily - but I was actually terribly shy.
examples.zh: 大家都以为我小时候是个合群又自信、很容易交到朋友的孩子——但实际上我非常害羞。

examples.en: If IgA levels suddenly fall below a certain level, training is eased or dropped altogether.
examples.zh: 如果免疫球蛋白A（IgA）水平突然降至某一水平以下，训练就会减轻或完全停止。

senses.zh: 外围的；远离中心的；外边的

examples.en: The weight of the building is supported entirely by twelve outer and four inner columns.
examples.zh: 整座建筑的重量完全由十二根外柱和四根内柱支撑。

examples.en: The audience is bounced from gag to gag and conversation to conversation; there is no time for audience reflection.
examples.zh: 观众在一个又一个笑料、一段又一段对话之间被来回牵引，根本没有思考的时间。

examples.en: By minimising human involvement, the idea was to minimise the risk of flawed results.
examples.zh: 其思路是通过尽量减少人为干预，将产生错误结果的风险降至最低。

examples.en: There may be some limited truth to this view.
examples.zh: 这种观点或许有一定道理。

examples.en: To date there's not been any increase in traffic accidents, but that's not something we want to see happen, obviously.
examples.zh: 迄今为止，交通事故数量并未增加，但显然这不是我们希望看到发生的事情。

examples.en: I was invited to a special preview and I can promise you, this is the ultimate in sports retailing.
examples.zh: 我受邀参加了一场特别预展，我可以向你保证，这是体育零售业的巅峰之作。

examples.en: Labyrinths and labyrinthine symbols have been found in regions as diverse as modern-day Turkey, Ireland, Greece, and India.
examples.zh: 在如今的土耳其、爱尔兰、希腊和印度等截然不同的地区，人们都发现了迷宫和迷宫符号。

examples.en: We're campaigning against this because, although there'll be little pollution from oil, exploration creates a lot of underwater noise.
examples.zh: 我们正在发起反对这项活动的宣传，因为尽管石油造成的污染很小，但勘探会产生大量的水下噪音。

examples.en: I think we'll just have to differ on that issue!
examples.zh: 我想在这个问题上我们只能保留各自的不同意见了！

examples.en: In California, ‘apprentice’ programs have provided life support to several indigenous languages.
examples.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，“学徒”项目为几种原住民语言提供了延续生机的支持。

examples.en: Another discovery is that oxytocin's effects vary depending on who we are interacting with.
examples.zh: 另一项发现是，催产素的作用因我们的互动对象不同而有所差异。

examples.en: Of 63 people scanned alongside the chess player, only one or two scored more highly on the measure.
examples.zh: 与这位国际象棋选手一起接受扫描的63人中，只有一两个人在此项指标上得分更高。

examples.en: The original plan was to pull the trains with steam locomotives, using firebricks in the boilers to provide steam, but these engines were never introduced.
examples.zh: 最初的计划是用蒸汽机车牵引列车，在锅炉中使用耐火砖来提供蒸汽，但这些机车从未投入使用。

examples.en: The economic opening of countries that have traditionally been minor players is another.
examples.zh: 传统上处于次要地位的国家的经济开放是另一个因素。

examples.en: I'd like to go with another friend in the last week of October.
examples.zh: 我想在十月的最后一周和另一个朋友一起去。

examples.en: Our muscles also twitch slightly, though they are largely paralysed so we don't hurt ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们的肌肉也会轻微抽动，但大体上处于麻痹状态，以免我们弄伤自己。

examples.en: You need about half a cup full for each wash.
examples.zh: 每次洗涤大约需要半杯的量。

examples.en: To sum up, learning is affected by emotions of both the individual and significant others.
examples.zh: 总而言之，学习受到个人及重要他人情绪的影响。

examples.en: When an organisation is shrinking, the best and most mobile workers are prone to leave voluntarily.
examples.zh: 当一个组织在缩减规模时，最优秀、流动性最强的员工往往会主动离职。

examples.en: Presumably some current students and lecturers will come?
examples.zh: 想来应该会有一些在校学生和讲师参加吧？

examples.en: People come to the club from neighbouring villages, and we're always in need of more drivers.
examples.zh: 人们从邻近的村庄来到俱乐部，我们一直需要更多的司机。

examples.en: In some countries, geographical factors influence the health and well-being of the population in very obvious ways.
examples.zh: 在一些国家，地理因素以非常明显的方式影响着人口的健康和福祉。

examples.en: We tend to want to protect animals we think are intelligent and possess emotions, such as elephants and primates.
examples.zh: 我们往往希望保护那些我们认为聪明且拥有情感的动物，比如大象和灵长类动物。

examples.en: The company reserves the right to search staff members leaving or entering the premises and to inspect any article or motor vehicle on company property.
examples.zh: 公司保留对离开或进入办公场所的员工进行搜查，以及对公司场所内的任何物品或机动车辆进行检查的权利。

examples.en: The climatic trigger for this flowering cycle is not yet known, but the adaptive significance is clear.
examples.zh: 这种开花周期的气候触发因素尚不清楚，但其适应性意义是显而易见的。

senses.zh: 节令性的；适合节日的；随季节变化的

examples.en: Generally the reason for such seasonal back-and-forth movement is to seek resources that aren't available within a single area year-round.
examples.zh: 通常，这种季节性往返迁徙的原因是为了寻找单一地区无法全年提供的资源。

examples.en: Would you have a few minutes to spare to answer some questions?
examples.zh: 您能抽出几分钟时间回答几个问题吗？

examples.en: Many such stadiums are situated in suburban areas, designed for sporting use only and surrounded by parking lots.
examples.zh: 许多此类体育场位于郊区，专为体育用途而设计，周围环绕着停车场。

examples.en: The researchers say there is now sufficient research to demonstrate that music should be available to all patients undergoing operations.
examples.zh: 研究人员表示，目前已有充分的研究证明，应该为所有接受手术的患者提供音乐。

examples.en: As well as having a supervisor, you'll each be assigned a mentor.
examples.zh: 除了有一位主管外，你们每个人还会被分配一位导师。

examples.en: A comedian will present a situation followed by an unexpected interpretation that is also apt.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员会先呈现一个情境，随后给出一个出人意料却又恰如其分的解读。

examples.en: We'd like feedback on whether people are satisfied, dissatisfied or neither satisfied nor dissatisfied.
examples.zh: 我们希望获得关于人们是满意、不满意，还是既不满意也不算不满意的反馈。

examples.en: Odours, unlike colours, for instance, cannot be named in many languages because the specific vocabulary simply doesn't exist.
examples.zh: 例如，与颜色不同，气味在许多语言中无法被命名，因为根本不存在相应的特定词汇。

examples.en: Now before we finish and have some refreshments, does anyone have any questions they'd like to ask the new committee?
examples.zh: 在我们结束并享用茶点之前，大家有什么问题想问新任委员会吗？

examples.en: In the 1930s, Vygotsky emphasised the importance of targeting a student's specific 'zone of proximal development' (ZPD).
examples.zh: 20世纪30年代，维果茨基强调了针对学生特定“最近发展区”（ZPD）的重要性。

examples.en: Today's land tortoises constitute a single branch, deeply nested among branches consisting of aquatic turtles.
examples.zh: 如今的陆龟构成了单一的进化支，深深嵌在由水生龟类组成的进化支之中。

examples.en: The focus is on individuals, tweaking performances to squeeze an extra hundredth of a second here, an extra millimetre there.
examples.zh: 重点在于个人，通过微调表现，在这里挤出百分之一秒，在那里多争出一毫米。

examples.en: I should also tell you about the award we won from the Charity Commission last year - for our work in education.
examples.zh: 我还应该告诉大家我们去年从慈善委员会获得的奖项——以表彰我们在教育领域的工作。

examples.en: Today you can see the results of this ambitious programme of restoration.
examples.zh: 今天，您可以看到这项雄心勃勃的修复计划所取得的成果。

examples.en: Yet when Dutch explorers landed in 1722, they met a Stone Age culture.
examples.zh: 然而,荷兰探险家1722年登陆时,遇到的是一个石器时代的文化。

examples.en: Flying in planes inspired her last two major series – aerial views of rivers and expansive paintings of the sky viewed from just above clouds.
examples.zh: 乘坐飞机的经历启发了她最后两个主要系列作品——河流的鸟瞰图，以及从云层正上方俯瞰的广阔天空画作。

examples.en: Hang on, we're due to get there at 11.30 am.
examples.zh: 等等，我们预计上午11点30分到达那里。

examples.en: Garden ponds are on the increase, rural ponds are disappearing, leading to massive migration to the towns.
examples.zh: 花园池塘的数量在增加，而乡村池塘正在消失，这导致青蛙大规模向城镇迁徙。

examples.en: Cultivating such qualities will help you realise your full potential.
examples.zh: 培养这些品质将有助于你充分发挥自己的潜力。

examples.en: What I enjoyed the most about this chapter was Barr's discussion of how foundations are actually built.
examples.zh: 这一章我最喜欢的是巴尔对地基究竟如何建造的讨论。

examples.en: The regular instructor is a colleague who appreciates the kind of ethical perspective I can bring as a philosopher.
examples.zh: 这门课的常任讲师是一位同事，他很欣赏我作为一名哲学家所能带来的那种伦理视角。

senses.zh: 聪明的；机敏的；构思巧妙的

examples.en: There's a management model that groups people according to four criteria: clever, hard-working, stupid and lazy.
examples.zh: 有一种管理模型根据四个标准对人进行分类：聪明、勤奋、愚蠢和懒惰。

examples.en: Day length is an excellent cue, because it provides a perfectly predictable pattern of change within the year.
examples.zh: 日照长度是一个极佳的信号，因为它在一年中提供了完全可预测的变化规律。

examples.en: Newman says this is a new, broader way of considering public transport issues.
examples.zh: 纽曼表示，这是一种思考公共交通问题的全新且更宏观的方式。

examples.en: So you learn about things like the weather, which is obviously really important and also the tides, as well as learning basic sailing skills.
examples.zh: 因此，除了学习基本的帆船技能外，你还会了解像天气（这显然非常重要）以及潮汐之类的知识。

examples.en: A warmer spring, and consequently a higher likeliness of a hot summer, will result in oak leafing before ash.
examples.zh: 更温暖的春季，以及随之而来的更高概率的炎热夏季，会导致橡树比梣树更早长出叶子。

examples.en: Only by arming themselves with an understanding of why butterfly numbers are down can conservationists hope to halt or reverse the decline.
examples.zh: 自然资源保护者只有先弄清楚蝴蝶数量下降的原因，才有希望遏制或扭转这一衰退趋势。

examples.en: The object could not be designed so that it was locked into the mould and therefore difficult to extract.
examples.zh: 物体的设计不能让它卡在模具里而难以取出。

examples.en: In Stavanger, Norway, psychologist Anne Mangen and her colleagues studied how high school students comprehend the same material in different mediums.
examples.zh: 在挪威斯塔万格，心理学家安妮·曼根及其同事研究了高中生如何理解不同媒介中的同一材料。

examples.en: Like the life span, the metabolic rate has for different organisms a fixed mathematical relationship to the body mass.
examples.zh: 与寿命一样，不同生物的新陈代谢率与体重之间也存在固定的数学关系。

examples.en: The time has long passed for the great continental voyages - another walk to the poles, another crossing of the Empty Quarter.
examples.zh: 伟大的大陆探险时代早已过去——无论是再次徒步前往极地，还是再次穿越鲁卜哈利沙漠。

examples.en: The sports injury treatment service operates on a paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service.
examples.zh: 运动损伤治疗服务是收费运营的，营养疗法服务也是如此。

examples.en: Conventional wisdom also places great weight on insight in promoting breakthrough scientific achievements, as if ideas spontaneously pop into someone's head - fully formed and functional.
examples.zh: 传统观点也十分看重顿悟在推动突破性科学成就中的作用，仿佛想法会自发地浮现在某人脑海中——完全成形且切实可行。

examples.en: A few decades later, the name pterosaur, or winged reptile, was adopted to describe the growing list of similar fossils.
examples.zh: 几十年后，“翼龙”（即长翼爬行动物）这一名称被采用，用来描述越来越多类似的化石。

examples.en: The skill has become his brand: he calls himself the Blindfold King.
examples.zh: 这项技能已成为他的个人招牌：他自称为“蒙眼王”。

examples.en: Well, since very few people will ever experience the Antarctic first hand, the visitors' centre aims to recreate the atmosphere of Antarctica.
examples.zh: 由于极少有人能亲身体验南极，游客中心旨在重现南极洲的氛围。

examples.en: Professional guidance can be useful, he adds, allowing people to approach silence slowly so that they can gradually enjoy the benefits.
examples.zh: 他补充说，专业指导会很有用，能让人慢慢接触静默，从而逐渐享受其益处。

examples.en: What kind of skills do you think you developed on the placement?
examples.zh: 你认为自己在实习期间培养了哪些技能？

examples.en: The algorithm - usually built by external designers - often becomes the keeper of knowledge, she explains.
examples.zh: 她解释说，算法——通常由外部设计人员构建——往往成了知识的掌控者。

examples.en: Do you think the role of handwriting will change in the future?
examples.zh: 你认为手写的作用在未来会发生改变吗？

senses.zh: 相等物；这个词的英语对应词；相等的

examples.en: Rivers used to be the equivalent of today's motorways, in that they were extensively used for transportation.
examples.zh: 河流过去相当于如今的高速公路，因为它们曾被广泛用于交通运输。

examples.en: Large-scale rewilding is happening almost everywhere - except Britain.
examples.zh: 大规模的野化再造几乎在所有地方都在进行——除了英国。

examples.en: Inclusive design is often linked with universal design although they are not quite the same thing.
examples.zh: 包容性设计常与通用设计联系在一起，尽管两者并不完全相同。

examples.en: Pupils, parents and staff should feel they have been involved in the policy, which needs to be disseminated and implemented effectively.
examples.zh: 学生、家长和教职员工都应感到自己参与了该政策的制定，而且该政策需要得到有效宣传和落实。

examples.en: Play should stem from the child's own desire.
examples.zh: 玩耍应当源于孩子自身的意愿。

examples.en: You need to clean the area where staff serve customers, including wiping the weighing scales.
examples.zh: 你需要清洁员工为顾客服务的区域，包括擦拭台秤。

examples.en: European languages, when traced back to their earlier version, are very poor in number words and expressions.
examples.zh: 欧洲语言如果追溯到早期版本，其数字词汇和表达是非常匮乏的。

examples.en: In 1998, energy consumption in the transport sector was to blame for 28% of emissions of CO2, the leading greenhouse gas.
examples.zh: 1998年，交通运输部门的能源消耗导致了28%的二氧化碳（主要温室气体）排放。

examples.en: The hull (the body of the ship) acted as a trap for the sand and mud carried by Solent currents.
examples.zh: 船体（船身）起到了收集索伦特海峡洋流所挟带的泥沙的作用。

examples.en: There is considerable debate over how we should react if we detect a signal from an alien civilization.
examples.zh: 如果我们探测到来自外星文明的信号，我们该如何应对，这存在相当大的争议。

examples.en: There is nothing extraordinary about these proposals, seen from the perspective of anywhere else in Europe.
examples.zh: 从欧洲其他任何地方的角度来看，这些提议都没有什么特别之处。

examples.en: Steam ships reduced the journey time between Britain and China by approximately two months.
examples.zh: 蒸汽船将英国和中国之间的航行时间缩短了大约两个月。

examples.en: The finishing time will be 12.30 as usual.
examples.zh: 结束时间将照常在12点30分。

examples.en: The vocabulary aspect, for example, is dependent on having heard those words.
examples.zh: 例如，词汇方面取决于是否听到过这些词。

examples.en: The main entrance to the house has a lot of steps so you might want to use the disabled entry.
examples.zh: 这栋房子的主入口有很多台阶，所以你可能想走无障碍通道。

examples.en: We might lose our freedom to discriminate in favour of our own communities, for example.
examples.zh: 例如，我们可能会失去偏袒自己群体的自由。

examples.en: The results suggest that listening to baby talk prompts infant brains to start practicing their language skills.
examples.zh: 研究结果表明，听儿语会促使婴儿的大脑开始练习语言技能。

examples.en: Classrooms are large and pupils sit at single desks in rows.
examples.zh: 教室很大，学生们成排坐在单人课桌前。

examples.en: More importantly it's full of equipment that's designed to collect data.
examples.zh: 更重要的是，它装满了专门用来收集数据的设备。

examples.en: The only other thing I can think of is to make sure you bring snacks for the kids.
examples.zh: 我唯一能想到的另一件事，就是一定要给孩子们带些零食。

examples.en: Some footwear just isn't good enough to re-sell, for one reason or another, and gets rejected.
examples.zh: 有些鞋类由于种种原因不够好，无法转售，因而被淘汰。

examples.en: We should mention some geographical factors, things like wetlands and river estuaries and coastal erosion and so on.
examples.zh: 我们应该提到一些地理因素，比如湿地、河口以及海岸侵蚀等等。

examples.en: Professor Pretty feels that organic farming would be too big a jump in thinking and in practices for many farmers.
examples.zh: 普雷蒂教授认为，对许多农民而言，有机农业在思维和实践上的跨度都太大了。

examples.en: The street may be attractive to children as a place to find adventurous play and money.
examples.zh: 对孩子们来说，街道可能很有吸引力，是个可以寻找刺激游戏和赚钱的地方。

examples.en: Like points earned on regular purchases, these green points can be redeemed for cash.
examples.zh: 就像日常购物赚取的积分一样，这些绿色积分也可以兑换成现金。

examples.en: I know I've got to look calm even if I'm in a panic.
examples.zh: 我知道即使内心惊慌，我也必须看起来保持冷静。

examples.en: Next to this is the greenhouse where some exotic plants and fruits are grown.
examples.zh: 紧挨着它的是温室，里面种植着一些奇花异草和奇异水果。

examples.en: In some versions, the wolf swallows up the grandmother, while in others it locks her in a cupboard.
examples.zh: 在有些版本中，狼吞掉了外婆，而在另一些版本中，狼把她锁进了橱柜里。

examples.en: My neighbour had the only bicycle in the village, whereas everyone else walked everywhere.
examples.zh: 我的邻居拥有村里唯一的一辆自行车，而其他人去哪儿都靠步行。

examples.en: In the last few lectures I've been dealing with business finance, but now I'm going to move on to business systems.
examples.zh: 在过去的几节课里，我一直在讲企业财务，但现在我要转到企业系统。

senses.zh: 可怕的；严重的；非常讨厌的

examples.en: We do many terrible things to each other and to many other creatures with whom we share the planet.
examples.zh: 我们对彼此以及与我们共享地球的许多其他生物做了许多可怕的事情。

examples.en: Surely, Bellerby reasoned, a good-quality globe wouldn't be difficult to find.
examples.zh: 贝勒比心想，要找到一个高品质的地球仪肯定不难。

examples.en: We've done a lot on how to deal with ropes and tie knots - that's an essential skill.
examples.zh: 我们在如何处理绳索和打结方面做了很多练习——那是一项基本技能。

examples.en: A 2014 study by Shi Ping Liu and colleagues sheds light on this mystery.
examples.zh: 刘石平及其同事在2014年的一项研究揭示了这一谜团。

examples.en: I don't have a rail card so I didn't get any discount.
examples.zh: 我没有铁路优惠卡，所以没有享受到任何折扣。

examples.en: Like grape vines, the trees thrive in poor soil, putting down deep roots in search of moisture and nutrients.
examples.zh: 就像葡萄藤一样，这些树木在贫瘠的土壤中也能茁壮成长，扎下深根以寻找水分和养分。

examples.en: Although attempts were made to preserve the bodies of some of the birds, no complete specimen survives.
examples.zh: 尽管人们曾尝试保存其中一些鸟类的遗骸，但没有完整的标本留存下来。

examples.en: Colder, much wetter weather descended on Europe between 1315 and 1319, when thousands perished in a continent-wide famine.
examples.zh: 1315年至1319年间，更寒冷、更潮湿的天气席卷了欧洲，成千上万的人死于一场遍及整个大陆的饥荒。

examples.en: Traces of such tunnels used to mine gold can still be found at the Dolaucothi mines in Wales.
examples.zh: 在威尔士的多劳科蒂矿区，至今仍能找到这类用于开采黄金的隧道遗迹。

examples.en: Change the observers and the vantage points, clear away some of the mist, and a different lot of peaks appear.
examples.zh: 更换观察者和观察位置，拨开一些迷雾，就会呈现出另一番群峰景象。

examples.en: The tutorial will take you through the basic steps to using the Internet, at any time convenient to you.
examples.zh: 该教程将在您方便的任何时间，带您了解使用互联网的基本步骤。

examples.en: Humour may be a luxury, but the mechanism behind it is no evolutionary accident.
examples.zh: 幽默或许是一种奢侈品，但它背后的机制绝非进化上的偶然。

examples.en: Businesses can locate based on other considerations, such as the availability of labour, while worrying less about the cost of delivering their output.
examples.zh: 企业可以根据其他考量因素（如劳动力的可获得性）来选址，而无需过于担心交付产出的成本。

examples.en: There are a few surviving written documents that give descriptions and representations of ancient Roman ships, including the sails and rigging.
examples.zh: 现存有少量书面文献，对古罗马船只（包括船帆和索具）进行了描述和描绘。

examples.en: If you watch someone take a book off a shelf, well, they usually do it wrong.
examples.zh: 如果你观察别人从书架上取书，嗯，他们的做法通常是错的。

examples.en: Even in the UK, losses were estimated at 25% in the early 1990s because of the failure to maintain the antiquated water supply infrastructure.
examples.zh: 即便在英国，由于未能维护陈旧的供水基础设施，20世纪90年代初的水资源损耗率估计也达到了25%。

examples.en: The idea originated from workplaces - usually in the non-service sector - that emphasized fun and enjoyment as part of work-life balance.
examples.zh: 这个想法起源于一些工作场所——通常在非服务行业——它们将乐趣和享受作为工作与生活平衡的一部分加以强调。

examples.en: I'll give you a brief introduction to the estate while you're sitting down, and then we'll walk round.
examples.zh: 趁大家坐着，我先简要介绍一下这座庄园，然后我们再四处走走。

examples.en: A critical ingredient in the success of hotels is developing and maintaining superior performance from their employees.
examples.zh: 酒店成功的一个关键因素是培养并保持员工的卓越表现。

examples.en: The Metropolitan line, which opened on 10 January 1863, was the world's first underground railway.
examples.zh: 于1863年1月10日开通的大都会线是世界上第一条地下铁路。

examples.en: From an evolutionary perspective, sounds give us vital information, helping us navigate the world and avoid danger.
examples.zh: 从进化的角度来看，声音为我们提供重要信息，帮助我们辨识方向并避开危险。

examples.en: I made a really embarrassing mistake when I was working in the milk shed.
examples.zh: 我在挤奶棚工作时犯了一个非常尴尬的错误。

examples.en: Advertisements were designed to promote the avocado as a superfood rich in nutrients and therefore beneficial for health.
examples.zh: 广告旨在将牛油果宣传为一种富含营养、因而有益健康的超级食物。

examples.en: You don't need slides or any complicated equipment - just some notes.
examples.zh: 你不需要幻灯片或任何复杂的设备——只需要一些笔记。

examples.en: The moai were carved with stone tools, then transported for many kilometres, without the use of animals or wheels, to massive stone platforms.
examples.zh: 摩艾石像用石器雕刻而成，随后在不使用动物或轮子的情况下，被运送数公里到达巨大的石头平台上。

examples.en: Ants are collected when they fall into the trap while foraging.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁在觅食时掉进陷阱就会被收集起来。

examples.en: Similarly, the information accompanying the objects often made little sense to the lay visitor.
examples.zh: 同样，展品附带的说明信息对普通参观者来说往往晦涩难懂。

examples.en: A pirate fleet would serve in the first wave of attack, preparing the way for the navy.
examples.zh: 海盗舰队会在第一波攻击中打头阵，为海军扫清道路。

examples.en: Shall we quickly discuss the recommendations we're going to make?
examples.zh: 我们快速讨论一下将要提出的建议好吗？

examples.en: Today, huge amounts of a building's space and construction cost are given over to air conditioning.
examples.zh: 如今，建筑物的大量空间和建造成本都被用于空调系统。

examples.en: Government officials were paid their salary in silk, and farmers paid their taxes in grain and silk.
examples.zh: 政府官员的俸禄用丝绸支付，而农民则用粮食和丝绸缴税。

examples.en: Geologists consider the earth as having a molten core, surrounded by a semi-molten mantle and a brittle, outer skin.
examples.zh: 地质学家认为地球有一个熔融的核心，外围是半熔融的地幔和脆弱的外壳。

examples.en: Through gradual growth, the front arms would then have evolved into wings.
examples.zh: 通过逐渐生长，前臂随后便进化成了翅膀。

examples.en: As towns gradually expanded, water was brought from increasingly remote sources, leading to sophisticated engineering efforts such as dams and aqueducts.
examples.zh: 随着城镇逐渐扩大，水需要从越来越偏远的水源引来，从而催生了水坝和引水渠等复杂的工程建设。

examples.en: The market should have had more realistic expectations.
examples.zh: 市场本应抱有更切合实际的预期。

examples.en: Moving the trays allows the plants to get enough sunlight.
examples.zh: 移动托盘可以让植物获得充足的阳光。

senses.zh: 复制；重复获得；使自我复制

examples.en: The success stories need to be studied and replicated elsewhere, to make green, blue, brown and food-producing roofs the norm in cities around the world.
examples.zh: 这些成功案例需要被研究并在其他地方复制推广，使绿色、蓝色、棕色以及生产食物的屋顶成为世界各地城市的常态。

senses.zh: 生命的有限；死亡；死亡率

examples.en: By the 1740s, about the time that infant mortality was dipping, the drink was common.
examples.zh: 到了18世纪40年代，大约在婴儿死亡率下降的时候，这种饮品已十分普遍。

examples.en: The idea of forcing storm clouds to discharge their lightning on command is not new.
examples.zh: 迫使雷暴云按指令放电的想法并不新鲜。

examples.en: Rain washed these deposits, along with wood ashes, down into the clay soil along the River Tiber.
examples.zh: 雨水把这些沉积物连同木灰一起冲进了台伯河沿岸的黏土中。

examples.en: If you look ahead of you, you'll see a maze.
examples.zh: 如果你往前看，你会看到一个迷宫。

examples.en: The problem stems at least in part from the lack of any plausible mechanism for telepathy.
examples.zh: 这个问题至少在一定程度上源于心灵感应缺乏任何合理的机制。

examples.en: My husband uses it at the weekends to go to the golf club.
examples.zh: 我丈夫周末用它去高尔夫俱乐部。

examples.en: I want to reveal not only some of the fascinating discoveries, but, more importantly, the reasoning behind them.
examples.zh: 我不仅想揭示一些迷人的发现，更重要的是，想揭示它们背后的推理过程。

examples.en: Did you go by ferry or did you fly?
examples.zh: 你是坐渡轮去的还是坐飞机去的？

examples.en: The resulting young coral can then be displayed in the tank in Tiny Giants.
examples.zh: 培育出的幼年珊瑚随后可以在“微小巨人”展区的水箱中展出。

senses.zh: 开玩笑的；爱开玩笑的；活泼有趣的

examples.en: There is also an important role for adults in guiding children through playful learning opportunities.
examples.zh: 成年人在引导儿童把握寓教于乐的学习机会方面也扮演着重要角色。

examples.en: Cultural anthropology — or social anthropology — analyses human culture and society.
examples.zh: 文化人类学——或称社会人类学——分析人类文化与社会。

examples.en: Knowing the width of Earth's orbit, the parallax shift lets astronomers calculate the distance.
examples.zh: 知道地球轨道的宽度后，视差偏移就能让天文学家计算出距离。

examples.en: After graduating he moved to Sydney and worked as a freelance pianist and composer.
examples.zh: 毕业后他搬到了悉尼，成为一名自由钢琴家和作曲家。

examples.en: 'If ranchers don't have a dead cow, they will not make a call to apply for a permit to kill a wolf.'
examples.zh: “如果牧场主没有死牛，他们就不会打电话申请猎杀狼的许可证。”

examples.en: Just a tenth of a gram of nickel in the furnace can create up to 50,000 crystals.
examples.zh: 熔炉中仅十分之一克的镍就能产生多达50,000颗晶体。

examples.en: 'Like much research into ageing, these results support common sense,' says Seeman.
examples.zh: “就像许多关于衰老的研究一样，这些结果印证了常识，”西曼说道。

examples.en: The sap that comes out of the trees consists of 98 percent water and 2 percent sugar and other nutrients.
examples.zh: 从树中流出的树液由98%的水以及2%的糖分和其他营养物质组成。

examples.en: The concept of indoor farming is not new, since hothouse production of tomatoes and other produce has been in vogue for some time.
examples.zh: 室内农业的概念并不新鲜，因为番茄和其他农产品的温室生产已经流行了一段时间。

examples.en: The deep sea contains more nickel, cobalt and rare earth metals than all land reserves combined, according to the US Geological Survey.
examples.zh: 根据美国地质调查局的数据，深海中所含的镍、钴和稀土金属比陆地所有储量的总和还要多。

examples.en: 'The possibility certainly existed that it was a kite,' he says.
examples.zh: “它当然有可能是风筝，”他说道。

examples.en: Traditionally, the animals came from pounds and private breeders.
examples.zh: 传统上，这些动物来自收容所和私人繁育者。

examples.en: Not surprisingly, linguists doubt that any native speakers of Navajo will remain in a hundred years’ time.
examples.zh: 毫不奇怪，语言学家怀疑一百年后是否还会有纳瓦霍语母语者留存。

examples.en: State promises to provide more up-to-date engines, planes, and helicopters to fight fires have been fulfilled.
examples.zh: 州政府关于提供更先进的消防车、飞机和直升机来灭火的承诺已经兑现。

examples.en: We deliberately keep the parties small in size to minimize disruption to people and landscape.
examples.zh: 我们刻意保持小规模团队，以尽量减少对当地居民和自然景观的干扰。

examples.en: Finding the right premises is the real secret.
examples.zh: 找到合适的经营场所才是真正的秘诀。

examples.en: Over 99% of dissolving agents used in the manufacturing process are used again.
examples.zh: 生产过程中使用的溶解剂有99%以上都会被循环利用。

examples.en: Professor Regelson advocates the use of melatonin for treating sleep disorders.
examples.zh: 雷格尔森教授提倡使用褪黑素来治疗睡眠障碍。

examples.en: There'll be lifeguards on duty, so it's suitable for all ages.
examples.zh: 届时将有救生员值班，因此适合所有年龄段的人。

examples.en: Some players I have met take a dissenting stance toward the robots too, believing that accuracy is not the answer.
examples.zh: 我遇到的一些球员也对机器人持反对态度，认为精准度并非解决之道。

examples.en: You must make your complaint within three months of the ending of the 14-day notice period.
examples.zh: 你必须在14天通知期结束后的三个月内提出投诉。

examples.en: We aim to develop compounds that fool cells into activating maintenance and repair.
examples.zh: 我们的目标是开发出能骗过细胞、使其激活维护和修复机制的化合物。

examples.en: Doing makeup for special effects is highly specialised, so don't expect to be offered any practical experience in that.
examples.zh: 特效化妆具有高度专业性，所以不要指望能在这方面获得任何实践经验。

examples.en: The team will also ask what aspect of education helped people engage more with productive and innovative activities.
examples.zh: 该团队还将探究教育的哪个方面帮助人们更多地参与富有成效和创新性的活动。

examples.en: There's a couple of other talks - one giving advice about how to avoid injuries while doing exercise.
examples.zh: 还有另外两场讲座——其中一场是关于如何在运动时避免受伤的建议。

examples.en: There's a kind of shelf there above the sink.
examples.zh: 水槽上方有一个类似架子的东西。

examples.en: The garments will be judged by a panel of experts and fashion designers, and the winning entries will be modelled at a special gala evening.
examples.zh: 这些服装将由专家和时装设计师组成的评审团进行评判，获奖作品将在特别晚会上由模特展示。

examples.en: Yes, it's very effective, but that's precisely why it's not used as a dye.
examples.zh: 是的，它非常有效，但这恰恰是它不被用作染料的原因。

examples.en: In fact, the longer the children had attended the noisy schools, the more distractible they became.
examples.zh: 事实上，孩子们在嘈杂的学校就读时间越长，注意力就越容易分散。

examples.en: Aside from the implementation problem, the original growth mindset research has also received harsh criticism.
examples.zh: 除了实施方面的问题，最初的成长型思维研究也受到了严厉的批评。

examples.en: The trouble is, excessive tourism is destroying the beauty spots and places of interest that people come to visit.
examples.zh: 问题在于，过度旅游正在破坏人们慕名而来的风景名胜和名胜古迹。

examples.en: The Centre itself is a huge complex that caters for a great range of arts.
examples.zh: 该中心本身是一个庞大的建筑群，能够满足各类艺术活动的需求。

examples.en: We have a bookshop, which specialises in books about drama, and that attracts plenty of customers.
examples.zh: 我们有一家书店，专门经营戏剧类书籍，吸引了大量顾客。

examples.en: At the outset of the new millennium, however, the way resource planners think about water is beginning to change.
examples.zh: 然而，在新千年伊始，资源规划者思考水资源的方式开始发生转变。

examples.en: In the Roman era, wealthy aristocrats and high government officials also travelled for pleasure.
examples.zh: 在古罗马时代，富有的贵族和政府高官也会为了消遣而旅行。

examples.en: During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, the entire site became covered with a layer of hard grey clay, which minimised further erosion.
examples.zh: 在17和18世纪期间，整个遗址被一层坚硬的灰色黏土所覆盖，从而将进一步的侵蚀降到了最低。

examples.en: If you hear 'can', you will likely activate words like 'candy' and 'candle' as well, at least during the earlier stages of word recognition.
examples.zh: 如果你听到“can”，你很可能会同时激活像“candy”和“candle”这样的词，至少在词汇识别的早期阶段是如此。

examples.en: During the industrial revolution and population explosion of the 19th and 20th centuries, the demand for water rose dramatically.
examples.zh: 在19和20世纪的工业革命和人口爆炸期间，对水的需求急剧上升。

senses.zh: 外国的；在国外的；对外的

examples.en: For several years now, tourism has been the prime source of foreign exchange in Nepal and Bhutan.
examples.zh: 好几年来，旅游业一直是尼泊尔和不丹的主要外汇来源。

examples.en: In most of the houses several families lived together in circumstances beyond our imagination.
examples.zh: 在大多数房屋里，好几户人家共同生活在超乎我们想象的环境中。

examples.en: Douglass even recorded various types of laughter, as well as mixtures of laughter from men, women, and children.
examples.zh: 道格拉斯甚至录制了各种类型的笑声，以及男人、女人和孩子混合在一起的笑声。

examples.en: Though the practical need for a common language will diminish, the social value of sharing one will persist.
examples.zh: 尽管对通用语言的实际需求将会减弱，但共享一门语言的社会价值仍将存在。

examples.en: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a suitable alternative.
examples.zh: 如果您的孩子有任何过敏情况，请告知我们，我们将确保为他们提供合适的替代品。

examples.en: If resistance to goals is expected, the use of participation in goal-setting should increase acceptance.
examples.zh: 如果预计会对目标产生抵触情绪，采用参与式目标设定应当能提高接受度。

examples.en: The colour is more or less the same, but the appearance of the mane is different - that's the hair around the lion's face and neck.
examples.zh: 颜色大致相同，但鬃毛的外观不同——也就是狮子面部和颈部周围的毛发。

examples.en: As far as I'm concerned, what I love most is the concentration you need to make a good pot.
examples.zh: 就我而言，我最喜欢的是制作一口好陶罐所需的专注力。

examples.en: For a start, it can include a lot of other mental states, such as frustration, apathy, depression and indifference.
examples.zh: 首先，它可以包含许多其他心理状态，例如挫败感、冷漠、抑郁和漠不关心。

examples.en: From this, regular players develop a memory for the patterns the pieces make, the defences and attacks.
examples.zh: 由此，常下棋的棋手会对棋子形成的格局、防守和进攻产生记忆。

examples.en: In an essay we'd focus on the poetry and Shakespeare's use of imagery etc., but that isn't really relevant in a review.
examples.zh: 在论文中，我们会侧重于诗歌以及莎士比亚对意象的运用等，但在剧评中这些其实并不重要。

examples.en: I went there in 1993 just after graduating from university.
examples.zh: 我是1993年刚从大学毕业就去那里的。

examples.en: The best way to see things differently to other people is to bombard the brain with things it has never encouraged before.
examples.zh: 要想以不同于他人的方式看待事物，最好的办法就是用大脑从未接触过的事物去冲击它。

examples.en: Follow your supervisor's lead and try to remain calm at all times.
examples.zh: 听从主管的指挥，并设法在任何时候都保持冷静。

examples.en: We need radical changes, to make it healthier, more enjoyable, and less environmentally damaging to travel around cities.
examples.zh: 我们需要彻底的变革，让城市出行变得更健康、更愉快，并对环境的破坏更小。

examples.en: You can find that in a small L-shaped building in the middle of the northern boundary of the site.
examples.zh: 你可以在场地北边界中段的一座小型L形建筑里找到它。

examples.en: King Street is for local commuter lines and regional services.
examples.zh: 国王街用于本地通勤线路和区域交通服务。

examples.en: If concrete is the only answer to the construction of new cities, then carbon emissions will soar, aggravating global warming.
examples.zh: 如果混凝土是建设新城市的唯一答案，那么碳排放量将会飙升，从而加剧全球变暖。

examples.en: Some cows had been treated with antibiotics, so their milk wasn't suitable for human consumption, and it had to be put in a separate container.
examples.zh: 有些奶牛接受了抗生素治疗，因此它们的牛奶不适合人类饮用，必须装在单独的容器里。

examples.en: More typically, the advantages are real enough, but there are also disadvantages that have been overlooked.
examples.zh: 更常见的情况是，优势确实存在，但也有一些劣势被忽视了。

examples.en: As the fruit matures, the coconut water gradually solidifies to form the brilliant white, fat-rich, edible flesh or meat.
examples.zh: 随着果实成熟，椰子水逐渐凝固，形成洁白、富含脂肪的可食用果肉。

examples.en: For women educated in primary school, however, the infant mortality rate was significantly lower, at 80 per thousand.
examples.zh: 然而,对于受过小学教育的女性,婴儿死亡率明显较低,为每千人80例。

examples.en: Alternative medicine appears to be an adjunct sought in times of disenchantment when conventional medicine seems not to offer the answer.
examples.zh: 当传统医学似乎无法提供解决方案、人们感到失望时，替代医学似乎成了一种寻求辅助的手段。

examples.en: Maybe just look at the effects of one supplement, like sugar, on the health of the mice?
examples.zh: 也许只观察一种补充剂（比如糖）对小鼠健康的影响？

examples.en: When we distribute bikes overseas we don't give them away for free.
examples.zh: 当我们向海外分发自行车时，并不是免费赠送的。

examples.en: In April 2002 an event took place which demonstrated one of the many applications of information theory.
examples.zh: 2002年4月发生了一起事件，展示了信息论的众多应用之一。

examples.en: Once machines are better than us at designing even smarter machines, progress towards these limits could accelerate.
examples.zh: 一旦机器比我们更擅长设计出更智能的机器，逼近这些极限的进程可能会加速。

examples.en: On 24 July they were a few days into their descent of the valley.
examples.zh: 7月24日，他们向山谷下撤已有几天了。

examples.en: Kant and Freud felt that joke-telling relies on building up a psychic tension which is safely punctured by the ludicrousness of the punchline.
examples.zh: 康德和弗洛伊德认为，讲笑话依赖于积聚心理紧张感，而妙语的荒谬性则会安全地释放这种紧张感。

examples.en: Tons of carbon have been stripped from the world's soils - where it's needed - and pumped into the atmosphere.
examples.zh: 成吨的碳从本需要它的全球土壤中被剥离，并被排入大气层。

examples.en: I like reading and going to the movies.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读书和看电影。

examples.en: We prefer to integrate reading with the course, so we don't give out a reading list in advance.
examples.zh: 我们倾向于将阅读与课程结合起来，因此不会提前发放阅读书单。

examples.en: Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.
examples.zh: 其他发现包括用当地开采的铜制成的小件首饰。

examples.en: On Wednesday afternoon, the director of the play we're going to see that evening will talk to us at the theatre.
examples.zh: 周三下午，我们当晚要看的那部戏的导演将在剧院与我们交流。

examples.en: Everybody wanted nutmeg, and many were willing to spare no expense to have it.
examples.zh: 每个人都想要肉豆蔻，而且许多人愿意不惜一切代价得到它。

examples.en: While the food frozen this way was still palatable, there was some deterioration.
examples.zh: 虽然用这种方式冷冻的食物仍然可口，但品质有所下降。

examples.en: Many visitors find walking a labyrinth less stressful than sitting in a corridor or waiting room.
examples.zh: 许多访客发现，走迷宫比坐在走廊或候诊室里压力更小。

examples.en: Some scientists doubt the value of traditional knowledge because the occupation of the Arctic doesn't go back far enough.
examples.zh: 一些科学家怀疑传统知识的价值，因为人类在北极居住的历史还不够久远。

examples.en: We are open from 7:30 in the morning until 6 o'clock at night.
examples.zh: 我们的营业时间是早上7点30分到晚上6点整。

examples.en: We already teach a number of pupils to use the sound and lighting systems in the centre.
examples.zh: 我们已经在教一些学生使用中心的音响和照明系统了。

examples.en: The Wheel consists of two sets of opposing axe-shaped arms, attached about 25 metres apart to a fixed central spine.
examples.zh: 法尔科克轮由两组相对的斧形吊臂组成，相距约25米固定在一根中央主轴上。

examples.en: Participants had their brains scanned using functional magnetic resonance imaging at the beginning and end of the trial.
examples.zh: 在试验开始和结束时，研究人员使用功能性磁共振成像对参与者的大脑进行了扫描。

examples.en: There are three main types of habitat: wetland, grassland and woodland.
examples.zh: 这里有三种主要的栖息地类型：湿地、草地和林地。

examples.en: My background in IT's been useful here, and I can use my expertise to help other volunteers.
examples.zh: 我的IT背景在这里很有用，我可以用自己的专业知识帮助其他志愿者。

examples.en: An example of this might be scoring athletes against their peers to create a sense of competition.
examples.zh: 这方面的一个例子是给运动员与同龄人打分对比，以营造竞争感。

examples.en: One or more of the tour guides will welcome you there and brief you about what the tour will be about.
examples.zh: 一两位导游会在那里欢迎你们，并向你们简要介绍这次游览的内容。

examples.en: In 1880, clubs began to charge fans for admission to games, even though players were still amateurs and had other proper jobs.
examples.zh: 1880年，俱乐部开始向球迷收取比赛门票，尽管当时球员仍是业余性质，且另有正式工作。

examples.en: Manatees have pectoral flippers but no back limbs, only a tail for propulsion.
examples.zh: 海牛有胸鳍但没有后肢，只有一条用于推进的尾巴。

examples.en: We really do think of every essential detail, from an oven and cooking rings fuelled by bottled gas, to mirrors in the bedroom areas.
examples.zh: 我们确实考虑到了每一个重要细节，从以瓶装煤气为燃料的烤箱和炉灶，到卧室区域的镜子。

examples.en: On Tuesday evening, we'll all have dinner together in a restaurant near our hotel.
examples.zh: 周二晚上，我们大家将在酒店附近的一家餐厅共进晚餐。

examples.en: I have to get an extension to my permit.
examples.zh: 我得去给我的许可证办理延期。

examples.en: We've also got all the local papers and a wide selection of magazines.
examples.zh: 我们这里还有所有的当地报纸以及种类繁多的杂志。

examples.en: The company definitely needs a boost and to attract more highly skilled workers if their recovery is to be long-lasting.
examples.zh: 如果想要实现持久复苏，这家公司无疑需要注入活力，并吸引更多高技能人才。

examples.en: The Canadian Arctic is a vast, treeless polar desert that's covered with snow for most of the year.
examples.zh: 加拿大北极地区是一片广阔无树的极地荒漠，一年中大部分时间都被冰雪覆盖。

examples.en: Most ancient cultures had weather gods, and weather catastrophes, such as floods, played an important role in many creation myths.
examples.zh: 大多数古代文化都有气象神，而像洪水这样的气象灾害在许多创世神话中都扮演着重要角色。

senses.zh: 见多识广的；品位高雅的

examples.en: Human beings are the only species to perform sophisticated creative acts regularly.
examples.zh: 人类是唯一经常进行复杂创造性活动的物种。

examples.en: New Zealand is a small country with a visitor economy composed mainly of small businesses.
examples.zh: 新西兰是一个小国，其旅游经济主要由小型企业构成。

examples.en: The contraption looked like a large black pizza box with one glowing green eye; it was mounted above the press stand.
examples.zh: 这个装置看起来像一个大号黑色披萨盒，上面有一只发光的绿眼睛；它被安装在记者席上方。

examples.en: The demand for skrei has been used by a food marketing agency to build the reputation of Norway's fisheries in general.
examples.zh: 一家食品营销机构利用人们对北极鳕鱼的需求，树立起了挪威渔业的整体声誉。

examples.en: We also have a new location for the cricket pitch.
examples.zh: 我们还有一个新的板球场场地。

examples.en: Petrie believes that archaeologists are in a unique position to investigate how past societies responded to environmental and climatic change.
examples.zh: 皮特里认为，考古学家具有独特的优势，能够研究过去的社会是如何应对环境和气候变化的。

examples.en: The rocket site is providing precise measurements of lightning voltages and allowing engineers to check how electrical equipment bears up.
examples.zh: 火箭发射场正在提供闪电电压的精确测量数据，并让工程师能够检查电气设备的承受能力。

examples.en: Textbooks usually cover so many topics, it can be very difficult to choose just one.
examples.zh: 教科书通常涵盖太多主题，要想只选出一个可能会非常困难。

examples.en: Rent is £60 per week inclusive of bills (except telephone).
examples.zh: 租金为每周60英镑，包含各项水电杂费（电话费除外）。

senses.zh: 辅导课；个别指导；辅导教师的

examples.en: I don't think I'm on the same wavelength as mine, so I feel I'm not getting anything out of the tutorials.
examples.zh: 我觉得自己和导师合不来，所以感觉从辅导课中毫无收获。

examples.en: I should have a look at the menu to check there's a good choice of vegetarian dishes.
examples.zh: 我应该看一看菜单，确认是否有丰富的素食菜品可供选择。

examples.en: I hope you're happy running up and down stairs!
examples.zh: 希望你喜欢上下跑楼梯！

examples.en: The clearance of peatlands for planting also increases the risk of forest fires, which release huge amounts of CO2.
examples.zh: 为种植而清理泥炭地也会增加森林火灾的风险，从而释放出大量的二氧化碳。

examples.en: The most advanced industry for much of the 19th century was textiles.
examples.zh: 在19世纪的大部分时间里，最先进的产业是纺织业。

examples.en: Retrieving information from episodic memory depends upon semantic, olfactory, auditory and visual factors.
examples.zh: 从情景记忆中提取信息取决于语义、嗅觉、听觉和视觉因素。

examples.en: Soon, treated, recycled water will account for most farm irrigation there.
examples.zh: 很快，经过处理的再生水将占到那里农田灌溉用水的大部分。

examples.en: I don't like the idea of staying in a tent.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢住帐篷的想法。

examples.en: In fact, archaeological finds from that period are rare all over Norway.
examples.zh: 事实上，那个时期的考古发现在整个挪威都很罕见。

senses.zh: 表现出某种水平的人或事物

examples.en: You were saying that recognition of good performers is essential.
examples.zh: 你刚才说，对优秀员工的认可至关重要。

examples.en: The attempt to reintroduce this predator marries well with the aim of bringing forests back to parts of our bare and barren uplands.
examples.zh: 重新引入这种捕食者的尝试,与让森林重返光秃荒凉的高地的目标十分契合。

examples.en: In particular, the effects of noisy classrooms and activities on those experiencing disabilities in the form of auditory function deficit need thorough investigation.
examples.zh: 特别是嘈杂的教室和活动对患有听觉功能缺陷等残障的学生所产生的影响，需要深入调查。

examples.en: Many researchers now think that these were pictures the wise men engraved of themselves.
examples.zh: 许多研究人员现在认为，这些是智者为自己雕刻的画像。

examples.en: Our society has created a false dichotomy between play and learning.
examples.zh: 我们的社会在玩耍和学习之间制造了一种错误的二元对立。

examples.en: There's a charge of £35, including lunch, or £40 if you want to camp in the wood.
examples.zh: 费用为35英镑（含午餐），如果你想在树林里露营则为40英镑。

examples.en: Did you have any idea how many calories they contain?
examples.zh: 你知道它们含有多少卡路里吗？

examples.en: There is evidence that all modern turtles are descended from a terrestrial ancestor which lived before most of the dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 有证据表明，所有现代龟类都起源于一种生活在大多数恐龙之前的陆生祖先。

examples.en: The Neolithic farmers at Céide would have enjoyed several centuries of relative peace and stability.
examples.zh: 凯德田野的新石器时代农民理应享受了几个世纪相对和平与稳定的生活。

examples.en: Today, I want to talk about self-regulatory focus theory and how the actions of leaders can affect the way followers approach different situations.
examples.zh: 今天，我想谈谈自我调节焦点理论，以及领导者的行为如何影响追随者应对不同情况的方式。

examples.en: Float sessions uniquely decreased activity in the default mode network (DMN), a collection of brain regions commonly linked with depression.
examples.zh: 漂浮疗程独特地降低了默认模式网络（DMN，一组通常与抑郁症相关的脑区）的活动。

examples.en: Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps.
examples.zh: 考古发现包括短颈球形器皿、大口杯和碗，其中许多都带有装饰性印纹。

examples.en: Researchers joked that AI stood for 'almost implemented'.
examples.zh: 研究人员开玩笑说，AI代表“几乎实现（almost implemented）”。

examples.en: We invested fifteen of the seventy-five-thousand-pound prize money to help secure our future.
examples.zh: 我们投资了7.5万英镑奖金中的1.5万英镑，以帮助保障我们的未来。

examples.en: I had no idea that loneliness has been increasing steadily for the last 20 years.
examples.zh: 我完全没想到，在过去20年里，孤独感一直在稳步增加。

examples.en: Mann concluded that a passive, boring activity is best for creativity because it allows the mind to wander.
examples.zh: 曼恩总结道，被动、无聊的活动最有利于激发创造力，因为它能让思绪自由游走。

examples.en: Each chapter offers practice in following a sustained and closely argued line of thought.
examples.zh: 每一章都提供练习，帮助读者理解连贯且论证严密的思路。

examples.en: If you'd like to read about how the preparations for the festival are going, the festival organiser is keeping a blog.
examples.zh: 如果你想了解艺术节筹备工作的进展情况，艺术节组织者正在更新博客。

examples.en: The breeding season of some plants can be delayed to extraordinary lengths.
examples.zh: 有些植物的繁殖期可以推迟极长的时间。

examples.en: My name's Lou Miller and I'm going to be your tour guide today as we take this fantastic boat trip around the Tasmanian coast.
examples.zh: 我叫卢·米勒，今天由我担任大家的导游，带大家进行这次环塔斯马尼亚海岸的奇妙乘船之旅。

examples.en: For a food item to become really popular, it has to be readily available.
examples.zh: 一种食品要想真正流行起来，就必须容易买到。

examples.en: The false doors and the trench were incorporated into the complex to discourage unwanted visitors.
examples.zh: 假门和壕沟被融入该建筑群中，以阻吓不速之客。

examples.en: I suppose this isn't surprising, given that tardigrades are mainly comprised of liquid and are coated with a type of gel.
examples.zh: 我想这并不奇怪，因为水熊虫主要由液体构成，且表面覆有一层凝胶。

examples.en: The railway company applied for permission to replace it with a multi-storey car park, but that was refused.
examples.zh: 铁路公司申请许可将其改建为多层停车场，但遭到了拒绝。

examples.en: There's also an interesting comparison to make between 18th and 19th century programs.
examples.zh: 在18世纪和19世纪的节目单之间，也可以做一个有趣的对比。

examples.en: In 67 BCE, a new law granted Pompey vast funds to combat the Mediterranean menace.
examples.zh: 公元前67年，一项新法律授予庞培巨额资金，以打击地中海的海盗威胁。

examples.en: When we experience stressful events, a physiological change is triggered that causes us to take in warnings and focus on what might go wrong.
examples.zh: 当我们经历压力事件时，会触发一种生理变化，促使我们留意警告并关注可能出错的地方。

examples.en: The financial crisis stimulated a debate about the role and purpose of the company and a heightened awareness of corporate ethics.
examples.zh: 金融危机激发了关于公司角色与宗旨的辩论，并提高了人们对企业道德的意识。

examples.en: This means a widespread reintroduction would involve existing or new hybrid strains derived from resistant, generally non-native elm species.
examples.zh: 这意味着大规模重新引入将涉及由抗病（通常为非本土）榆树物种培育出的现有或新型杂交品系。

examples.en: The discussion about the future of work was really optimistic for a change.
examples.zh: 关于未来工作的讨论难得地非常乐观。

examples.en: Perfect - hopefully I won't even have to go to the supermarket!
examples.zh: 太棒了——希望我甚至都不用去超市了！

examples.en: I spoke to you last week about enrolling my daughter for next year.
examples.zh: 我上周跟您谈过为我女儿报名明年入学的事。

examples.en: The lecturers must set aside certain times every week when they're available for students.
examples.zh: 讲师每周必须留出特定的时间来为学生答疑。

examples.en: The exact method used will depend on the final purpose of the collections.
examples.zh: 所使用的确切方法将取决于这些采集物的最终用途。

examples.en: Yet in museums, fine period rooms give only an image of the lifestyle of the upper class of that era.
examples.zh: 然而在博物馆里，精美的历史时期展厅仅展示了那个时代上流社会的生活方式。

examples.en: You certainly wouldn't want to pay more than 900 pounds.
examples.zh: 你肯定不想付超过900英镑。

examples.en: In total, the house construction has released 70 tons of carbon dioxide into the air.
examples.zh: 总体而言，房屋建造已向空气中释放了70吨二氧化碳。

examples.en: More often than not, data is spread across different government departments that each require special permissions to be accessed.
examples.zh: 通常情况下，数据分散在不同的政府部门，每个部门都需要特殊许可才能访问。

examples.en: The district did not flourish for much longer, and during the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries factories closed down.
examples.zh: 该地区没能繁荣太久，在19世纪和20世纪初，工厂纷纷倒闭。

examples.en: In fact, no one really knows when knitting first began, but archaeological remains have disclosed plenty of information for us to think about.
examples.zh: 事实上，没人真正知道编织是什么时候开始的，但考古遗迹已经揭示了大量供我们思考的信息。

examples.en: To many, the costs may not even appear to be financial at all, but merely aesthetic - a terrible shame, but nothing to do with money.
examples.zh: 对许多人来说，这些代价甚至看起来完全不是经济上的，而仅仅是审美上的——非常可惜，但与金钱无关。

examples.en: The concept is of multi-storey buildings in which food crops are grown in environmentally controlled conditions.
examples.zh: 这一概念是指在多层建筑中，在受控的环境条件下种植粮食作物。

examples.en: I've done a great many expeditions and each one was unique.
examples.zh: 我参加过许多次探险，每一次都是独一无二的。

senses.zh: 最精彩或最重要的部分

examples.en: They had a video with all the highlights of the festival at a stand in the lobby to the library, so I heard them.
examples.zh: 他们在图书馆大厅的展台播放了一段包含艺术节所有精彩片段的视频，所以我听到了他们的演奏。

examples.en: The woods are well established and varied, with an oak plantation, and other areas of mixed species.
examples.zh: 这片树林生长良好且种类多样，有一片橡树林以及其他混交林区。

examples.en: Historical records make statements, offer opinions and pass judgments.
examples.zh: 历史记录会作出陈述、提出观点并下达评判。

examples.en: The design of Bakelite objects, everything from earrings to television sets, was governed to a large extent by the technical requirements of the moulding process.
examples.zh: 酚醛塑料制品（从耳环到电视机的一切物品）的设计，在很大程度上受到模塑工艺技术要求的制约。

examples.en: The two stood side by side, a powerful symbol of the regeneration of an ancient species.
examples.zh: 这两棵树并肩而立，成为一个古老物种重获新生的有力象征。

examples.en: In the first light phase, the heart rate and blood pressure go down and the muscles relax.
examples.zh: 在第一个浅睡阶段，心率和血压下降，肌肉放松。

examples.en: Excavated vessels also provide some clues about ancient shipbuilding techniques.
examples.zh: 出土的船只也为古代造船技术提供了一些线索。

examples.en: Not only are the physical demands greater than most people could handle, athletes also face intense psychological pressure during competition.
examples.zh: 运动员不仅要应对常人难以承受的体能要求，在比赛期间还要面临巨大的心理压力。

examples.en: We knew it was an important building because it had two rows of post holes deep enough to support a large roof.
examples.zh: 我们知道那是一座重要的建筑，因为它有两排柱洞，深度足以支撑一个大屋顶。

examples.en: Storminess increased in the North Atlantic and North Sea.
examples.zh: 北大西洋和北海的风暴天气有所增加。

examples.en: In 1815, a sudden blast removed the top 1,280 meters of Mount Tambora in Indonesia.
examples.zh: 1815年，一次突如其来的剧烈喷发削去了印度尼西亚坦博拉火山顶部1280米的山体。

examples.en: I stopped worrying about not being able to understand all the words and focused on the actors' expressions.
examples.zh: 我不再担心听不懂所有的台词，而是把注意力集中在演员的表情上。

examples.en: ‘Many athletes are not getting the best nutrition, even through supplements,’ Yessis insists.
examples.zh: “许多运动员甚至通过营养补充剂也未能摄取最佳营养，”耶西斯坚称。

examples.en: I guess he treasures things like first editions and other rare books.
examples.zh: 我猜他珍视像初版本和其他珍稀书籍之类的东西。

examples.en: The one that is ultimately chosen is simply the brain's best theory.
examples.zh: 最终被选中的那个，只不过是大脑得出的最佳推论。

examples.en: There's central heating, and if you want to light a fire, there's a stove.
examples.zh: 这里有中央供暖系统，如果你想生火，还有一个火炉。

examples.en: In the same way, random, arbitrary or accidental mutations of ideas may help pave the way for advances in science.
examples.zh: 同样，随机、任意或偶然的想法突变，或许有助于为科学进步铺平道路。

examples.en: To him, exploration meant bringing back information from a remote place regardless of any great self-discovery.
examples.zh: 对他而言，探险意味着从偏远地区带回信息，无论是否有任何重大的自我发现。

examples.en: Pay cuts, unheard of during times of growth, may even be imposed.
examples.zh: 在经济增长时期闻所未闻的降薪，甚至也可能会被强制推行。

examples.en: Many farmers have seized the opportunity to maximise the planting of oil palm trees.
examples.zh: 许多农民抓住机会，最大限度地扩大油棕树的种植规模。

examples.en: I'd like to find out about sailing courses for beginners.
examples.zh: 我想了解一下针对初学者的帆船课程。

examples.en: We'd love to be able to close our road for longer - for the whole weekend, from Saturday morning until Sunday evening, for example.
examples.zh: 我们很希望能把这条路封闭更长时间——例如封闭整个周末，从周六早上一直到周日晚上。

examples.en: I'm hoping I can persuade one or two of you to become volunteers yourselves.
examples.zh: 我希望能够说服你们中的一两个人也成为志愿者。

examples.en: Distance therefore poses no obstacle to the globalisation of the disk-drive industry.
examples.zh: 因此，距离对磁盘驱动器产业的全球化并不构成障碍。

examples.en: One freight barge can replace 44 large trucks, uses far less energy, and causes less pollution.
examples.zh: 一艘货运驳船可以替代44辆大型卡车，能耗少得多，造成的污染也更少。

examples.en: Occasionally, a bubble is not removed during refining, a sand grain refuses to melt, a tremor in the tin puts ripples into the glass ribbon.
examples.zh: 偶尔，精炼过程中会有气泡未被消除，沙粒未能融化，或者锡液的震动在玻璃带上留下波纹。

examples.en: I'm his wife, Shirley, and we own the cottages together, so I'm sure I can help you.
examples.zh: 我是他的妻子雪莉，我们共同拥有这些度假小屋，所以我相信我能帮到你。

examples.en: If you look out here to the south, you can see a circular ornamental pond.
examples.zh: 如果你往南边看，可以看到一个圆形的观赏池塘。

examples.en: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there, and it was far too crowded.
examples.zh: 我带孩子们去那里看了关于旧电脑的展览，人实在太多太拥挤了。

examples.en: Go straight on and keep going till the path bends to the left.
examples.zh: 一直往前走，直到小路向左拐弯。

examples.en: The bathroom is too small for a bath, so there's a shower instead.
examples.zh: 浴室太小放不下浴缸，所以改用了淋浴。

examples.en: Halley was aware that the AU was one of the most fundamental of all astronomical measurements.
examples.zh: 哈雷意识到，天文单位（AU）是所有天文测量中最基础的数据之一。

senses.zh: 变化无常的；方向不定的；时多时少的

examples.en: At first I couldn't decide on my variables.
examples.zh: 起初我无法确定我的变量。

senses.zh: 企业；事业；有风险的计划

examples.en: As the entrepreneurs gain experience, the enterprises can be gradually expanded and consideration can be given to increasing loan amounts.
examples.zh: 随着创业者积累经验，企业可以逐步扩大规模，并可以考虑增加贷款额度。

examples.en: Your team may have lots of ideas too, but you've got to make the ultimate choices.
examples.zh: 你的团队可能也有很多想法，但你必须做出最终选择。

examples.en: There they found numerous artefacts, including fragments of axes, some dating to about 14,000 years ago.
examples.zh: 他们在那里发现了许多人工制品，包括斧头碎片，其中一些可追溯到大约14,000年前。

examples.en: Any member found removing company property from the building without proper authority will be subject to disciplinary action.
examples.zh: 任何成员如被发现未经适当授权将公司财物带出大楼，将受到纪律处分。

examples.en: What's more, administering oxytocin also has sharply contrasting outcomes depending on a person's disposition.
examples.zh: 此外，施用催产素还会因个人性情的不同而产生截然相反的结果。

examples.en: For each month of employment, workers are entitled to one twelfth of the annual holiday.
examples.zh: 每工作一个月，员工就有权享有年假的十二分之一。

examples.en: Over time, however, world output has shifted into goods whose worth is unrelated to their size and weight.
examples.zh: 然而随着时间的推移，全球产出已转向那些价值与其体积和重量无关的商品。

examples.en: You have to do some training before you're allowed to touch sharp objects.
examples.zh: 你必须先接受一些培训，才被允许接触锋利的物品。

examples.en: Only when many studies are combined in a meta-analysis will the faint signal of telepathy really become apparent.
examples.zh: 只有当多项研究在元分析中结合起来时，心灵感应的微弱信号才会真正显现出来。

examples.en: If you use a personal computer, there are plenty of guidelines available from the government on posture, angles, lighting and the like.
examples.zh: 如果你使用个人电脑，政府提供了许多关于坐姿、角度、照明等方面的指南。

examples.en: As the anthropologist Bruce Knauft has remarked, hunter-gatherers are characterised by 'extreme political and sexual egalitarianism'.
examples.zh: 正如人类学家布鲁斯·克瑙夫特所言，狩猎采集者的特征是“极度的政治和性别平等主义”。

examples.en: I'm interested in journalism, and I quite like the idea of moving to Scandinavia and writing for magazines.
examples.zh: 我对新闻业很感兴趣，而且我很喜欢搬到斯堪的纳维亚半岛为杂志撰稿的想法。

examples.en: I need to book somewhere to celebrate my sister's 30th birthday.
examples.zh: 我需要预订一个地方来庆祝我姐姐的30岁生日。

examples.en: Since the tests were introduced, AIS athletes in all sports have been remarkably successful at staying healthy.
examples.zh: 自引入这些测试以来，澳大利亚体育学院（AIS）所有项目的运动员在保持健康方面都取得了显著成效。

examples.en: I had some things stolen out of my bag yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我包里有一些东西被偷了。

examples.en: I was interested by the effect of the audience at a musical performance when it came to the choice of dress.
examples.zh: 我对音乐演出中观众对演出服选择的影响很感兴趣。

examples.en: I think we're going to see a greater emphasis within companies on teams created with a specific project in mind.
examples.zh: 我认为我们将看到公司内部更加重视为特定项目而组建的团队。

examples.en: One of the most intriguing manuscripts from Qumran, this is a sort of ancient treasure map that lists dozens of gold and silver caches.
examples.zh: 这是库姆兰最引人入胜的手稿之一，算是一份古代藏宝图，列出了数十处金银藏匿点。

examples.en: Local authorities are not always open to discussion about the future of premises.
examples.zh: 地方当局并不总是愿意就经营场所的未来进行讨论。

examples.en: Brick walls were then constructed, and finally a brick arch was added to create a tunnel.
examples.zh: 随后砌起砖墙，最后加上砖拱，从而建成了隧道。

examples.en: Using alternative fuels and improving energy efficiency is thus both an ecological necessity and a technological challenge.
examples.zh: 因此，使用替代燃料和提高能源效率既是生态上的必然要求，也是技术上的挑战。

examples.en: We have lots of fascinating indoor and outdoor exhibits on our huge complex, spreading hundreds of hectares.
examples.zh: 我们庞大的园区占地数百公顷，拥有许多引人入胜的室内外展品。

examples.en: I'd love to have a bookshop like your grandfather.
examples.zh: 我很想拥有一家像你祖父那样的书店。

examples.en: There are very few times when you'll be bored or have nothing to do.
examples.zh: 你很少会有感到无聊或无事可做的时候。

examples.en: In the battle for control of the industry, it was inevitably the poor countries which came off worse.
examples.zh: 在争夺行业控制权的较量中，处于劣势的不可避免地是贫穷国家。

examples.en: ‘Native Americans have not lost pride in their language, but they have had to adapt to socio-economic pressures,’ he says.
examples.zh: “美洲原住民并没有丧失对自己语言的自豪感，但他们不得不适应社会经济压力，”他说道。

examples.en: The type of music, patient choice and timing, before, during or after the surgery didn't make much difference.
examples.zh: 音乐的类型、患者的选择以及播放时机（术前、术中或术后）并没有太大区别。

examples.en: Day-neutral plants have an evolutionary advantage when the connection between the favourable period for reproduction and day length is much less certain.
examples.zh: 当有利繁殖期与日照长度之间的联系不那么确定时，日中性植物具有进化优势。

examples.en: There's nowhere to stay in the park itself, but there's an old trading post called Goulding quite near.
examples.zh: 公园内部没有住宿的地方，但在不远处有一个名叫古尔丁的旧贸易站。

examples.en: My job is due to start on October the 2nd, and I'm available from May the 1st until late September.
examples.zh: 我的工作定于10月2日开始，我从5月1日到9月下旬都有空。

examples.en: Epigenetic processes are chemical reactions tied to neither nature nor nurture but representing what researchers have called a 'third component'.
examples.zh: 表观遗传过程是既不完全取决于先天也不完全取决于后天的化学反应，它代表了研究人员所称的“第三要素”。

examples.en: The rising number of people meant there was a huge increase in the amount of sewage discharged into the rivers.
examples.zh: 人口的增长意味着排入河流的污水量大幅增加。

examples.en: I've been looking at how a range of natural dyes can be used to colour fabrics like cotton and wool.
examples.zh: 我一直在研究如何用各种天然染料给棉花和羊毛等织物染色。

examples.en: The borrowing period is one month, but of course books can be renewed.
examples.zh: 借阅期为一个月，但图书当然可以续借。

examples.en: The only exception is the scroll numbered 3Q15, which was created out of a combination of copper and tin.
examples.zh: 唯一的例外是编号为3Q15的卷轴，它是由铜和锡的合金制成的。

examples.en: International commerce was therefore dominated by raw materials, such as wheat, wood and iron ore, or processed commodities, such as meat and steel.
examples.zh: 因此，国际贸易由小麦、木材和铁矿石等原材料，或肉类和钢铁等加工商品所主导。

examples.en: The glow-worm belongs to a family of beetles known as the Lampyridae or fireflies.
examples.zh: 萤火虫属于鞘翅目萤科（甲虫的一科）。

examples.en: Gwendoline made her final art purchase in March 1926.
examples.zh: 格温多琳于1926年3月进行了她最后一次艺术品购置。

examples.en: The Dutch now had a monopoly over the nutmeg trade which would last for another century.
examples.zh: 荷兰人自此垄断了肉豆蔻贸易，并持续了又一个世纪。

examples.en: There's a lot we could say about what restaurants could do to reduce obesity.
examples.zh: 关于餐厅可以采取哪些措施来减少肥胖问题，我们有很多话可说。

examples.en: One such journey took just under 12 weeks, beating every other ship sailing that year by around a month.
examples.zh: 其中一次航行仅用了不到12周时间，比当年航行的所有其他船只快了大约一个月。

examples.en: Milo's is a young, dynamic company and they're really keen on creating a strong team.
examples.zh: 米洛是一家年轻、充满活力的公司，他们非常热衷于打造一支强大的团队。

examples.en: I can't remember if there's anything specifically on Greece, but I should think so.
examples.zh: 我不记得是否有专门关于希腊的内容，但我想应该有。

examples.en: In contrast, stress didn't change how they responded to good news (such as learning that the likelihood of card fraud was lower than they'd thought).
examples.zh: 相比之下，压力并没有改变他们对好消息的反应（例如得知信用卡欺诈的可能性比他们原本认为的要低）。

examples.en: Unlike episodic memory, semantic memory isn't dependent on recalling personal experiences.
examples.zh: 与情景记忆不同，语义记忆并不依赖于对个人经历的回忆。

examples.en: In observed lessons, any strugglers would be assisted by the teacher or quietly seek help from their neighbour.
examples.zh: 在观摩课上，任何跟不上的学生都会得到老师的帮助，或者悄悄向同桌求助。

examples.en: When the wood was gone and civil war began, the islanders began toppling the moai.
examples.zh: 当树木耗尽、内战爆发时，岛民们开始推倒摩艾石像。

examples.en: I'm particularly interested in that as I do it as a hobby.
examples.zh: 我对那个特别感兴趣，因为我把它当作一项业余爱好。

examples.en: A true Renaissance man, he embodied scientific spirit, artistic talent and humanist sensibilities.
examples.zh: 作为一名真正的文艺复兴全才，他集科学精神、艺术才华和人文情怀于一身。

examples.en: Plastic tubes with secure tops are better than glass because they are lighter, and do not break as easily if mishandled.
examples.zh: 带有牢固盖子的塑料管比玻璃管更好，因为它们更轻，而且如果操作不当也不容易破碎。

examples.en: As you can see, we're in the reception area, which we try to make attractive and welcoming to visitors.
examples.zh: 如你所见，我们现在位于接待区，我们设法让这里对访客更具吸引力且更加温馨。

examples.en: Please provide two identical passport photos of yourself.
examples.zh: 请提供两张完全相同的本人护照照片。

examples.en: Outward and return reservations should be made at the time of booking.
examples.zh: 去程和返程预订应在购票时一并完成。

examples.en: In New Zealand, classes for children have slowed the erosion of Maori and rekindled interest in the language.
examples.zh: 在新西兰，针对儿童开设的课程减缓了毛利语的流失，并重新燃起了人们对这门语言的兴趣。

examples.en: Neuroscience has revealed which brain circuits are responsible for functions like understanding what other people think, empathy, fairness, and social identity.
examples.zh: 神经科学已经揭示了哪些大脑回路负责诸如理解他人想法、共情、公平感和社会认同等功能。

examples.en: From childhood, Marie was remarkable for her prodigious memory, and at the age of 16 won a gold medal on completion of her secondary education.
examples.zh: 玛丽从小就以惊人的记忆力而著称，并在16岁完成中学学业时荣获一枚金质奖章。

examples.en: The locally manufactured wheelbarrows were still too expensive for all but a few of the households.
examples.zh: 当地制造的手推车仍然太贵，除了少数富裕家庭外，大多数家庭都买不起。

examples.en: On the one hand, music is a purely abstract art form, devoid of language or explicit ideas.
examples.zh: 一方面，音乐是一种纯粹抽象的艺术形式，不包含语言或明确的思想。

examples.en: Our guests usually appreciate the fact that the music can be loud enough for dancing, but not too loud for conversation.
examples.zh: 我们的客人通常很赞赏这一点：音乐声足够大，适合跳舞，但又不会太大，以至于妨碍交谈。

examples.en: Inside, a box of games and toys can be found, and children's tents can be hired if required.
examples.zh: 在里面可以找到一箱游戏和玩具，如果需要，还可以租用儿童帐篷。

examples.en: One way of making sure that the pedestrians are safe is to increase signage at the intersections.
examples.zh: 确保行人安全的一种方法是增加十字路口的指示牌。

examples.en: The Dutch allied themselves with Kandy, an inland kingdom on Ceylon.
examples.zh: 荷兰人与锡兰的内陆王国康提结盟。

examples.en: Conservationists are starting to accept that the old preservation-jar model is failing, even on its own terms.
examples.zh: 自然资源保护者开始承认，旧有的“标本罐式”保护模式正在失效，即便按其自身的标准衡量也是如此。

senses.zh: 语言学家；通晓多种语言的人；我不擅长学语言

examples.en: An audio tape recording does not solve all the linguist’s problems, however.
examples.zh: 然而，磁带录音并不能解决语言学家的所有问题。

examples.en: On a simplistic level, experience, abilities, effort and other obvious inputs should explain differences in pay, responsibility and other obvious outcomes.
examples.zh: 简单来说，经验、能力、努力程度和其他明显的投入，应当能够解释薪资、职责和其他明显回报上的差异。

examples.en: There was a dialogue between pitcher and umpire.
examples.zh: 投手和裁判之间进行了对话。

examples.en: The wild tomato has twice as much lycopene as cultivated ones; the newly domesticated one has five times as much.
examples.zh: 野生番茄的番茄红素含量是人工栽培番茄的两倍；而新驯化的番茄则是其五倍。

examples.en: If mutations prove beneficial, then the animal or the scientific theory will continue to thrive and perhaps reproduce.
examples.zh: 如果突变证明是有益的，那么这种动物或科学理论就会继续繁衍生息并发展壮大。

examples.en: Selling pharmaceuticals is a daily exercise in ethical judgement.
examples.zh: 销售药品是一项每天都在考验道德判断力的工作。

examples.en: One current plan is to create a tidal lagoon on the coast of Wales.
examples.zh: 目前的一项计划是在威尔士海岸建造一个潮汐泻湖。

examples.en: Children with auditory function deficit are potentially failing to learn to their maximum potential because of noise levels generated in classrooms.
examples.zh: 患有听觉功能缺陷的儿童，可能会因为教室里产生的噪音水平而无法充分发挥其最大潜能来进行学习。

examples.en: To stop the laser itself being struck, it would not be pointed straight at the clouds.
examples.zh: 为了防止激光器本身被雷击中，它不会直接对准云层。

senses.zh: 潮汐的；受潮汐影响的；泰晤士河是感潮河

examples.en: There are other forms of tidal energy, but I'll go on to the third category of marine energy: ocean thermal energy conversion.
examples.zh: 还有其他形式的潮汐能，但我接下来要讲海洋能的第三类：海洋温差能转换。

examples.en: Work on designs for the new turbine blades and sites are well advanced at the university of Southampton's sustainable energy research group.
examples.zh: 在南安普顿大学的可持续能源研究小组，新型涡轮叶片的设计和选址工作已取得很大进展。

examples.en: There are now around three hundred Asiatic lions in India and almost all of them are in this sanctuary.
examples.zh: 目前印度大约有三百头亚洲狮，而且几乎全都生活在这个保护区里。

examples.en: With turtles it is a little less obvious.
examples.zh: 对于龟类来说，这一点就不那么明显了。

examples.en: According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums.
examples.zh: 据研究人员称，这一出人意料的发现可能归因于在贫民窟长大的儿童的生活经历。

examples.en: With its five distinct volcanoes, the island resembles a lunar landscape.
examples.zh: 这座岛屿有五座截然不同的火山，看起来就像月球表面一样。

examples.en: Ask company employees questions prior to job interviews to gain as much insight as you can.
examples.zh: 在求职面试前向公司员工提问，以尽可能多地获取内部信息。

examples.en: What's fascinating is that the writer isn't necessarily conscious of the message they're conveying.
examples.zh: 引人入胜的是，作者未必意识到自己正在传达的信息。

examples.en: There's a lot in the novel about poverty.
examples.zh: 这部小说中有很多关于贫困的描写。

examples.en: Few governments charge realistic prices for water, especially to farmers.
examples.zh: 几乎没有哪个政府会收取切合实际的水费，尤其是对农民。

examples.en: 'If routine cognitive tasks are taken over by AI, how do professions develop their future experts?' she asks.
examples.zh: “如果常规的认知任务被人工智能接管，各行业该如何培养未来的专家呢？”她问道。

examples.en: I used to go to tap dancing classes there when I was at secondary school.
examples.zh: 我上中学的时候常去那里上踢踏舞课。

examples.en: If you could get the right data, the conclusions might be significant, but I suspect it's not going to be easy.
examples.zh: 如果你能获得合适的数据，结论可能会很有意义，但我怀疑这并不容易。

examples.en: Alternatively, you can arrange your own accommodation for that week in a flat, with friends or a local family.
examples.zh: 或者，你也可以自己安排那一周的住宿，住在公寓、朋友家或当地寄宿家庭。

examples.en: Vehicles with limited self-driving capabilities have been around for more than 50 years, resulting in significant contributions towards driver assistance systems.
examples.zh: 具备有限自动驾驶功能的车辆已经问世50多年了，为驾驶辅助系统做出了重大贡献。

examples.en: A rat that gets scared every time a subway train rolls past won't be very successful.
